day-0001.key_verse_text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
day-0001.summary: God creates the heavens and earth from formless void, then speaks light into existence and separates it from darkness. God establishes sky and separates waters, gathers waters into seas, and brings forth vegetation. God creates celestial lights to govern day and night, then populates waters and sky with creatures, and finally produces land animals, viewing each creation as good.

day-0002.key_verse_text: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
day-0002.summary: God creates man and woman in his own image and blesses them with dominion over all living creatures and the earth. God provides every herb and tree bearing seed as food for humanity and animals. God surveys all creation and declares it very good. On the seventh day, God completes his work and rests, blessing and sanctifying that day.

day-0003.key_verse_text: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
day-0003.summary: The Lord God forms man from dust and places him in the garden of Eden, commanding him to tend it and avoid the tree of knowledge. Finding the man alone unsuitable, the Lord creates a woman from his rib as his helper. The man and woman exist together naked and unashamed.

day-0047.key_verse_text: The Egyptians shall know that I am Yahweh when I stretch out my hand on Egypt, and bring the children of Israel out from among them.”
day-0047.summary: The genealogies of Reuben, Simeon, and Levi are recorded, tracing Moses and Aaron's lineage through Amram and Jochebed. The Lord commands Moses to tell Pharaoh to release Israel, promising to harden Pharaoh's heart and perform signs. Moses and Aaron demonstrate power when Aaron's rod becomes a serpent that swallows the Egyptian magicians' serpents, yet Pharaoh refuses to listen.

day-0891.key_verse_text: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
day-0891.summary: The Macedonian assemblies give generously despite severe poverty, motivating the Corinthians to complete their promised collection. Jesus became poor to make others rich. God loves cheerful givers who give from their hearts. The collection supplies saints' needs and produces thanksgiving to God.

day-0195.key_verse_text: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.
day-0195.summary: Elkanah has 2 wives; Hannah bears no children while Peninnah does, causing Hannah deep sorrow. At the temple in Shiloh, Hannah vows to give the Lord a son if granted one. Eli blesses her petition. The Lord remembers Hannah, who conceives and bears Samuel. She later brings the weaned child to the temple to fulfill her vow.

day-0269.key_verse_text: Yet Yahweh testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.” Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in Yahweh their God.
day-0269.summary: Hoshea reigns over Israel and does evil, eventually falling under Assyrian control. Israel's exile results from widespread idolatry and rejection of the Lord's prophetic warnings to turn from wickedness. The Lord removes Israel from his sight, and Assyria repopulates Samaria with foreign nations who fear the Lord yet continue serving their own gods.

day-0343.key_verse_text: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
day-0343.summary: A man blessed by the Lord finds delight in his law and meditates on it day and night, flourishing like a well-watered tree, while the wicked scatter like chaff. The Lord laughs at nations and rulers who plot against him and his Anointed, declaring his King established on Zion's holy hill and inviting all to serve him with reverent joy.

day-0121.key_verse_text: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’
day-0121.summary: The Lord commands the children of Israel to present regular offerings throughout the year: 2 lambs daily, additional lambs on the Sabbath, bulls and rams at month beginnings, and special offerings during Passover, the feast of weeks, and the seventh month festivals, with precise quantities of flour, oil, and wine for each sacrifice.

day-0417.key_verse_text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
day-0417.summary: The Lord has shown favor to the land, forgiven the people's iniquity, and turned from anger. The psalmist seeks continued revival and salvation, trusting that the Lord speaks peace to the saints. Mercy and truth converge while righteousness and peace embrace, with the Lord preparing to bless the land.

day-0713.key_verse_text: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
day-0713.summary: Jesus sends 2 disciples to retrieve a donkey and colt, then rides into Jerusalem while crowds spread clothes and branches on the road, shouting praises. He cleanses the temple, heals the lame and blind, and later curses a barren fig tree, which withers immediately.

day-0639.key_verse_text: Then he said to me, “Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come for your words ’ sake.
day-0639.summary: A heavenly messenger appears to Daniel by the Hiddekel river after 3 weeks of mourning and fasting. The figure's radiant appearance overwhelms Daniel, who falls into deep sleep. The messenger touches him, explains that Daniel's prayers were heard from the first day, and reveals that spiritual conflict delayed his arrival before delivering prophecy about future events.

day-0565.key_verse_text: but this thing I commanded them, saying, ‘Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people. Walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.’
day-0565.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to stand at the temple gate and call Judah to amend their ways and practice justice, warning against false trust in the temple itself. The Lord details their sins—theft, murder, adultery, idolatry—and declares that anger and wrath will be poured out on the land because the people have consistently rejected the Lord's voice through the prophets.

day-0491.key_verse_text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
day-0491.summary: Solomon's proverbs, copied by Hezekiah's men, offer wisdom about speech, conduct, and restraint. Well-chosen words are precious; wise reproof benefits the obedient ear. Kings must remove wickedness from their presence, and individuals should avoid hasty disputes, practice patience, show kindness to enemies, and maintain self-control in all matters.

day-0048.key_verse_text: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
day-0048.summary: The Lord sends Moses to confront Pharaoh with a series of plagues: water turning to blood, frogs covering the land, lice infesting all creatures, and swarms of flies. Though Pharaoh repeatedly promises to release the people after each plague subsides, his heart hardens and he refuses to let them go.

day-0876.key_verse_text: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
day-0876.summary: Knowledge about idols matters less than love for the weak, whose consciences may be damaged by seeing stronger believers eat sacrificed food. The writer forgoes personal rights to avoid hindering others, adapting to different groups and disciplining himself so his preaching remains credible.

day-0709.key_verse_text: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”
day-0709.summary: Jesus takes 3 disciples up a mountain where his appearance transforms, Moses and Elijah appear beside him, and a voice from a cloud declares him God's beloved Son. The disciples fall in fear until Jesus touches them and tells them to rise. Coming down, Jesus commands silence about the vision until after his resurrection.

day-0196.key_verse_text: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
day-0196.summary: Hannah prays, declaring the Lord's holiness and power to reverse human fortunes. Eli's sons abuse their priestly duties by taking sacrifices by force, despising the Lord's offering. Samuel serves faithfully before the Lord as a child. A man of God pronounces judgment on Eli's house for honoring his sons above the Lord, promising to raise up a faithful priest instead.

day-0418.key_verse_text: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
day-0418.summary: A person in distress calls upon the Lord for mercy and preservation, praising the Lord's greatness, goodness, and readiness to forgive. The Lord is described as incomparable among all gods and worthy of worship from all nations. The petitioner requests instruction in the Lord's ways and asks for deliverance from enemies.

day-0344.key_verse_text: But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
day-0344.summary: A speaker faces many adversaries who claim the Lord offers no help, yet declares the Lord as a shield and glory. The speaker cries out and receives an answer, sleeps peacefully sustained by the Lord, and expresses confidence against overwhelming opposition. The speaker calls on the Lord to save and strike enemies, affirming that salvation belongs to the Lord.

day-0122.key_verse_text: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
day-0122.summary: Moses conveys the Lord's commands regarding vows. A man who vows to the Lord must keep his word. A woman's vows stand unless her father or husband forbids them when hearing them. A widow's or divorced woman's vows always stand. A husband may nullify his wife's vows, and if he does so after hearing them, he bears her guilt.

day-0270.key_verse_text: He trusted in Yahweh, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.
day-0270.summary: Hezekiah becomes king at 25 and reigns 29 years in Jerusalem, doing right in the Lord's eyes by removing idolatrous high places and breaking the bronze serpent. He trusts the Lord completely and prospers, rebelling against Assyria. When Sennacherib's forces besiege Judah, Hezekiah pays tribute, but Assyrian messengers later mock his trust in the Lord before Jerusalem's walls.

day-0492.key_verse_text: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
day-0492.summary: The passage describes the foolish, the sluggard, and the deceitful through vivid comparisons. Honor befits not fools, whose folly spreads harm. Sluggards make excuses and lack diligence. Deceivers disguise malice with charming speech, yet their wickedness surfaces. Those who dig pits and roll stones experience their own schemes returning upon them.

day-0861.key_verse_text: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death? I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God ’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.
day-0861.summary: The law holds dominion over a person while living, illustrated through marriage bonds. Believers are made dead to the law through Christ's body to serve in newness of spirit. The law itself is holy and good, yet sin uses it to produce death. A person desires good but finds evil present, experiencing internal conflict between mind and flesh.

day-0566.key_verse_text: Yahweh says, “Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom. Don’t let the mighty man glory in his might. Don’t let the rich man glory in his riches. But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness on the earth, for I delight in these things,” says Yahweh.
day-0566.summary: The Lord announces judgment on Judah for persistent unfaithfulness, false wisdom, and deceit. Bones will be desecrated, crops will fail, and the land will become desolate. The Lord declares that true glory comes not from wisdom, might, or riches, but from knowing the Lord and understanding his justice and kindness.

day-0640.key_verse_text: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.
day-0640.summary: An angel reveals to Daniel a succession of Persian and Greek kings, describing their conflicts and alliances. A contemptible king rises through flattery, profanes the sanctuary, and corrupts the covenant-breakers, while the wise remain strong. The king ultimately exalts himself above all gods and meets his appointed end.

day-0714.key_verse_text: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes ’?
day-0714.summary: Jesus enters the temple and faces questions about his authority. He responds with a counter-question about John's baptism, which the chief priests and elders cannot answer. Jesus then tells 2 parables about obedience and a vineyard, concluding that God's Kingdom will be given to others who produce fruit.

day-0994.key_verse_text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
day-0994.summary: A new heaven and earth appear with the holy city New Jerusalem descending from God. God dwells with people, wiping away tears and eliminating death, mourning, crying, and pain. The one on the throne makes all things new and gives freely to the thirsty from the water of life.

day-0847.key_verse_text: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.
day-0847.summary: Paul finds disciples in Ephesus who have received only John's baptism, baptizes them in Jesus's name, and lays hands on them so the Holy Spirit comes upon them. He teaches in the synagogue and school of Tyrannus for two years, performing miracles that spread the Lord's word throughout Asia until a silversmith's riot erupts over declining idol sales.

day-0832.key_verse_text: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
day-0832.summary: Peter declares that God approved Jesus through mighty works and signs, yet lawless men crucified him. God raised Jesus from death, fulfilling David's prophecy about the Christ's resurrection. About 3,000 respond to Peter's call to repent and be baptized. The new believers devote themselves to apostolic teaching, fellowship, breaking bread, and prayer, sharing possessions and meeting daily in the temple.

day-0123.key_verse_text: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.
day-0123.summary: The Lord commands Moses to avenge Israel against Midian. Twelve thousand armed men fight and kill all males, including 5 kings and Balaam, capturing women, children, and livestock. Moses orders further killings and purification rituals, then divides the plunder between warriors and the congregation, with portions given to the Lord and the Levites.

day-0271.key_verse_text: Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”
day-0271.summary: King Hezekiah tears his clothes and seeks Isaiah after receiving threatening letters from the Assyrian king Sennacherib. Isaiah assures Hezekiah that the Lord will protect Jerusalem. That night, the Lord's angel strikes 185,000 Assyrians dead, and Sennacherib returns home, where his own sons kill him.

day-0345.key_verse_text: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
day-0345.summary: The psalmist calls on God for relief from distress and mercy, then addresses others about their pursuit of vanity. The Lord sets apart the godly and hears their prayers. The psalmist instructs listeners to stand in awe, examine their hearts, and trust in the Lord, finding gladness and peace in divine protection.

day-0049.key_verse_text: but indeed for this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth,
day-0049.summary: The Lord sends Moses to demand Pharaoh release the Israelites. After livestock die and boils afflict Egypt while sparing Israel, Pharaoh's heart hardens. The Lord then brings devastating hail that destroys crops and animals throughout Egypt, except in Goshen. Pharaoh briefly relents but hardens his heart again, refusing to let the people go.

day-0419.key_verse_text: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.
day-0419.summary: Zion stands on holy mountains as the Lord's beloved city where glorious things are spoken. Nations acknowledge the Lord and claim birth there. Yet a sufferer cries day and night from deep trouble, surrounded by affliction, wrath, and isolation, questioning whether the Lord's faithfulness reaches beyond the grave.

day-0197.key_verse_text: Yahweh came, and stood, and called as at other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Then Samuel said, “Speak; for your servant hears.”
day-0197.summary: The child Samuel ministers to the Lord before Eli when the Lord calls him repeatedly. Samuel initially mistakes the calls for Eli's voice until Eli recognizes the Lord is speaking and instructs Samuel to respond. The Lord then reveals judgment against Eli's house. Samuel grows and becomes established as a prophet throughout Israel.

day-0567.key_verse_text: God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens.
day-0567.summary: The Lord warns the house of Israel against adopting the ways of nations and fearing their idols, which are merely carved wood decorated with silver and gold. The Lord alone is the true God who created the earth by power and wisdom, while idols are vanity and will perish. Judgment comes upon Judah for unfaithful shepherds.

day-0641.key_verse_text: Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.
day-0641.summary: Michael stands up to deliver the people whose names appear in the book during unprecedented trouble. Many sleepers awake to everlasting life or shame. The wise shine like stars forever. Daniel receives instruction to seal the words until the end times, and a heavenly figure reveals that these events will conclude after a specific period.

day-0715.key_verse_text: For many are called, but few chosen.”
day-0715.summary: Jesus describes a king who prepares a wedding feast for his son. The invited guests reject the invitation, mistreat and kill the servants sent to summon them, so the king destroys those murderers and invites people from the highways instead. When a guest arrives without proper wedding clothing, the king has him bound and cast into outer darkness.

day-0979.key_verse_text: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”
day-0979.summary: The Lamb opens 6 seals in sequence. The first 4 seals release horsemen bringing conquest, war, famine, and death across the earth. The 5th seal reveals martyrs beneath an altar crying for justice. The 6th seal triggers cosmic upheaval, causing all people to hide in fear of the Lamb's wrath.

day-0965.key_verse_text: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
day-0965.summary: Mockers in the last days question the Lord's promise of return, forgetting that God destroyed the ancient world by water and will destroy the present heavens and earth by fire. The Lord's patience reflects his desire for repentance before the day of judgment arrives.

day-0818.key_verse_text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
day-0818.summary: Jesus washes the disciples' feet before the Passover, demonstrating humility and service. After Judas departs to betray him, Jesus gives a new commandment: the disciples must love one another as he has loved them, and this love will mark them as his disciples.

day-0950.key_verse_text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
day-0950.summary: Faith is the assurance of things hoped for and proof of things not seen. The elders obtained approval through faith, and numerous figures from Abel through the prophets demonstrate faith by obeying God, enduring hardship, and seeking a heavenly country despite not receiving the promises during their lifetimes.

day-0050.key_verse_text: and that you may tell in the hearing of your son, and of your son’s son, what things I have done to Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that you may know that I am Yahweh.”
day-0050.summary: The Lord instructs Moses to confront Pharaoh about releasing the Israelites. After Pharaoh refuses, a plague of locusts devastates Egypt, consuming all vegetation. Pharaoh briefly repents, but the Lord hardens his heart again. Darkness then covers the land for 3 days, yet Pharaoh continues refusing to let the people go.

day-0803.key_verse_text: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.
day-0803.summary: Jesus explains that the Son acts only as the Father directs, possessing authority to give life and execute judgment. Those hearing Jesus's word and believing the Father who sent him receive eternal life and escape judgment. The Father, Jesus's works, John the Baptist, and the Scriptures all testify to Jesus's identity, yet the listeners reject him despite searching Scripture.

day-0493.key_verse_text: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
day-0493.summary: The passage offers observations about human conduct and relationships. Boasting about tomorrow, self-praise, foolish provocation, and jealousy bring trouble. Open rebuke surpasses hidden love, and a friend's wounds prove faithful. Genuine counsel brings joy, while close neighbors matter more than distant relatives. Iron sharpens iron as friends sharpen each other's character.

day-0198.key_verse_text: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”
day-0198.summary: Israel battles the Philistines and suffers defeat despite bringing the Lord's ark to the camp. The Philistines capture the ark and kill Eli's sons. Eli dies upon hearing the news, and his daughter-in-law names her newborn Ichabod, saying the glory has departed from Israel. The Lord's ark brings affliction to the Philistines in each city where they place it.

day-0124.key_verse_text: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
day-0124.summary: The Reubenites and Gadites request the fertile lands east of the Jordan for their livestock. Moses initially objects, fearing they will discourage the other tribes. After the Reubenites and Gadites promise to fight alongside the other tribes before settling their families, Moses grants them the conquered territories of Sihon and Og, which they then fortify and inhabit.

day-0494.key_verse_text: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
day-0494.summary: The righteous display boldness while the wicked flee in fear. Those who keep the law prosper, whereas those who forsake it praise wickedness. Concealing sins prevents prosperity, but confession and renunciation bring mercy. Integrity matters more than wealth, and trust in the Lord yields blessing and safety.

day-0346.key_verse_text: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.
day-0346.summary: The psalmist calls on the Lord to hear his morning prayers and requests, noting that the Lord rejects wickedness and destroys liars and the deceitful. The psalmist enters the Lord's house in reverence, asks for righteous guidance against enemies, and declares that those taking refuge in the Lord rejoice while the righteous receive blessing and favor.

day-0272.key_verse_text: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to Yahweh’s house.
day-0272.summary: Hezekiah receives a terminal illness diagnosis but prays earnestly, and the Lord grants him healing and 15 additional years. After recovery, he displays his treasures to Babylonian envoys, prompting Isaiah to prophesy future captivity. Manasseh then reigns and commits extensive evil, provoking the Lord's judgment. Amon follows, continuing wickedness until his servants assassinate him.

day-0642.key_verse_text: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion. I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know Yahweh.
day-0642.summary: The Lord commands Hosea to marry an unfaithful woman, symbolizing Israel's abandonment of the Lord. Their children receive names signifying judgment and separation. Yet the Lord promises future restoration, declaring eternal betrothal characterized by righteousness, justice, loving kindness, compassion, and faithfulness, transforming the rejected into beloved people.

day-0568.key_verse_text: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;
day-0568.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to proclaim a covenant to Judah and Jerusalem, warning that those who disobey face curses. The people have broken the covenant, turned to other gods, and plotted against Jeremiah. The Lord pronounces judgment on them and their enemies, though promising eventual restoration for those who learn the Lord's ways.

day-0788.key_verse_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
day-0788.summary: Jesus observes a poor widow giving 2 small coins to the temple treasury and declares she contributed more than the wealthy donors because she gave from her poverty rather than abundance. He then predicts the temple's destruction and describes future tribulations, wars, earthquakes, and persecution before the Son of Man's coming.

day-0921.key_verse_text: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
day-0921.summary: The apostles describe their ministry among the Thessalonians, explaining that their visit bore fruit despite previous suffering. They preached God's Good News with pure motives, worked diligently without burdening anyone, and treated the believers with gentle, fatherly affection. The Thessalonians received the message as God's word and suffered similarly to assemblies in Judea.

day-0420.key_verse_text: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
day-0420.summary: The psalmist declares the Lord's eternal loving kindness and faithfulness, praising the Lord's power over creation and covenant with David. The Lord promises David's offspring and throne will endure forever, yet later expresses lament that the Lord has rejected the anointed one, broken the covenant, and brought shame. The psalm closes with a blessing of the Lord.

day-0051.key_verse_text: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.
day-0051.summary: The Lord announces the final plague striking all Egyptian firstborns at midnight and instructs the Israelites to mark their doorposts with lamb's blood so the destroyer passes over their homes. The people observe the Passover meal and regulations, then depart Egypt with plundered silver, gold, and livestock after 430 years.

day-0125.key_verse_text: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.
day-0125.summary: Moses records the 40-year journey of the children of Israel from Egypt through the wilderness to the plains of Moab. The Lord commands them to cross the Jordan, dispossess the land's inhabitants, destroy their idols, and take possession of Canaan as their inheritance.

day-0199.key_verse_text: Then Samuel took a stone and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us until now.”
day-0199.summary: The Philistines return the Lord's ark to Israel with a trespass offering. After 20 years in Kiriath Jearim, Samuel calls Israel to repentance at Mizpah. The Lord defeats the Philistines with thunder, and Samuel erects a stone called Ebenezer to commemorate the Lord's help. Samuel judges Israel throughout his life.

day-0347.key_verse_text: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.
day-0347.summary: A person in distress pleads with the Lord for mercy and healing, describing physical weakness and emotional anguish. The person weeps through the night and grows weary from grief. The Lord hears the supplication and accepts the prayer, causing the enemies to turn back in shame and disgrace.

day-0421.key_verse_text: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
day-0421.summary: The Lord exists as an eternal dwelling place across generations, preceding all creation. Human life passes swiftly like grass that sprouts and withers in a day. The Lord's anger consumes people, exposing their hidden sins. A request follows for the Lord to teach wisdom through awareness of life's brevity and to restore joy and favor.

day-0495.key_verse_text: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
day-0495.summary: The passage describes contrasts between righteous and wicked conduct. The righteous bring joy, pursue justice, and find safety in trusting the Lord, while the wicked face ruin through sin and poor leadership. Wisdom, self-control, and obedience to law produce stability and honor, whereas pride, anger, and fear of people lead to downfall.

day-0569.key_verse_text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
day-0569.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to buy a linen belt, hide it by the Euphrates, and retrieve it after many days. The belt is ruined, symbolizing how the Lord will destroy Judah and Jerusalem's pride because they refuse to hear the Lord's words and pursue other gods instead of clinging to the Lord.

day-0716.key_verse_text: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ This is the first and great commandment. A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
day-0716.summary: The Pharisees and Sadducees attempt to trap Jesus with questions about taxes and resurrection, but his answers silence them. A lawyer then asks about the greatest commandment, and Jesus identifies love of God and love of neighbor as foundational to all law and prophets.

day-0643.key_verse_text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.
day-0643.summary: The Lord commands the prophet to love an unfaithful woman, symbolizing the Lord's love for Israel despite their idolatry. Israel will endure a long period without king or worship, then return to seek the Lord. The Lord charges Israel with lacking knowledge and truth, abandoning the Lord's law, and pursuing idolatry and immorality, bringing destruction upon the land.

day-0717.key_verse_text: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!
day-0717.summary: Jesus addresses the multitudes and disciples, condemning the scribes and Pharisees for their hypocrisy, burdensome teachings, and outward displays of piety while neglecting justice and mercy. He pronounces multiple woes against them for blocking the Kingdom of Heaven, devouring widows' houses, and persecuting prophets. Jesus laments that Jerusalem refuses his gathering embrace and declares the city left desolate.

day-0759.key_verse_text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.
day-0759.summary: At 8 days old, Jesus is circumcised and named. His parents present him at the temple in Jerusalem where Simeon and Anna recognize him as the promised salvation. At age 12, Jesus remains in the temple discussing with teachers while his parents search for him. He grows in wisdom and favor with God and people.

day-0273.key_verse_text: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in Yahweh’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
day-0273.summary: King Josiah begins repairs to the Lord's house. The high priest discovers the book of the law, which the king reads and tears his clothes upon hearing. A prophetess confirms the Lord's judgment on Judah but promises the king peace. Josiah gathers the people, reads the covenant, and leads widespread religious reforms, removing idols and celebrating Passover.

day-0906.key_verse_text: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
day-0906.summary: Paul, a prisoner for the Gentiles, explains that the mystery of Christ has been revealed through the Spirit, making Gentiles fellow heirs in the body of Christ. He prays that the Father strengthens believers through the Spirit so Christ dwells in their hearts and they comprehend the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge.

day-0200.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me as the king over them.
day-0200.summary: Samuel's aging sons prove corrupt judges, prompting Israel's elders to demand a king like other nations. The Lord instructs Samuel to grant their request, viewing it as rejection of divine kingship. Samuel warns the people of a king's harsh demands, but they refuse to listen and insist on having a monarch to lead them in battle.

day-0892.key_verse_text: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
day-0892.summary: Paul appeals to the Corinthians by Christ's humility and gentleness, explaining that spiritual warfare operates through divine weapons that demolish strongholds and bring thoughts captive to Christ's obedience. He defends his apostolic authority, given by the Lord for building up rather than tearing down, and warns against self-commendation, affirming that the Lord alone approves.

day-0274.key_verse_text: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,
day-0274.summary: Successive kings of Judah do evil and face judgment as Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem, captures Jehoiachin, and destroys the temple. Zedekiah rebels and is defeated; the city burns and its people are exiled. Decades later, Evilmerodach releases Jehoiachin from prison and grants him favor.

day-0348.key_verse_text: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
day-0348.summary: A speaker seeks refuge in the Lord from pursuers, asserting personal innocence and calling for divine judgment. The Lord is described as a righteous judge who examines hearts and minds. The wicked prepare instruments of violence but fall into their own traps, their trouble returning upon their heads. The speaker vows to give thanks to the Lord Most High.

day-0422.key_verse_text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
day-0422.summary: One who dwells in the Most High's secret place finds refuge and protection under the Almighty's wings. The Lord delivers from dangers, covers with faithfulness, and stations angels to guard in all ways. Those who make the Lord their dwelling place experience divine deliverance, answered prayers, and long life.

day-0774.key_verse_text: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
day-0774.summary: A lawyer asks Jesus about inheriting eternal life and receives instruction to love God and neighbor. Jesus illustrates neighborly love through a parable of a Samaritan who aids a beaten traveler, then visits Martha and Mary, affirming Mary's choice to listen to his teaching over serving.

day-0496.key_verse_text: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
day-0496.summary: Agur confesses his ignorance and affirms that God's words are flawless and shield those who trust in him. He requests freedom from falsehood and moderate provision. The passage catalogs generations marked by disrespect, insatiable desires, amazing natural phenomena, and small creatures displaying wisdom.

day-0718.key_verse_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
day-0718.summary: Jesus predicts the temple's destruction and describes future tribulations including false messiahs, wars, famines, and persecution. He warns of the abomination of desolation and cosmic disturbances preceding his return on the clouds with power and glory. No one knows the day or hour except God the Father.

day-0126.key_verse_text: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan ( this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders ),
day-0126.summary: The Lord instructs Moses to command the children of Israel regarding the borders of Canaan they will inherit. Detailed boundaries are described from south to west to north to east. Moses then names Eleazar the priest and Joshua to oversee the land division, along with 1 prince from each of the 9 tribes and half-tribe receiving inheritance in Canaan.

day-0644.key_verse_text: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
day-0644.summary: The Lord calls priests and Israel to account for their unfaithfulness and idolatry. Though the people seek the Lord with offerings, the Lord withdraws from them and threatens judgment through foreign powers and devastation. The Lord desires mercy and knowledge of God rather than sacrifices, yet the people continue breaking covenant and committing violence.

day-0570.key_verse_text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.
day-0570.summary: Severe drought devastates Judah as the Lord refuses to hear prayers or accept offerings from a people who love to wander. False prophets deceive the nation while the Lord appoints destruction through sword, famine, and wild animals. Jeremiah laments his suffering, yet the Lord promises to strengthen him and make him a fortified wall against his enemies.

day-0862.key_verse_text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
day-0862.summary: Those in Christ Jesus experience no condemnation and live by the Spirit rather than the flesh. The Spirit of God dwells in believers, making them children of God and heirs with Christ. All things work together for good for those who love God and are called according to his purpose. Nothing can separate believers from God's love in Christ Jesus.

day-0877.key_verse_text: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
day-0877.summary: The ancestors experienced God's protection through the cloud and sea, ate spiritual food, and drank from a spiritual rock that was Christ, yet most displeased God through idolatry, sexual immorality, and grumbling. These events serve as examples. God remains faithful, providing escape from temptation. Believers should flee idolatry and conduct themselves to glorify God and benefit others.

day-0053.key_verse_text: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
day-0053.summary: Moses and the children of Israel sing to the Lord, celebrating his triumph over Pharaoh's army in the sea. The song praises the Lord's strength, power, and holiness, recounting how he destroyed the Egyptian chariots and horsemen while leading his redeemed people safely through. Miriam the prophetess leads the women in dancing and singing the same song.

day-0052.key_verse_text: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
day-0052.summary: The Lord commands the consecration of firstborns and establishes the Feast of Unleavened Bread as a memorial of exodus. When Pharaoh pursues the Israelites to the Red Sea, Moses stretches his hand over the water, dividing it so the people cross on dry ground. The pursuing Egyptian army is overwhelmed and destroyed as the waters return.

day-0349.key_verse_text: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?
day-0349.summary: The psalmist marvels at the Lord's majestic name and glory above the heavens. Despite human smallness compared to the celestial works, the Lord has made mankind slightly lower than angels, crowned with glory and honor, and given dominion over all creation including animals, birds, and fish.

day-0275.summary: The passage traces genealogies from Adam through Noah's sons and their descendants, including the line of Abraham and Isaac, the kings of Edom, and the 12 sons of Israel. It then details the descendants of Judah, including the line leading to David, along with genealogies of Caleb and other tribal families.

day-0127.key_verse_text: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, Yahweh, dwell among the children of Israel.’”
day-0127.summary: The Lord commands the Israelites to provide 48 cities to the Levites, including 6 cities of refuge. Those who kill unintentionally may flee there until the high priest dies. Murderers face execution by the avenger of blood. Witnesses must testify, and no ransom redeems murderers. Blood pollution defiles the land where the Lord dwells.

day-0497.key_verse_text: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
day-0497.summary: King Lemuel's mother instructs him to avoid women and strong drink, which destroy kings, while calling leaders to defend the mute and poor. The passage then describes a worthy woman of great value who works diligently, manages her household, helps the needy, and gains praise for fearing the Lord rather than relying on charm or beauty.

day-0423.key_verse_text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
day-0423.summary: Giving thanks to the Lord and proclaiming his kindness and faithfulness through music is good. Though the wicked flourish temporarily, they face destruction while the righteous grow strong like palm and cedar trees, bearing fruit in old age. The Lord reigns eternally, clothed in majesty and strength, with statutes that stand firm forever.

day-0201.key_verse_text: Then Yahweh’s Spirit will come mightily on you, then you will prophesy with them and will be turned into another man.
day-0201.summary: Saul searches for lost donkeys and encounters Samuel, who anoints him as prince over Israel. Samuel gives Saul signs of his coming transformation, including that the Lord's Spirit will come upon him mightily. At Mizpah, Samuel presents Saul to the people, who acclaim him king, though some despise him.

day-0719.key_verse_text: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
day-0719.summary: Jesus describes 10 virgins awaiting a bridegroom; 5 bring oil while 5 do not. When the bridegroom arrives at midnight, the prepared virgins enter the feast and the door closes, leaving the unprepared outside. Jesus then tells of a master distributing talents to servants according to ability, rewarding those who invest wisely and punishing the one who hides his portion.

day-0980.key_verse_text: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
day-0980.summary: Four angels hold back the earth's winds while another angel seals 144,000 from the tribes of Israel. A vast multitude from every nation stands before the throne in white robes, worshiping God and the Lamb. These are those who endured great suffering, and the Lamb shepherds them to life-giving waters while God wipes away their tears.

day-0571.key_verse_text: “Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh. For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat comes, but its leaf will be green, and will not be concerned in the year of drought. It won’t cease from yielding fruit.
day-0571.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah not to marry and announces coming judgment on Judah for forsaking the Lord and serving other gods. The Lord contrasts those who trust in human strength with those who trust in the Lord, comparing them to a desert bush and a fruitful tree. The Lord calls the people to keep the Sabbath holy.

day-0833.key_verse_text: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”
day-0833.summary: Peter and John encounter a man lame from birth at the temple gate. Peter commands him to walk in Jesus's name, and the man immediately stands and enters the temple praising God. The crowd recognizes him and gathers in amazement at what has occurred.

day-0848.key_verse_text: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.
day-0848.summary: Paul travels through Macedonia and Greece, then sails toward Jerusalem with companions. At Troas, a young man falls from a window during Paul's lengthy teaching, but revives. Paul later addresses the Ephesian elders, recounting his ministry among them and warning of future dangers to the assembly.

day-0995.key_verse_text: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
day-0995.summary: A river of life flows from God's throne, with the tree of life bearing 12 fruits monthly and healing nations. God's servants see his face, experience no night, and reign forever. Jesus testifies he comes soon, repaying each according to works, identifying himself as Alpha and Omega, root of David, and Morning Star.

day-0054.key_verse_text: Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a day’s portion every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in my law or not.
day-0054.summary: After leaving Egypt, the Israelites journey through the wilderness and encounter bitter water at Marah, which the Lord makes sweet. Later, facing hunger in the wilderness of Sin, the Lord provides quail and manna daily, establishing the Sabbath rest. At Rephidim, the Lord provides water from a rock, and Joshua defeats Amalek while Moses holds up his rod.

day-0645.key_verse_text: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
day-0645.summary: The Lord observes Israel's wickedness, falsehood, and theft while leaders celebrate corruption. Israel mixes with nations like an unturned pancake, growing weak without realizing it. Though the Lord taught and strengthened them, they plot evil and establish idols without divine approval. Their actions sow wind and reap whirlwind; strangers consume their harvest as judgment approaches.

day-0202.key_verse_text: God’s Spirit came mightily on Saul when he heard those words, and his anger burned hot.
day-0202.summary: Nahash the Ammonite besieges Jabesh Gilead and demands the right eyes of its men. Messengers reach Saul, God's Spirit empowers him, and he summons Israel to battle. Saul defeats the Ammonites decisively, and the people gather at Gilgal to establish him as king before the Lord.

day-0128.key_verse_text: This is the thing which Yahweh commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.
day-0128.summary: The heads of Joseph's families present a concern to Moses: if Zelophehad's daughters marry outside their tribe, their inheritance transfers with them. The Lord commands that the daughters marry within their father's tribe to keep tribal lands intact. The 5 daughters obey, marrying their cousins and retaining their inheritance in Manasseh's family.

day-0276.key_verse_text: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.
day-0276.summary: The passage records the descendants of David through Solomon and subsequent kings of Judah, genealogies of Judah and Simeon with their settlements, and the lineages of Reuben, Gad, and half-Manasseh east of the Jordan. Jabez prays for blessing and protection, which God grants. The eastern tribes later face exile to Assyria for unfaithfulness.

day-0350.key_verse_text: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, Yahweh, have not forsaken those who seek you.
day-0350.summary: The psalmist gives thanks to the Lord for maintaining justice and destroying the wicked, declaring that the Lord reigns forever and judges righteously. The Lord protects the oppressed and does not forsake those who seek him, while the wicked fall into their own traps and face judgment for their arrogance and cruelty toward the helpless.

day-0424.key_verse_text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
day-0424.summary: The psalmist calls on the Lord as judge to punish the wicked who oppress the vulnerable and deny divine knowledge. The Lord knows human thoughts and disciplines nations. The righteous find blessing through the Lord's teaching and comfort, while judgment ultimately returns to righteousness and the wicked face their own iniquity.

day-0498.key_verse_text: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”
day-0498.summary: The Preacher, king in Jerusalem, declares that all human endeavor under the sun is vanity. He observes that generations pass while the earth endures, natural cycles repeat endlessly, and nothing truly new exists. Despite acquiring great wisdom and knowledge, the Preacher finds all pursuits ultimately futile and sorrowful.

day-0646.key_verse_text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.
day-0646.summary: Israel is warned against rejoicing like other nations because of unfaithfulness to God. The Lord declares coming judgment: exile to Egypt and Assyria, destruction of altars, and removal of offspring. Yet the Lord calls Israel to sow righteousness and seek the Lord, promising rain of righteousness to those who break up fallow ground.

day-0720.key_verse_text: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.
day-0720.summary: Jesus announces his coming crucifixion to his disciples. Meanwhile, chief priests plot his death, a woman anoints him with expensive ointment, and Judas agrees to betray him for thirty pieces of silver. At the Passover meal, Jesus identifies his betrayer, then distributes bread and wine, declaring them his body and blood of the new covenant for the remission of sins.

day-0806.key_verse_text: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.
day-0806.summary: Jesus remains in Galilee while his brothers urge him to go to Judea for the Feast of Booths. He later arrives secretly and teaches in the temple, where the Jews marvel at his knowledge. Jesus explains that his teaching comes from the one who sent him and that those desiring God's will can discern its truth.

day-0966.key_verse_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
day-0966.summary: The author testifies to the eternal life revealed through Jesus Christ and declares that God is light with no darkness. Those who walk in the light have fellowship with one another and are cleansed by Jesus's blood, while those who confess their sins receive the Lord's faithful forgiveness and cleansing from all unrighteousness.

day-0804.key_verse_text: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”
day-0804.summary: Jesus feeds a great multitude with 5 loaves and 2 fish, with 12 baskets of fragments remaining. Later, his disciples row across the sea in darkness and wind when Jesus appears walking on the water. He identifies himself and calms their fear, and the boat immediately reaches land.

day-0951.key_verse_text: Therefore let ’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let ’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us, looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
day-0951.summary: Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, endured the cross and sits at God's right hand. Believers receive discipline from the Lord as children receive it from fathers, which yields righteousness. Those who have come to the heavenly Jerusalem through Jesus' new covenant must serve God with reverence, for the Lord is a consuming fire.

day-0572.key_verse_text: “House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter?” says Yahweh. “Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.
day-0572.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to visit a potter's house and observe clay being reshaped. The Lord explains that Israel is like clay in the potter's hand, subject to reshaping based on the nation's obedience or disobedience. When Judah refuses to repent, the Lord declares judgment through symbolic acts and pronouncements of destruction.

day-0203.key_verse_text: For Yahweh will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased Yahweh to make you a people for himself.
day-0203.summary: Samuel testifies to his integrity as judge, then recounts the Lord's faithfulness throughout Israel's history, how the people repeatedly forgot and were delivered, and how they requested a king despite the Lord being their ruler. Thunder and rain demonstrate their sin, yet Samuel assures them the Lord will not abandon his people if they serve faithfully.

day-0277.key_verse_text: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
day-0277.summary: The passage traces the genealogy of Levi's descendants through 3 main lines: Kohath, Gershom, and Merari. It identifies the singers David appointed for temple service, lists Aaron's priestly line, and details the cities and pasture lands distributed to the Levites throughout Israel's tribes.

day-0819.key_verse_text: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
day-0819.summary: Jesus tells his disciples not to be troubled and assures them that he prepares a place in his Father's house for them. He identifies himself as the way, the truth, and the life, the sole path to the Father. Jesus promises to send the Holy Spirit as a counselor and comforter to dwell with them forever.

day-0055.key_verse_text: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
day-0055.summary: Jethro arrives at Moses' camp with Moses' wife and 2 sons. After hearing of the Lord's deliverance from Egypt, Jethro observes Moses judging people all day and suggests a hierarchical system of capable, God-fearing leaders to share the burden. Moses implements this structure, appointing rulers over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.

day-0351.key_verse_text: For Yahweh is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
day-0351.summary: The Lord sits enthroned in heaven, observing all people. The wicked bend their bows against the upright, yet the Lord examines both the righteous and the wicked. The Lord hates wickedness and violence, raining judgment on the wicked while the upright behold the Lord's face, for the Lord loves righteousness.

day-0129.key_verse_text: Behold, Yahweh your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as Yahweh the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”
day-0129.summary: Moses addresses the Israelites in the fortieth year, recounting how the Lord commanded them to possess the promised land. After appointing judges and leaders, Moses sends 12 men to scout the territory. The people refuse to advance, fearing the inhabitants, and later presume to fight without divine approval, resulting in defeat and prolonged wandering.

day-0425.key_verse_text: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
day-0425.summary: The Lord is praised as a great God and King who created all things and calls people to worship and bow before him. All the earth is summoned to sing a new song, declare his glory among nations, and acknowledge his reign, for he comes to judge the world with righteousness and truth.

day-0499.key_verse_text: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.
day-0499.summary: The speaker pursues pleasure, accumulates vast wealth and possessions, and achieves great wisdom and success, yet concludes all accomplishments are vanity. Recognizing that wisdom and folly lead to the same end and that labors pass to unknown successors, the speaker finds only eating, drinking, and enjoying labor as gifts from God to hold meaning.

day-0573.key_verse_text: If I say that I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones. I am weary with holding it in. I can’t.
day-0573.summary: Pashhur, a priest, strikes Jeremiah and imprisons him for prophesying. Upon release, Jeremiah declares the Lord will rename Pashhur and bring captivity to Judah and Babylon's conquest. Jeremiah expresses his internal struggle between his compulsion to speak the Lord's word and the mockery and persecution this calling brings.

day-0721.key_verse_text: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
day-0721.summary: Jesus predicts the disciples will scatter, but Peter insists he will remain faithful. In Gethsemane, Jesus prays in anguish, asking the Father to remove the cup of suffering while submitting to the Father's will. Judas betrays Jesus with a kiss, soldiers arrest him, and Peter denies knowing Jesus 3 times before the rooster crows.

day-0935.key_verse_text: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness, that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.
day-0935.summary: In the last days, grievous times arrive as people become lovers of self and money, boastful and disobedient. Some hold a form of godliness while denying its power, creeping into houses to deceive gullible women. Evil men grow worse, yet Scripture, being God-breathed, equips those belonging to God for every good work.

day-0789.key_verse_text: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.” Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
day-0789.summary: The Passover feast approaches as chief priests plot Jesus's death. Judas agrees to betray him for money. Jesus sends disciples to prepare the meal, then shares bread and wine with the twelve, declaring his body and blood given in a new covenant. He predicts his betrayal and instructs the disciples on servant leadership.

day-0922.key_verse_text: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you, to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
day-0922.summary: Timothy is sent to strengthen the believers' faith during afflictions. He returns with news of their faith and love, bringing comfort to the sender. A prayer follows that the Lord would increase their love toward one another and all people, establishing their hearts in holiness.

day-0056.key_verse_text: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine; and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
day-0056.summary: In the third month after leaving Egypt, the Israelites arrive at Mount Sinai. The Lord calls Moses to convey a covenant: if the people obey, they become the Lord's possession and a kingdom of priests. The elders agree, and after 3 days of preparation, the Lord descends in fire and thunder while Moses receives further instructions.

day-0204.key_verse_text: But now your kingdom will not continue. Yahweh has sought for himself a man after his own heart, and Yahweh has appointed him to be prince over his people, because you have not kept that which Yahweh commanded you.”
day-0204.summary: Saul assembles forces against the Philistines, but when his troops scatter in fear and Samuel delays, Saul offers a burnt offering himself. Samuel arrives and declares that Saul has disobeyed the Lord's command, so his kingdom will not endure. The Philistines maintain military superiority, leaving Israel's soldiers without weapons.

day-0130.key_verse_text: For Yahweh your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, Yahweh your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.
day-0130.summary: The Lord directs the people to pass through the lands of Esau, Moab, and Ammon without conflict, instructing them to purchase food and water. After 38 years in the wilderness, the Lord hardens Sihon's heart, and the people defeat him and his army, conquering his cities and territory while avoiding the Ammonites' land.

day-0278.key_verse_text: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
day-0278.summary: The text records genealogies of the tribes of Israel, listing descendants of Issachar, Benjamin, Manasseh, Ephraim, Asher, and others with their military numbers and settlements. It documents inhabitants returning to Jerusalem after captivity, including priests, Levites, and gatekeepers who served in God's house, each assigned specific duties.

day-0647.key_verse_text: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.
day-0647.summary: The Lord recalls loving Israel as a child and teaching Ephraim to walk, yet the people turn to idolatry and refuse to repent. Though judgment comes through the sword and Assyrian rule, the Lord's compassion stirs within, restraining fierce anger and promising restoration. Israel's persistent deceit and unfaithfulness provoke the Lord's controversy, yet the Lord remains their God from Egypt.

day-0352.key_verse_text: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
day-0352.summary: The psalmist calls for the Lord's help as faithful people disappear and deceit spreads through flattering speech. The Lord responds, promising to protect the weak and needy from their oppressors. The Lord's words stand pure and trustworthy, preserved eternally, while wickedness continues to flourish among humanity.

day-0648.key_verse_text: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.
day-0648.summary: Ephraim's idolatry brings judgment and destruction from the Lord, who pursues the people like wild beasts. Yet the Lord offers restoration to those who return and repent, promising healing and flourishing like vegetation. The righteous walk in the Lord's ways while the rebellious stumble.

day-0775.key_verse_text: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
day-0775.summary: After finishing his prayer, a disciple asks Jesus to teach them to pray. Jesus provides a prayer addressing God as Father in heaven, requesting that God's name be honored, God's kingdom come, and God's will be done on earth. He then teaches that persistent asking, seeking, and knocking receive answers, comparing God's generosity to earthly fathers.

day-0426.key_verse_text: You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
day-0426.summary: The Lord reigns with righteousness and justice as the foundation of his throne. Fire, lightning, and his presence cause the earth to tremble and mountains to melt. The heavens declare his righteousness and all peoples see his glory. Those who love the Lord hate evil, and he preserves and delivers his saints from the wicked.

day-0907.key_verse_text: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
day-0907.summary: The passage describes the unity of the body of Christ, established through one Spirit, one Lord, and one God. Christ ascended and distributed gifts to people through apostles, prophets, evangelists, and teachers who build up the body. Members are called to walk worthily, speak truth in love, and put away falsehood, anger, and malice while showing kindness and forgiveness.

day-0893.key_verse_text: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
day-0893.summary: Paul expresses concern that the Corinthians might be deceived by false apostles preaching a different Jesus and spirit, just as the serpent deceived Eve. He defends his own apostolic authority through his sufferings and labors, and warns that Satan masquerades as an angel of light, so his servants also disguise themselves as righteous.

day-0722.key_verse_text: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”
day-0722.summary: The chief priests and elders deliver Jesus to Pilate, who questions him. Pilate offers to release either Jesus or Barabbas; the crowd demands Barabbas and Jesus's crucifixion. Pilate washes his hands and surrenders Jesus to be flogged. Soldiers mock Jesus with a scarlet robe and crown of thorns before leading him away to crucifixion.

day-0574.key_verse_text: Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no wrong. Do no violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Don’t shed innocent blood in this place.
day-0574.summary: King Zedekiah sends messengers to Jeremiah seeking divine intervention against Babylon's siege. Jeremiah declares the Lord will turn weapons against Judah, strike inhabitants with pestilence, and deliver survivors to Nebuchadnezzar. The Lord demands justice and righteousness from the royal house, warning that disobedience brings desolation and exile.

day-0500.key_verse_text: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
day-0500.summary: Everything operates within appointed seasons and times. God makes all things beautiful in their time and places eternity in human hearts, yet humans cannot comprehend God's complete work. All people and animals share the same fate, returning to dust, making human labor's profit unclear.

day-0057.key_verse_text: “You shall have no other gods before me.
day-0057.summary: God proclaims 10 commandments to the people, establishing requirements regarding worship, the Sabbath, family honor, and conduct toward others. The people witness thunder, lightning, and smoke on the mountain, then request Moses speak to them instead of God. Moses relays additional instructions about altars and offerings.

day-0131.key_verse_text: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?
day-0131.summary: The Lord delivers King Og of Bashan and his people into the hands of the Israelites, who conquer 60 fortified cities and take the land. The conquered territory is distributed among the tribes, with instructions given to Joshua. Moses requests permission to cross the Jordan but the Lord refuses, commanding him instead to view the land from Pisgah.

day-0205.key_verse_text: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that Yahweh will work for us, for there is no restraint on Yahweh to save by many or by few.”
day-0205.summary: Jonathan and his armor bearer attack a Philistine garrison, killing about 20 men and causing panic throughout the enemy camp. Saul's forces join the battle, and the Lord saves Israel that day. Later, Jonathan unknowingly breaks Saul's oath by eating honey, and though Saul condemns him to death, the people rescue Jonathan.

day-0279.key_verse_text: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh of Armies was with him.
day-0279.summary: The Philistines defeat Israel and kill Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa. Saul takes his own life rather than face capture. The Lord turns the kingdom over to David, whom all Israel anoints as king at Hebron. David captures Jerusalem and grows greater as the Lord remains with him. His mighty men, listed by name, fight alongside him.

day-0353.key_verse_text: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
day-0353.summary: A psalmist cries out to the Lord about prolonged suffering and enemies' triumph, then expresses trust in God's loving kindness and rejoices in salvation. The passage describes fools denying God and acting corruptly while the Lord observes humanity from heaven, ultimately protecting the righteous and promising restoration of Israel's fortunes.

day-0427.key_verse_text: Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
day-0427.summary: The Lord has accomplished marvelous deeds of salvation and revealed his righteousness to the nations, remembering his covenant faithfulness toward Israel. All creation is called to sing praises with instruments and joyful noise, as the Lord comes to judge the earth with righteousness and equity.

day-0501.key_verse_text: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.
day-0501.summary: The speaker observes oppression and futility in human labor and ambition, noting that companionship surpasses solitude. Proper reverence before God requires few words and fulfilled vows. Those who love wealth remain unsatisfied, while simple enjoyment of food and labor constitutes a gift from God.

day-0575.key_verse_text: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will raise to David a righteous Branch; and he will reign as king and deal wisely, and will execute justice and righteousness in the land. In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.
day-0575.summary: The Lord condemns the shepherds who scatter the flock and promises to gather the remnant and raise a righteous Branch from David who will reign with justice. The Lord denounces false prophets in Jerusalem and Samaria who speak lies and lead the people astray, declaring that authentic words from the Lord carry power like fire and a hammer.

day-0649.key_verse_text: Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
day-0649.summary: Joel receives a message from the Lord describing a devastating plague of locusts that strips the land bare, destroying crops, vineyards, and trees. The destruction cuts off offerings from the Lord's house, prompting priests and people to mourn and fast. The day of the Lord approaches as destruction from the Almighty.

day-0760.key_verse_text: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.
day-0760.summary: During the reign of Tiberius Caesar, John preaches baptism of repentance in the Jordan region. He instructs various crowds on righteous conduct, declares that a mightier one will baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire, and is later imprisoned by Herod. Jesus is baptized, the Holy Spirit descends upon him, and his genealogy traces back to Adam.

day-0723.key_verse_text: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
day-0723.summary: Simon of Cyrene carries Jesus's cross to Golgotha, where soldiers crucify him between 2 robbers. Passersby and leaders mock him; darkness covers the land. Jesus cries out in anguish, then dies. The temple veil tears, the earth shakes, and tombs open. A rich disciple buries Jesus in his own tomb. Chief priests request guards to secure it.

day-0058.key_verse_text: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
day-0058.summary: The Lord establishes ordinances governing Hebrew servants, including terms of service and freedom, protections for female servants, and penalties for various offenses including murder, assault, and cursing parents. Laws address proportional justice, animal liability, and property damage.

day-0863.key_verse_text: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
day-0863.summary: Paul expresses deep sorrow for Israel, acknowledging their privileges as God's chosen people yet explaining that God's word has not failed because true Israel consists of those called by God's promise, not merely by flesh, and that God's mercy, not human effort or desire, determines salvation.

day-0206.key_verse_text: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.
day-0206.summary: Samuel commands Saul to destroy the Amalekites completely, but Saul spares King Agag and the best livestock. Samuel confronts Saul, declaring that obedience surpasses sacrifice, and announces the Lord has rejected Saul from kingship. Samuel then executes Agag and ceases visiting Saul.

day-0132.key_verse_text: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—
day-0132.summary: Moses instructs Israel to obey the statutes and ordinances so they may possess the land the Lord gives them. He recounts how the Lord destroyed those who followed Baal Peor while the faithful remain alive, and describes the Lord's covenant, the ten commandments on stone tablets, and warnings against idolatry and covenant violation.

day-0878.key_verse_text: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord ’s death until he comes.
