day-0878.summary: Paul addresses head coverings during worship and proper observance of the Lord's Supper. Men and women have different customs regarding head covering. The Corinthians gather divisively, eating separately rather than sharing the meal together. Jesus instituted the bread and cup as a memorial of his death, and those partaking unworthily face judgment.

day-0280.key_verse_text: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
day-0280.summary: Mighty warriors from multiple tribes gather to David at Hebron with unified purpose to make him king over all Israel. After 3 days of celebration with abundant provisions, David consults leaders about retrieving the Lord's ark. During transport on a new cart, Uzza dies when touching the ark, causing David to fear and leave it at Obed-Edom's house instead.

day-0354.key_verse_text: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
day-0354.summary: The passage describes the character of one who dwells in the Lord's sanctuary: one who walks blamelessly, speaks truth, avoids slander, honors the faithful, keeps oaths, and refuses bribery. A speaker then expresses trust in God as refuge, declares the Lord as supreme good, and affirms that the Lord provides security, counsel, and eternal joy in divine presence.

day-0428.key_verse_text: Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
day-0428.summary: The Lord reigns supreme and sits enthroned among the cherubim, great in Zion and high above all peoples. The Lord established justice and righteousness, answering those who called upon him through history. All lands are called to shout for joy, serve with gladness, and enter the Lord's gates with thanksgiving, recognizing the Lord as God and creator.

day-0724.key_verse_text: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”Amen.
day-0724.summary: An angel announces Jesus' resurrection to 2 women at the tomb. Jesus appears to them and sends word to his disciples to meet him in Galilee. The 11 disciples encounter the risen Jesus on a mountain, where he declares his authority and commands them to make disciples of all nations, baptizing and teaching them.

day-0650.key_verse_text: It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be those who escape, as Yahweh has said, and among the remnant, those whom Yahweh calls.
day-0650.summary: A great army approaches on the day of the Lord, devastating the land like fire. The Lord calls the people to repent with fasting and weeping, and responds with mercy, restoring grain and wine. The Lord pours out the Spirit on all flesh, judges the nations in the valley of Jehoshaphat, and establishes Jerusalem as holy forever.

day-0834.key_verse_text: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”
day-0834.summary: Priests and Sadducees arrest Peter and John for proclaiming Jesus's resurrection. The next day, the council questions them about healing a crippled man. Peter declares salvation comes through Jesus's name alone. Though threatened, the apostles refuse to stop speaking, and believers share possessions communally while the apostles perform signs and wonders.

day-0207.key_verse_text: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
day-0207.summary: The Lord directs Samuel to anoint a new king from Jesse's sons in Bethlehem. After rejecting 7 of Jesse's older sons, Samuel anoints the youngest, David, and the Lord's Spirit comes upon him. Meanwhile, an evil spirit troubles Saul, and his servants bring David to play the harp and soothe him.

day-0502.key_verse_text: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
day-0502.summary: The Preacher observes that possessing wealth and honor without ability to enjoy them constitutes vanity and evil. He compares various conditions of life, concluding that a stillborn child fares better than one living long without satisfaction. Wisdom proves superior to folly, yet all humans face mortality and uncertainty about what truly benefits them in their fleeting existence.

day-0576.key_verse_text: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh. They will be my people, and I will be their God; for they will return to me with their whole heart.
day-0576.summary: The Lord shows Jeremiah 2 baskets of figs representing exiled captives and those remaining in Judah. The good figs symbolize captives whom the Lord will restore with transformed hearts to know him. The bad figs represent King Zedekiah and Jerusalem's remnant, whom the Lord will scatter among nations with sword, famine, and pestilence.

day-0981.key_verse_text: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
day-0981.summary: When the 7th seal opens, silence fills heaven. Seven angels receive trumpets and prepare to sound them. As they blow in sequence, catastrophic events unfold: fire and hail scorch the earth, a burning mountain falls into the sea, a bitter star poisons waters, and darkness covers the heavens. An eagle warns of 3 remaining trumpet blasts.

day-0849.key_verse_text: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
day-0849.summary: Paul and companions sail to Phoenicia, where disciples warn against going to Jerusalem. At Caesarea, prophet Agabus predicts Paul's arrest, but Paul resolves to die for Jesus. In Jerusalem, elders ask Paul to demonstrate his law-keeping. During temple purification, Asian Jews incite a riot, and Roman soldiers arrest Paul and carry him to the barracks.

day-0133.key_verse_text: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage. “You shall have no other gods before me.
day-0133.summary: Moses calls Israel to hear and observe the statutes and ordinances. The Lord speaks the 10 commandments from the mountain's fire, prohibiting other gods, idolatry, misuse of the Lord's name, and commanding Sabbath observance, honoring parents, and forbidding murder, adultery, theft, false testimony, and coveting. The Lord writes these words on 2 stone tablets and gives them to Moses.

day-0355.key_verse_text: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
day-0355.summary: A petitioner appeals to the Lord for justice, claiming innocence and faithfulness to God's ways while surrounded by violent enemies. The petitioner requests divine protection and deliverance, contrasting personal devotion with the wicked's earthly pursuits, and expresses confidence in ultimately beholding God's face in righteousness.

day-0281.key_verse_text: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
day-0281.summary: David establishes his kingdom with support from Tyre, defeats the Philistines through the Lord's guidance, and brings the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem with elaborate ceremony. Levites and priests are appointed to minister before the ark, and a psalm of thanksgiving is sung, celebrating the Lord's goodness and eternal kindness.

day-0059.key_verse_text: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.
day-0059.summary: The Lord establishes laws governing theft, property damage, and restitution. Regulations address stolen livestock, damaged goods, borrowed animals, and seduction. Prohibitions cover sorcery, bestiality, and false worship. Protections extend to aliens, widows, and the fatherless. Requirements include fair lending practices, timely offerings, and ritual holiness.

day-0429.key_verse_text: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
day-0429.summary: A speaker commits to living blamelessly and singing praises to the Lord, resolving to avoid vile things and evil deeds. The speaker will silence slanderers and reject the arrogant, instead favoring the faithful who walk in perfect ways. Deceivers and liars will not dwell in the speaker's house, and the wicked will be destroyed from the Lord's city.

day-0725.key_verse_text: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
day-0725.summary: John baptizes crowds in the wilderness, proclaiming a coming figure mightier than himself. Jesus arrives from Nazareth, receives baptism, and experiences the Spirit descending like a dove with a voice affirming his sonship. After 40 days in the wilderness, Jesus enters Galilee announcing God's Kingdom and calls Simon, Andrew, James, and John to follow him as fishers of men.

day-0967.key_verse_text: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
day-0967.summary: The author writes that Jesus Christ serves as an atoning sacrifice for sins and that knowing God is demonstrated through keeping his commandments. Loving one's brother indicates remaining in the light, while hating one's brother indicates darkness. The world and its desires pass away, but those who do God's will remain forever.

day-0503.key_verse_text: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
day-0503.summary: Wisdom brings understanding and favor, yet the wise and righteous face the same fate as the wicked. The speaker observes that humans cannot control their destiny or comprehend God's works. Since death ends all activity and memory, the living should pursue joy, work diligently, and recognize that wisdom surpasses strength, though outcomes remain uncertain.

day-0577.key_verse_text: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey Yahweh your God’s voice; then Yahweh will relent from the evil that he has pronounced against you.
day-0577.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to stand in the temple and warn Judah to amend their ways or face destruction. After Jeremiah delivers this message, priests and people seize him, but princes defend him based on his words and historical precedent. A protective official shields Jeremiah from death while another prophet, Uriah, is killed by the king for similar prophecy.

day-0820.key_verse_text: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
day-0820.summary: Jesus describes himself as the true vine and his Father as the farmer who removes unfruitful branches and prunes fruitful ones. Branches remaining in the vine bear much fruit, while those separated wither and burn. Remaining in Jesus and keeping his commandments allows believers to ask and receive, and they become his friends chosen to bear lasting fruit.

day-0805.key_verse_text: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
day-0805.summary: A crowd follows Jesus to Capernaum seeking him. Jesus declares himself the bread of life and explains that belief in him provides eternal life. Many disciples find his teaching difficult and leave, while the twelve remain, with Jesus noting that one among them is a devil.

day-0952.key_verse_text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
day-0952.summary: The passage exhorts believers to maintain brotherly love, show hospitality, honor marriage, and remain free from greed. Jesus Christ remains constant throughout all time. Believers are encouraged to avoid strange teachings, offer praise to God, do good works, and obey their leaders. The Lord God of peace strengthens believers to accomplish his will.

day-0282.key_verse_text: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
day-0282.summary: David proposes building a house for the Lord's ark, but the Lord sends word through Nathan that David's son will build the temple instead and his throne will be established forever. David responds with prayer and praise, then conquers surrounding nations and establishes his kingdom with justice and righteousness.

day-0060.key_verse_text: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
day-0060.summary: God establishes laws regarding honesty, justice, and compassion. The Lord commands observance of feasts, proper sacrifice, and rest on the seventh day. God promises to send an angel to guide the people into the prepared land, drive out the inhabitants, and bless them if they obey and avoid serving other gods.

day-0134.key_verse_text: Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one. You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
day-0134.summary: The Lord commands Israel to love him with complete devotion and to teach these commandments to children through constant conversation and visible reminders. When the Lord brings Israel into a prosperous land, the people must remember their deliverance from Egypt, avoid other gods, and obey the Lord's statutes to possess the promised land.

day-0651.key_verse_text: He said: “Yahweh will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and the top of Carmel will wither.”
day-0651.summary: Amos, a herdsman from Tekoa, delivers the Lord's pronouncements against Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, Ammon, and Moab for their transgressions, each facing fire and destruction. The Lord then turns against Judah for rejecting his law and Israel for oppressing the poor and silencing prophets, promising judgment where none can escape.

day-0356.key_verse_text: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
day-0356.summary: The Lord descends with cosmic power to rescue the speaker from enemies and death, riding on cherubs amid thunder, fire, and darkness. The speaker pursues and defeats foes, attributes victory to the Lord's strength and favor, and declares the Lord's perfect ways and shield to all who seek refuge.

day-0430.key_verse_text: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.
day-0430.summary: A suffering person cries out to the Lord for help, describing physical and emotional anguish while enemies mock. The Lord endures forever and will show mercy to Zion, responding to the destitute and freeing prisoners so nations declare the Lord's name. Though creation perishes, the Lord remains unchanging and eternal.

day-0504.key_verse_text: Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart cheer you in the days of your youth, and walk in the ways of your heart, and in the sight of your eyes; but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.
day-0504.summary: Small foolishness undermines great wisdom as dead flies spoil perfume. The wise and foolish differ in their hearts and conduct. Folly often receives honor while the worthy sit low. Careful work succeeds where careless effort fails. Young people rejoice in their days yet face God's judgment for all their actions.

day-0652.key_verse_text: Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
day-0652.summary: The Lord announces judgment against Israel for their sins despite being chosen above all families. Through a series of rhetorical questions and declarations, the Lord establishes that consequences follow actions naturally. Israel faces invasion and destruction for hoarding wealth and oppressing the poor. Multiple plagues and hardships have failed to turn them back to the Lord.

day-0578.key_verse_text: ‘I have made the earth, the men, and the animals that are on the surface of the earth by my great power and by my outstretched arm. I give it to whom it seems right to me.
day-0578.summary: Jeremiah receives a command to wear bonds and send them to neighboring kings, declaring that the Lord has given all lands to Nebuchadnezzar and will punish nations refusing to serve him. The prophet Hananiah contradicts this, promising deliverance within 2 years, but the Lord tells Jeremiah that Hananiah speaks falsely and will die that year, which occurs.

day-0726.key_verse_text: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
day-0726.summary: Jesus teaches in the Capernaum synagogue with authority, casts out an unclean spirit, and heals Simon's mother-in-law and many others. He prays alone early morning, then travels through Galilee preaching and casting out demons. A leper approaches and Jesus heals him, instructing him to tell no one but show himself to the priest.

day-0208.key_verse_text: and that all this assembly may know that Yahweh doesn’t save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh’s, and he will give you into our hand.”
day-0208.summary: The Philistines and Israel face each other across a valley. Goliath, a massive Philistine champion, challenges Israel to single combat for 40 days. David arrives with provisions, hears Goliath's defiance, and volunteers to fight. Refusing armor, David strikes Goliath with a stone from his sling, kills him, and cuts off his head. The Philistines flee, and Israel pursues them.

day-0923.key_verse_text: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God ’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first, then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.
day-0923.summary: The passage instructs believers to pursue sanctification by abstaining from sexual immorality and treating others with honor. It describes the Lord's descent from heaven with a shout and God's trumpet, when the dead in Christ rise first, followed by the living caught up together in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air forever.

day-0790.key_verse_text: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”
day-0790.summary: Jesus prays in agony on the Mount of Olives, submitting to the Father's will despite his distress. Judas betrays him with a kiss, and soldiers arrest him. Peter denies knowing Jesus three times. The council interrogates Jesus about his identity as the Christ and Son of God.

day-0209.key_verse_text: David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahweh was with him.
day-0209.summary: Jonathan and David form a deep covenant of love, but Saul grows jealous of David's military success and popularity. Saul repeatedly attempts to kill David, including throwing a spear at him twice. David marries Saul's daughter Michal and escapes to Samuel at Ramah, where God's Spirit causes Saul and his messengers to prophesy instead of capturing David.

day-0135.key_verse_text: Know therefore that Yahweh your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
day-0135.summary: The Lord delivers 7 nations before Israel and commands their complete destruction without covenants or intermarriage, as Israel is a holy people chosen for the Lord's possession. The Lord promises blessings, protection from disease, and military victory over all enemies if the people obey the commandments and avoid idolatry.

day-0357.key_verse_text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
day-0357.summary: The heavens continuously declare God's glory through their ceaseless display, with the sun traversing the sky in strength. The Lord's law, covenant, precepts, and commandments are perfect and sure, more desirable than gold and sweeter than honey, offering restoration and wisdom to those who keep them.

day-0283.key_verse_text: Now set your heart and your soul to follow Yahweh your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God, to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for Yahweh’s name.”
day-0283.summary: David's military campaigns expand his kingdom, but Satan incites him to census Israel, bringing plague. After David repents and builds an altar, the Lord designates the site for the temple. David then commands Solomon to construct the sanctuary, provides abundant materials and workers, and charges the princes to support the building project.

day-0431.key_verse_text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
day-0431.summary: The Lord forgives sins, heals diseases, and redeems lives from destruction, crowning the faithful with loving kindness and mercy. The Lord executes justice for the oppressed, removes transgressions completely, and shows compassion like a father to those who fear him. The Lord's kingdom rules over all creation.

day-0505.key_verse_text: This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man. For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
day-0505.summary: The Preacher urges remembrance of the Creator in youth before old age arrives with its physical decline and approach to death. After describing mortality's inevitability, the Preacher concludes that fearing God and keeping his commandments constitutes humanity's whole duty, since God judges all works and hidden things.

day-0061.key_verse_text: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”
day-0061.summary: Moses conveys the Lord's words to the people, who pledge obedience. Moses builds an altar with 12 pillars, offers sacrifices, and sprinkles blood on both the altar and the people to ratify the covenant. Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and 70 elders ascend the mountain and see God. Moses then enters the cloud for 40 days to receive the stone tablets.

day-0579.key_verse_text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
day-0579.summary: Jeremiah sends a letter to the captives in Babylon instructing them to build houses, plant gardens, and seek the city's peace while the Lord works toward their restoration after 70 years. The Lord warns against false prophets and promises to gather the exiles back, while condemning those in Jerusalem who rejected his messengers.

day-0727.key_verse_text: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
day-0727.summary: Jesus heals a paralyzed man in Capernaum, forgiving his sins and demonstrating authority to do so. He calls Levi to follow him and eats with tax collectors and sinners. When questioned about fasting and Sabbath practices, Jesus explains that the Sabbath exists for humanity's benefit, not the reverse.

day-0653.key_verse_text: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
day-0653.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment on Israel for perverting justice and oppressing the poor. The nation faces devastation and captivity for its sins. The Lord rejects its religious observances and calls instead for justice to flow like rivers and righteousness like a mighty stream.

day-0776.key_verse_text: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
day-0776.summary: Jesus casts out a mute demon, prompting accusations and demands for signs. He responds with parables about divided kingdoms and spiritual emptiness, then pronounces woes against Pharisees and lawyers for their hypocrisy, external righteousness, and obstruction of knowledge. The religious leaders grow angry and seek to trap him.

day-0908.key_verse_text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
day-0908.summary: Believers are called to imitate God by walking in love as Christ loved and sacrificed himself. Sexual immorality and covetousness have no place among saints, for such practices exclude people from God's kingdom. Those transformed from darkness into light demonstrate the Spirit's fruit through goodness, righteousness, and truth while avoiding fellowship with darkness.

day-0894.key_verse_text: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
day-0894.summary: A man in Christ experiences visions and heavenly revelations, yet receives a thorn in the flesh to prevent excessive exaltation. The Lord responds that grace suffices and power perfects itself in weakness. The speaker glories in weaknesses so Christ's power rests upon him, taking pleasure in afflictions for Christ's sake.

day-0062.key_verse_text: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
day-0062.summary: The Lord instructs Moses to collect offerings from the willing-hearted Israelites, including gold, silver, bronze, fine fabrics, and other materials. These items will be used to construct a sanctuary where the Lord dwells among the people, built according to the pattern shown to Moses.

day-0761.key_verse_text: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed, and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”
day-0761.summary: Jesus, filled with the Holy Spirit, endures 40 days of temptation in the wilderness, resisting the devil's offers through Scripture. He returns to Galilee in power and teaches in synagogues. In Nazareth, he reads Isaiah's prophecy about his anointed mission, declaring its fulfillment. The townspeople initially marvel but grow angry and attempt to kill him; he escapes unharmed.

day-0284.key_verse_text: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;
day-0284.summary: David, now old, establishes Solomon as king and organizes 38,000 Levites by their ancestral lines into divisions for temple service. The Levites oversee the Lord's house, serve as officers and judges, guard doorways, and lead musical praise. Priests are assigned to rotating service divisions, and musicians from Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun's families are appointed to prophesy with instruments.

day-0136.key_verse_text: He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of Yahweh’s mouth.
day-0136.summary: The Lord leads the people through 40 years of wilderness, humbling and testing them with hunger before providing manna, teaching that life depends on the Lord's word. The Lord brings them into a fertile land of abundance, warning against forgetting the Lord's commandments when prosperity comes, lest they perish like other nations.

day-0210.key_verse_text: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘Yahweh is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.
day-0210.summary: David flees to Jonathan and expresses fear for his life. Jonathan devises a plan using arrows to signal whether Saul intends David harm. After Saul's anger confirms the danger, Jonathan meets David in the field and they covenant together, then part in peace.

day-0358.key_verse_text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
day-0358.summary: The psalmist petitions the Lord to answer in times of trouble, send help from the sanctuary, and grant the heart's desire. The Lord saves the anointed and answers from holy heaven. Those trusting in chariots and horses fall, but those trusting in the Lord's name rise and stand upright.

day-0506.key_verse_text: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; for your love is better than wine.
day-0506.summary: A beloved expresses longing for her lover, praising his fragrance and love above wine. The lover compliments her beauty, comparing her to a steed in Pharaoh's chariots. Friends offer to adorn her with gold and silver. The beloved describes her lover as myrrh and henna blossoms, while the lover admires her eyes like doves.

day-0432.key_verse_text: Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
day-0432.summary: The Lord is clothed in honor and majesty, stretching out the heavens and establishing the earth's foundations. The Lord provides water, vegetation, and sustenance for all creatures, from wild animals to humans. The Lord's works are innumerable and filled with wisdom, and all living things depend on the Lord's provision for their survival.

day-0580.key_verse_text: “You shall be my people, and I will be your God.
day-0580.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to record a message of restoration for Israel and Judah. Though the people currently experience great distress and wounds from their sins, the Lord promises to reverse their captivity, heal them, multiply their descendants, and establish a covenant relationship with them as their God.

day-0654.key_verse_text: Woe to those who are at ease in Zion, and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria, the notable men of the chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come!
day-0654.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment on the complacent leaders of Israel who luxuriate in ease while ignoring injustice. Through visions of locusts and fire, the Lord shows Amos impending destruction. When the priest Amaziah opposes Amos's prophecies, Amos declares his divine calling and announces the Lord's judgment against Amaziah and exile for Israel.

day-0728.key_verse_text: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
day-0728.summary: Jesus heals a man's withered hand on the Sabbath in the synagogue, angering the Pharisees who plot his destruction. Large crowds from various regions follow him to the sea seeking healing. Jesus then ascends a mountain and appoints 12 disciples, naming them and granting them authority to preach and cast out demons.

day-0879.key_verse_text: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
day-0879.summary: The Spirit distributes various gifts to believers for the common good. Just as a body has many members with different functions, Christ's body comprises many members with different roles. God arranges each member as desired, ensuring no division and mutual care among all parts.

day-0864.key_verse_text: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.
day-0864.summary: Paul expresses his desire for Israel's salvation, noting their zeal for God lacks knowledge. They seek their own righteousness rather than submitting to God's righteousness. Christ fulfills the law for all who believe. Salvation comes through confessing Jesus as Lord and believing God raised him from the dead. Faith comes by hearing the word of God.

day-0211.key_verse_text: Everyone who was in distress, everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was discontented gathered themselves to him; and he became captain over them. There were with him about four hundred men.
day-0211.summary: David visits the priest Ahimelech at Nob, receives holy bread and Goliath's sword, then flees to Gath and feigns madness. He escapes to Adullam's cave where 400 distressed men gather around him. Saul learns of David's visit through Doeg the Edomite and orders the priests' massacre, killing 85 priests and destroying Nob. Abiathar alone escapes and joins David.

day-0359.key_verse_text: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
day-0359.summary: The king rejoices in the Lord's strength and salvation, receiving his heart's desire, a crown, and eternal life. The Lord blesses him with honor, majesty, and joy. Enemies who plot evil against the Lord face destruction through divine wrath, while the king trusts in the Lord's loving kindness and remains unmoved.

day-0433.key_verse_text: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.
day-0433.summary: The psalmist calls the people to give thanks to the Lord and recall his covenant with Abraham and his mighty deeds throughout history, from Joseph's deliverance through the plagues in Egypt to the exodus and settlement in Canaan, all so the people might keep his statutes and laws.

day-0507.key_verse_text: He brought me to the banquet hall. His banner over me is love.
day-0507.summary: The beloved describes herself humbly while the lover praises her beauty and brings her to a banquet hall where his love covers her. He invites her to arise and come away as spring arrives, and she declares her devotion to him, asking him to return like a young deer on the mountains.

day-0285.key_verse_text: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in Yahweh’s house.
day-0285.summary: The passage lists divisions of doorkeepers from Korahite and Merarite families assigned to gates of the Lord's house, Levites appointed over treasuries and dedicated items, 12 military commanders each leading 24,000 troops rotating monthly, tribal leaders, and officials overseeing the king's property, treasures, and agricultural resources.

day-0655.key_verse_text: I will plant them on their land, and they will no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them,” says Yahweh your God.
day-0655.summary: The Lord shows Amos a basket of summer fruit, signifying the end of Israel. Judgment comes through famine, darkness, and the sword for those who exploit the poor and abandon God's word. Yet the Lord promises restoration: the fallen tent of David rises again, and the people return to plant vineyards and dwell securely on their land forever.

day-0581.key_verse_text: “But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says Yahweh: “I will put my law in their inward parts, and I will write it in their heart. I will be their God, and they shall be my people. They will no longer each teach his neighbor, and every man teach his brother, saying, ‘Know Yahweh;’ for they will all know me, from their least to their greatest,” says Yahweh, “for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.”
day-0581.summary: The Lord promises to restore Israel and Judah after their exile, gathering them from distant lands and leading them home with compassion. The Lord will establish a new covenant, writing the law on their hearts so all know the Lord directly, and will forgive their iniquities completely. Jerusalem will be rebuilt as a holy city.

day-0137.key_verse_text: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
day-0137.summary: Moses tells Israel that the Lord goes before them as a devouring fire to destroy the nations they will dispossess, not because of their righteousness but because of those nations' wickedness and to fulfill the Lord's covenant with their ancestors. Moses recounts Israel's repeated rebellion in the wilderness, the golden calf incident, and his intercession that saved them from destruction.

day-0982.key_verse_text: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can ’t see, hear, or walk.
day-0982.summary: The fifth angel sounds and releases locusts from the abyss to torment those without God's seal for 5 months. The sixth angel frees 4 bound angels at the Euphrates, releasing 200 million horsemen who kill one third of mankind. The survivors refuse to repent of idolatry, murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.

day-0063.key_verse_text: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
day-0063.summary: The Lord instructs the construction of the tabernacle with 10 linen curtains embroidered with cherubim, 11 goat-hair curtains, acacia boards with silver sockets, and gold-overlaid bars. A veil separates the holy place from the most holy place. The altar, courtyard, and furnishings follow specific dimensions and materials. Aaron and his sons maintain the lamp continually before the Lord.

day-0835.key_verse_text: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.
day-0835.summary: Ananias and Sapphira sell property but withhold part of the proceeds; Peter exposes their deception and both fall dead. The apostles perform many signs and wonders, attracting multitudes. Authorities arrest them, but an angel frees them. Peter declares the apostles must obey God rather than men. Gamaliel advises restraint, and the council releases them after beating them.

day-0850.key_verse_text: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.
day-0850.summary: A man addresses a crowd in Hebrew, recounting his former persecution of believers, his encounter with Jesus on the Damascus road, his commissioning as a witness, and his subsequent vision directing him to the Gentiles. The crowd reacts violently until Roman officials intervene, discovering his citizenship and arranging a council hearing.

day-0212.key_verse_text: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand will not be on you.
day-0212.summary: David defeats Philistines at Keilah but flees when Saul pursues him. Jonathan encourages David in the wilderness while Ziphites betray his location to Saul. Saul nearly captures David at Maon but abandons the pursuit when Philistines attack. Later, David spares Saul's life in a cave, convincing Saul of his innocence and loyalty.

day-0729.key_verse_text: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”
day-0729.summary: A crowd gathers so densely that Jesus cannot eat. His friends think him insane, and scribes accuse him of casting out demons by Satan's power. Jesus responds with parables about divided kingdoms and explains that blasphemy against the Holy Spirit brings eternal condemnation. When his mother and brothers arrive, he identifies those doing God's will as his true family.

day-0286.key_verse_text: Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and on the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, Yahweh, and you are exalted as head above all. Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all! Now therefore, our God, we thank you and praise your glorious name.
day-0286.summary: David gathers Israel's leaders and announces that the Lord has chosen Solomon to build the temple instead of him. David provides Solomon with detailed architectural plans and materials, then calls the assembly to contribute. The princes and people offer willingly with rejoicing, and David blesses the Lord before anointing Solomon as king.

day-0360.key_verse_text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
day-0360.summary: A sufferer cries out to God in anguish, describing physical torment and mockery from enemies while recalling God's faithfulness to ancestors. The speaker calls for deliverance and vows to praise God in the assembly, declaring that the Lord's dominion extends to all nations and future generations.

day-0138.key_verse_text: Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul. You shall bind them for a sign on your hand, and they shall be for frontlets between your eyes. You shall teach them to your children, talking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.
day-0138.summary: Moses commands the people to love the Lord and keep his commandments, recounting his mighty deeds in Egypt and the wilderness. The Lord promises rain and prosperity if the people obey, but warns of drought and destruction if they turn to other gods. The people face a choice between blessing and curse.

day-0750.key_verse_text: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.
day-0750.summary: The chief priests plot to arrest Jesus during Passover. A woman anoints him with costly perfume; Jesus defends her act as preparation for his burial. Judas agrees to betray him for money. At the Passover meal, Jesus announces his betrayal, then breaks bread and shares wine, declaring them his body and blood of the new covenant poured out for many.

day-0508.key_verse_text: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
day-0508.summary: A woman searches for her beloved at night and through the city streets until finding him and bringing him to her mother's house. Solomon arrives in a grand carriage, and the man praises the woman's beauty in elaborate detail, declaring her entirely beautiful with no flaw, and inviting her to come away with him.

day-0434.key_verse_text: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
day-0434.summary: The Lord's loving kindness endures forever, yet the people repeatedly sin and rebel despite witnessing mighty acts in Egypt and the wilderness. Though the Lord grows angry and allows enemies to oppress them, the Lord repeatedly rescues them and remembers the covenant, moved by their cries.

day-0582.key_verse_text: “Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard for me?
day-0582.summary: During Jerusalem's siege, Jeremiah buys a field in Anathoth as the Lord commands, completing the transaction with witnesses and a sealed deed. After delivering the documents to Baruch, Jeremiah prays, acknowledging the Lord's power. The Lord responds, affirming the city's fall to Babylon while promising future restoration, covenant renewal, and the resumption of land purchases throughout Judah.

day-0968.key_verse_text: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
day-0968.summary: The Father's great love makes believers children of God, though the world does not recognize them because it did not know him. When Jesus is revealed, believers will be like him. Those born of God do not sin and are distinguished by righteousness and love for one another, while those who sin belong to the devil.

day-0656.key_verse_text: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.
day-0656.summary: Obadiah receives a vision declaring the Lord's judgment against Edom for violence toward Jacob and pride in its mountain stronghold. The Lord promises to humble Edom's wise men and mighty warriors, while those who escape on Mount Zion will possess Edom's territory and the kingdom belongs to the Lord.

day-0821.key_verse_text: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
day-0821.summary: Jesus prepares his disciples for persecution and separation, explaining that his departure enables the Counselor to come and convict the world. Though sorrow will precede joy, the disciples will receive what they ask in his name. Jesus has overcome the world and offers peace amid worldly trouble.

day-0065.key_verse_text: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
day-0065.summary: The Lord prescribes detailed instructions for consecrating Aaron and his sons as priests through washing, clothing, anointing, and sacrificial offerings. The Lord declares intention to dwell among the children of Israel and establishes perpetual daily burnt offerings at the Tent of Meeting.

day-0953.key_verse_text: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
day-0953.summary: James writes to the dispersed believers that testing of faith produces endurance, and those lacking wisdom should ask God in faith. God gives good gifts from above, and the implanted word saves souls. True religion involves bridle of the tongue, care for the fatherless and widows, and remaining unstained by the world.

day-0064.key_verse_text: Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before Yahweh continually.
day-0064.summary: The Lord commands that Aaron and his sons be set apart as priests, wearing specially crafted holy garments including an ephod, breastplate, robe, turban, and sash made from gold, fine linen, and colored threads. The breastplate bears 12 stones engraved with the names of Israel's tribes, which Aaron carries on his heart before the Lord continually.

day-0139.key_verse_text: Whatever thing I command you, that you shall observe to do. You shall not add to it, nor take away from it.
day-0139.summary: The Lord commands the people to destroy all pagan worship sites and bring offerings only to the place the Lord chooses. Sacrifices, tithes, and vows belong at that central location where the people rejoice before the Lord. Blood must not be eaten. The people are warned against imitating the detestable practices of the nations they dispossess.

day-0361.key_verse_text: Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
day-0361.summary: The Lord shepherds and provides abundantly for those in his care, leading them through green pastures and still waters, restoring their souls and guiding them in righteousness. Even in dark valleys, the Lord's presence brings comfort. The Lord prepares provision and blessing, and goodness and loving kindness pursue the faithful throughout their days.

day-0213.key_verse_text: David said to Abigail, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!
day-0213.summary: Samuel dies and is buried. David learns that wealthy Nabal is shearing sheep and sends messengers requesting provisions, but Nabal refuses and insults them. David prepares to attack, but Abigail intercepts him with gifts and persuasion, preventing bloodshed. The Lord strikes Nabal dead days later, and David takes Abigail as his wife.

day-0287.key_verse_text: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”
day-0287.summary: Solomon becomes king with the Lord's favor and requests wisdom to judge his people. The Lord grants him wisdom along with riches and honor. Solomon then organizes labor and materials to build the Lord's house in Jerusalem, with Huram of Tyre providing skilled workers and cedar. Solomon constructs the temple with gold-overlaid chambers, cherubim, pillars, bronze altar, and various vessels.

day-0435.key_verse_text: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
day-0435.summary: The Lord's loving kindness endures forever. Those redeemed from adversity cry out in their troubles, and the Lord delivers them from distress, leading them to safety. The Lord breaks chains, heals the sick, calms storms, and transforms wastelands into fertile ground. The Lord exalts the humble and humbles the proud.

day-0509.key_verse_text: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies. Lover
day-0509.summary: The beloved enters the garden and invites friends to celebrate. The lover awakens to knocking but hesitates to open; when she does, the beloved has departed. She searches the city, is beaten by watchmen, and describes the beloved's beauty to the daughters of Jerusalem. The beloved affirms mutual belonging and praises the lover's beauty.

day-0583.key_verse_text: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
day-0583.summary: The Lord speaks to Jeremiah while imprisoned, promising to answer those who call and reveal hidden things. The Lord declares plans to heal Judah and Israel, restore their fortunes, cleanse them from iniquity, and make Jerusalem a place of joy and praise among nations. Shepherds will again tend flocks throughout the land, and a righteous Branch will execute justice.

day-0731.key_verse_text: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.
day-0731.summary: Jesus teaches through parables about light, seeds, and the kingdom of God, explaining that hidden things become known and that faith grows like a mustard seed. Later, during a storm on the sea, Jesus calms the wind and waves, prompting the disciples to marvel at his authority over nature.

day-0791.key_verse_text: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.
day-0791.summary: The chief priests bring Jesus before Pilate, accusing him of perverting the nation and claiming kingship. Pilate finds no basis for charges and sends Jesus to Herod, who mocks him and returns him. When Pilate offers to release Jesus or Barabbas, the crowd demands Barabbas and Jesus's crucifixion. Pilate grants their request.

day-0938.key_verse_text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men, instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;
day-0938.summary: Paul instructs Titus to teach sound doctrine to various groups: older men and women, younger wives and men, and servants. Each group receives specific guidance for godly living. The grace of God appears, bringing salvation and instructing people to deny ungodliness and live soberly and righteously.

day-0924.key_verse_text: Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
day-0924.summary: The Lord's day comes unexpectedly like a thief in the night, bringing sudden destruction on those unprepared. Believers, however, belong to the day and light, so they remain vigilant and sober, equipped with faith, love, and hope of salvation through Jesus Christ, who died so all might live with him.

day-0066.key_verse_text: “Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.
day-0066.summary: The Lord instructs Moses to construct an incense altar, establish a census tax for atonement, create a bronze basin for priestly washing, and prepare holy anointing oil and incense. The Lord appoints Bezalel and Oholiab to oversee the work and commands Israel to observe the Sabbath as an eternal sign of sanctification before giving Moses the stone tablets.

day-0140.key_verse_text: You shall walk after Yahweh your God, fear him, keep his commandments, and obey his voice. You shall serve him, and cling to him.
day-0140.summary: A prophet or dreamer who performs signs but urges worship of other gods must be rejected and executed, as the Lord tests loyalty. Close relatives and entire cities that promote idolatry face the same judgment. The Lord demands exclusive devotion and obedience to his commandments.

day-0730.key_verse_text: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”
day-0730.summary: Jesus teaches a large crowd by the sea using a parable about a farmer sowing seed. The seed falls on different types of ground, producing varying results. Jesus later explains that the seed represents God's word, and the different soils represent how different people receive and respond to it.

day-0362.key_verse_text: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
day-0362.summary: The Lord owns the earth and all its inhabitants, having established it upon the seas. Those with clean hands and pure hearts may ascend the Lord's hill and stand in his holy place, receiving blessing and righteousness. The King of glory, the Lord mighty in battle, enters through everlasting gates.

day-0436.key_verse_text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
day-0436.summary: The psalmist declares a steadfast heart and commits to singing praises to the Lord among the nations, celebrating the Lord's great loving kindness and faithfulness. God speaks from the sanctuary, claiming dominion over various territories, and the psalmist appeals for divine help against enemies.

day-0657.key_verse_text: But Jonah rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid its fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of Yahweh.
day-0657.summary: The Lord commands Jonah to preach against Nineveh, but Jonah flees by ship to Tarshish. A great storm strikes, and the terrified sailors cast lots, discovering Jonah is responsible. After Jonah identifies himself as a Hebrew who fears the Lord, the sailors throw him overboard. The sea calms, and the Lord prepares a great fish to swallow Jonah.

day-0510.key_verse_text: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned. Brothers
day-0510.summary: The beloved describes the lover's physical beauty in elaborate detail, and the lover expresses devotion and desire. The beloved then reflects on love's power to overcome all obstacles, describing it as stronger than death itself, before calling the lover to depart swiftly.

day-0584.key_verse_text: therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Jonadab the son of Rechab will not lack a man to stand before me forever.’”
day-0584.summary: Jeremiah receives the Lord's word concerning Jerusalem's siege and Zedekiah's fate. The Lord condemns Judah's leaders for breaking their covenant to free Hebrew servants, pronouncing judgment through sword, pestilence, and famine. By contrast, the Rechabites' obedience to their ancestor Jonadab's commands earns the Lord's promise of perpetual descendants.

day-0214.key_verse_text: Yahweh will give to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed.
day-0214.summary: The Ziphites report David's location to Saul, who pursues him with 3,000 men. David and Abishai infiltrate Saul's camp at night and take his spear and water jar without harming him. David then calls out to Saul from a distance, proving he could have killed him but refused. Saul acknowledges his wrongdoing and returns home.

day-0658.key_verse_text: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”
day-0658.summary: Jonah prays from inside the fish, recounting his distress in the depths and the Lord's deliverance of his life from the pit. He declares his intention to offer thanksgiving and fulfill his vows, affirming that salvation belongs to the Lord. The Lord then commands the fish to vomit Jonah onto dry land.

day-0909.key_verse_text: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
day-0909.summary: Children obey their parents in the Lord, and fathers nurture their children without provoking them. Servants obey masters as serving Christ, while masters treat servants justly. The Lord calls believers to put on the full armor of God to stand against spiritual forces of darkness, taking up truth, righteousness, faith, salvation, and the word of God through constant prayer.

day-0288.key_verse_text: if my people who are called by my name will humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
day-0288.summary: Solomon completes the temple, brings the ark into the inner sanctuary, and dedicates the house with sacrifices and music. The Lord's glory fills the building. Solomon prays for the Lord to hear prayers made toward this place, and the Lord appears to him, promising to hear and forgive if the people humble themselves and turn from wickedness.

day-0777.key_verse_text: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”
day-0777.summary: Jesus warns his disciples against the hypocrisy of the Pharisees and assures them that hidden things will be revealed. He instructs them not to fear those who kill the body, emphasizes God's care for sparrows and humans, and teaches that life consists not of possessions but of seeking God's Kingdom and giving to the needy.

day-0762.key_verse_text: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”
day-0762.summary: Jesus teaches in Capernaum's synagogue with authority, casting out a demon and healing Simon's mother-in-law. At sunset, crowds bring the sick and demon-possessed, and Jesus heals them all. The next morning, though the multitudes seek him, Jesus departs to preach the good news of God's Kingdom in other cities.

day-0895.key_verse_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.
day-0895.summary: Paul announces his third visit and warns those who have sinned that he will not spare them, seeking proof that Christ speaks through him with power. He urges the Corinthians to examine themselves and test whether Jesus Christ dwells in them, then closes with greetings and a benediction invoking grace, love, and fellowship.

day-0141.key_verse_text: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to your needy, and to your poor, in your land.
day-0141.summary: The Lord establishes dietary laws distinguishing clean from unclean animals, requires tithes and firstborn offerings at the chosen place, mandates debt cancellation every 7 years, commands generosity toward the poor and enslaved, and prescribes regulations for releasing Hebrew servants and dedicating firstborn livestock.

day-0067.key_verse_text: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!” All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
day-0067.summary: The people convince Aaron to fashion a golden calf for worship while Moses receives the covenant tablets. The Lord commands Moses to descend, revealing the corruption below. Moses intercedes for the people, the Lord relents, and Moses descends to destroy the tablets and calf, ordering the Levites to execute the unfaithful.

day-0732.key_verse_text: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”
day-0732.summary: Jesus encounters a demon-possessed man in the Gadarenes region. After casting out the demons into a nearby pig herd, the man sits clothed and in his right mind. Jesus directs him to return home and tell his friends what the Lord has done, and the man proclaims these things throughout Decapolis.

day-0215.key_verse_text: Then Saul said to his servants, “Seek for me a woman who has a familiar spirit, that I may go to her and inquire of her.” His servants said to him, “Behold, there is a woman who has a familiar spirit at Endor.”
day-0215.summary: David flees to the Philistines and settles in Ziklag for 16 months, raiding neighboring peoples while deceiving King Achish. When the Philistines prepare for war against Israel, Saul grows fearful and consults a medium at Endor, who summons Samuel's spirit. Samuel declares that the Lord has abandoned Saul and will deliver Israel to the Philistines.

day-0363.key_verse_text: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
day-0363.summary: The speaker lifts his soul to the Lord, requesting guidance in truth and paths while asking the Lord to remember mercy rather than past sins. The Lord instructs the humble and guides those who fear him, showing them his covenant and keeping their feet from nets of trouble.

day-0289.key_verse_text: Blessed be Yahweh your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for Yahweh your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”
day-0289.summary: Solomon completes construction projects across his kingdom, establishes religious observances, and undertakes maritime trade. The queen of Sheba visits to test his wisdom, witnesses his wealth and splendor, and praises the Lord for establishing him as king. Solomon accumulates vast riches, exceeding all other kings in wealth and wisdom, and reigns forty years before his son Rehoboam succeeds him.

day-0437.key_verse_text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
day-0437.summary: A speaker calls on God to hear complaints against enemies who speak lies and hatred without cause, then pronounces curses upon them before describing personal suffering and appealing to the Lord for deliverance, concluding that the Lord stands beside the needy to save them from their judges.

day-0511.key_verse_text: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
day-0511.summary: Isaiah receives a vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem, declaring that the Lord's people have rebelled despite being nourished. The Lord rejects their sacrifices and prayers because of their injustice and bloodshed, calling them to cease evil and seek justice. The Lord offers forgiveness if they repent, but promises destruction to those who refuse and rebel.

day-0585.key_verse_text: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I intend to do to them, that they may each return from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.”
day-0585.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to write divine words on a scroll so Judah might repent. Baruch reads the scroll publicly, then to the princes, who warn Jeremiah and Baruch to hide. King Jehoiakim burns the scroll in defiance. The Lord orders Jeremiah to write it again, adding more words, while pronouncing judgment on the king.

day-0733.key_verse_text: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”
day-0733.summary: Jesus crosses the sea and encounters Jairus, a synagogue ruler whose daughter is dying. On the way to help her, a woman with a 12-year blood discharge touches Jesus' clothes and is healed. Jesus later reaches Jairus' house, where he raises the dead girl by taking her hand and speaking to her.

day-0659.key_verse_text: Shouldn’t I be concerned for Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred twenty thousand persons who can’t discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also many animals?”
day-0659.summary: The Lord commands Jonah to preach judgment to Nineveh. The city repents, and the Lord relents from destruction. Jonah grows angry at this mercy. The Lord causes a vine to shade Jonah, then destroys it, using the experience to question Jonah's selective concern for a plant while opposing compassion for 120,000 people and animals.

day-0880.key_verse_text: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
day-0880.summary: Love surpasses all spiritual gifts and accomplishments, remaining patient, kind, and truthful while bearing all things. Without love, eloquence, prophecy, knowledge, faith, and sacrifice amount to nothing. Love never fails, unlike temporary gifts, and stands as the greatest of the 3 enduring virtues.

day-0871.key_verse_text: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
day-0871.summary: Paul came to the Corinthians not with eloquent speech but with a focus on Jesus Christ crucified, speaking through the Spirit's power rather than human wisdom. The Lord's hidden wisdom, revealed through the Spirit, surpasses earthly understanding and remains foolishness to the natural mind, yet those who are spiritual discern all things.

day-0865.key_verse_text: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
day-0865.summary: God has not rejected Israel but preserves a remnant chosen by grace. Though some branches were broken off due to unbelief, Gentiles are grafted in, yet natural branches may be restored. A partial hardening affects Israel until the fullness of Gentiles enters, after which all Israel will be saved through the Lord's irrevocable gifts and mercy.

day-0068.key_verse_text: He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
day-0068.summary: The Lord directs Moses to lead the people to the promised land but withdraws his direct presence due to their stiff-necked nature. Moses intercedes, and the Lord promises his presence will accompany them. When Moses requests to see the Lord's glory, the Lord agrees to reveal his goodness while protecting Moses from seeing his face directly.

day-0364.key_verse_text: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
day-0364.summary: The speaker requests the Lord to examine and judge his integrity, affirming his trust and faithful walk. He declares his separation from deceitful and wicked people, his commitment to innocence, and his love for the Lord's house and glory. He expresses confidence in standing firm and blessing the Lord among the congregations.

day-0216.key_verse_text: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.
day-0216.summary: The Philistine lords reject David from their army, so he returns to Ziklag to find it burned and his people captured by Amalekites. David strengthens himself in the Lord, inquires of him, pursues the raiders with 400 men, defeats them completely, and recovers all the captives and plunder. He distributes spoils among the elders of Judah.

day-0290.key_verse_text: He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.
day-0290.summary: Rehoboam rejects wise counsel from elders and adopts harsh policies, causing Israel to rebel and split the kingdom. After initial strength, Rehoboam abandons the Lord's law, prompting Egyptian invasion. Following humiliation and repentance, the Lord grants partial deliverance, though Rehoboam continues in evil because his heart remains unset toward seeking the Lord.

day-0438.key_verse_text: Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”
day-0438.summary: The Lord declares that the Lord's anointed sits at his right hand while enemies become a footstool. The Lord sends forth a rod of strength from Zion, and willing people gather in holy array. The Lord swears an eternal priesthood after the order of Melchizedek, and the Lord crushes kings and judges nations in his wrath.

day-0660.key_verse_text: For behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
day-0660.summary: The Lord emerges from his holy place and descends to tread upon the earth's high places, causing mountains to melt and valleys to split. This judgment comes because of Jacob's disobedience and Israel's sins, particularly in Samaria and Jerusalem. The Lord will destroy Samaria's idols and foundations, and the devastation will reach Judah and Jerusalem.

day-0586.key_verse_text: But Jeremiah said, “They won’t deliver you. Obey, I beg you, Yahweh’s voice, in that which I speak to you; so it will be well with you, and your soul will live.
day-0586.summary: King Zedekiah and his people reject the Lord's words spoken through Jeremiah. The prophet is arrested, imprisoned, and nearly killed, but the king repeatedly seeks his counsel in secret. Jeremiah consistently declares that the city will fall to Babylon unless Zedekiah surrenders, and the king ultimately keeps him confined in the guard's court.

day-0983.key_verse_text: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
day-0983.summary: A mighty angel descends from the sky clothed in a cloud with a rainbow on his head, his face like the sun and feet like fire. He holds an open book, stands on sea and land, and swears that there will be no more delay before God's mystery is finished.

day-0836.key_verse_text: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
day-0836.summary: The apostles appoint 7 men including Stephen to distribute aid to widows. Stephen performs wonders and disputes with synagogue members who accuse him of blasphemy. Before the council, Stephen recounts Israel's history and condemns their resistance to the Holy Spirit. The council stones him while he sees Jesus standing at God's right hand.

day-0142.key_verse_text: It shall be with him, and he shall read from it all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear Yahweh his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them; that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand, or to the left, to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children, in the middle of Israel.
day-0142.summary: The Lord commands observance of 3 annual feasts: Passover with unleavened bread, the feast of weeks, and the feast of booths. Judges must render righteous judgment without partiality or bribes. A future king must be chosen from among the people, avoid multiplying horses and wives, and read the law daily to fear the Lord and remain humble before his brothers.

day-0851.key_verse_text: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”
day-0851.summary: Paul testifies before the council, claiming a clear conscience. After being struck, he creates division between Sadducees and Pharisees by mentioning resurrection. The Lord appears to Paul at night, promising he will testify at Rome. Jewish conspirators plot to kill him, but Paul's nephew reveals the ambush. The commanding officer sends Paul under heavy guard to Governor Felix at Caesarea.

day-0143.key_verse_text: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.
day-0143.summary: The Levites receive no land inheritance but eat offerings from sacrifices and firstfruits. The Lord forbids occult practices like divination and sorcery. The Lord promises to raise a prophet from among the people, speaking the Lord's words, and those rejecting this prophet face judgment, while false prophets speaking presumptuously die.

day-0069.key_verse_text: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth, keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”
day-0069.summary: The Lord commands Moses to chisel new tablets and ascend Mount Sinai alone. There the Lord proclaims his merciful and just character, then establishes a covenant with Israel, detailing laws regarding worship, festivals, and offerings. Moses spends 40 days receiving the commandments, and his face shines when he descends with the tablets.

day-0512.key_verse_text: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples. They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
day-0512.summary: Isaiah sees a vision where the Lord's house stands exalted on mountains, drawing all nations to receive instruction in divine ways. The Lord judges between nations, transforming weapons into agricultural tools. Yet Judah pursues idolatry and foreign practices, so the Lord's day brings terror, humbling human pride and destroying idols while the Lord alone stands exalted.

day-0217.key_verse_text: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.
day-0217.summary: The Philistines defeat Israel in battle on Mount Gilboa, killing Saul's 3 sons. Saul, wounded by archers and fearing abuse, falls on his sword; his armor bearer does likewise. The Philistines desecrate Saul's body, but men from Jabesh Gilead recover it and give it proper burial.

day-0365.key_verse_text: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
day-0365.summary: The Lord serves as light and salvation, dispelling fear and providing strength. Enemies stumble and fall, and armies cannot shake confidence. The speaker seeks one thing: to dwell in the Lord's house, behold divine beauty, and inquire in the temple. The Lord hides and protects during trouble, lifting the head above adversaries.

day-0439.key_verse_text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
day-0439.summary: The Lord's works are great, righteous, and enduring. Those who fear the Lord gain wisdom and understanding. The righteous person who fears the Lord and deals graciously experiences blessing, stability, and honor, while the wicked grieve and perish.

day-0291.key_verse_text: Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has no strength. Help us, Yahweh our God; for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. Yahweh, you are our God. Don’t let man prevail against you.”
day-0291.summary: King Abijah defeats Jeroboam's larger army through reliance on God, then King Asa removes idols and seeks the Lord, experiences military victory against Ethiopia, leads a covenant renewal, but later relies on Syria instead of God for protection and dies diseased after refusing to seek the Lord's help.

day-0513.key_verse_text: In that day, Yahweh’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.
day-0513.summary: The Lord removes sustenance and leadership from Jerusalem and Judah, bringing chaos and oppression. The Lord judges the people for their sins and pride, stripping away their ornaments and beauty. After devastation, survivors experience restoration as the Lord's branch becomes glorious and the land beautiful again.

day-0734.key_verse_text: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
day-0734.summary: Jesus returns to his hometown and teaches in the synagogue, but the people are offended and disbelieve. He sends out the 12 disciples in pairs to preach repentance and heal the sick. Meanwhile, King Herod, fearing John the Baptizer has risen, eventually executes him at Herodias's request during a birthday feast.

day-0969.key_verse_text: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
day-0969.summary: The passage instructs believers to test spirits by whether they confess Jesus Christ in the flesh, identifying false prophets in the world. God's love is revealed through sending his Son as an atoning sacrifice, and those who love one another remain in God and possess perfect love that casts out fear.

day-0735.key_verse_text: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
day-0735.summary: The apostles report to Jesus, who takes them to a deserted place to rest. A crowd follows and gathers around him. Jesus teaches them, then feeds 5,000 men with 5 loaves and 2 fish. Later, he walks on the sea to his disciples in their boat. Upon landing at Gennesaret, sick people seek healing by touching his garment.

day-0661.key_verse_text: But as for me, I am full of power by Yahweh’s Spirit, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.
day-0661.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment against those who devise evil and seize fields and houses, oppressing people and taking their heritage. Corrupt leaders and false prophets mislead the people while the Lord declares through the speaker that judgment will come, with Zion plowed like a field and Jerusalem reduced to rubble.

day-0822.key_verse_text: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.
day-0822.summary: Jesus prays to the Father, asking for glorification and describing his completed work on earth. He prays for his disciples, whom the Father has given him, asking that they be kept, sanctified in truth, and unified. Jesus also prays for future believers, desiring that all be one and that the world recognize the Father's love.

day-0587.key_verse_text: For I will surely save you. You won’t fall by the sword, but you will escape with your life, because you have put your trust in me,” says Yahweh.’”
