day-0587.summary: Nebuchadnezzar's army breaches Jerusalem, captures King Zedekiah, and destroys the city while Jeremiah receives protection from the Babylonian king. The Lord promises deliverance to Ebedmelech through Jeremiah. After his release, Jeremiah joins Gedaliah as governor, and scattered Jews return to the land, though tensions arise over suspected threats to Gedaliah's life.

day-0954.key_verse_text: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
day-0954.summary: The passage describes how faith without works is dead. It illustrates this through examples of partiality toward the wealthy, the insufficiency of mere belief, and the necessity of action. Abraham and Rahab demonstrate that faith becomes complete through works, just as a body requires a spirit to live.

day-0292.key_verse_text: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, Judah and you inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in Yahweh your God, so you will be established! Believe his prophets, so you will prosper.”
day-0292.summary: Jehoshaphat strengthens Judah through military fortification and religious reform, establishing judges and sending teachers throughout the land. After an ill-fated alliance with Ahab leads to battle, Jehoshaphat returns home and faces rebuke. When enemies attack, the Lord delivers Judah through divine intervention while the people worship and praise.

day-0070.key_verse_text: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.
day-0070.summary: Moses assembles the Israelites and announces the Lord's commands regarding the Sabbath and a voluntary offering of materials and labor for the Tent of Meeting. Men and women willingly bring gold, jewels, fabrics, and other supplies. Moses then identifies Bezalel and Oholiab as divinely gifted craftsmen to oversee the construction work.

day-0440.key_verse_text: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap, that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
day-0440.summary: The Lord's name deserves praise from all servants, from sunrise to sunset and forever. The Lord sits high above all nations and stoops to observe heaven and earth. The Lord raises the poor from dust and the needy from ash heaps, seating them with princes, and grants the barren woman joy as a mother of children.

day-0588.key_verse_text: that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the things that we should do.”
day-0588.summary: Ishmael assassinates Gedaliah and massacres Jews at Mizpah, then flees when Johanan pursues him. The survivors ask Jeremiah to inquire of the Lord about their path forward. After 10 days, Jeremiah delivers the Lord's message: remaining in Judah brings blessing, but fleeing to Egypt brings death.

day-0366.key_verse_text: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
day-0366.summary: The psalmist calls to the Lord not to remain silent, asking to hear his petitions and lift his hands toward the holy place. The Lord breaks down the wicked who speak peace but harbor mischief, and blesses the one who trusts in him as strength and shield. The Lord saves his people and shepherds them forever.

day-0514.key_verse_text: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
day-0514.summary: A vineyard owner plants a choice vineyard expecting good fruit but harvests wild grapes, then pronounces judgment. The Lord identifies the vineyard as Israel and Judah, condemning their injustice, drunkenness, moral confusion, and corruption. The Lord summons a distant nation to execute swift judgment against the people.

day-0218.key_verse_text: “Your glory, Israel, was slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
day-0218.summary: A messenger arrives at David's camp with news that Saul and Jonathan have died in battle. The messenger claims he killed the wounded Saul at his request and brought his crown and bracelet. David and his men mourn and fast. David then executes the messenger for slaying the Lord's anointed, and composes a lamentation honoring Saul and Jonathan's valor.

day-0736.key_verse_text: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
day-0736.summary: Pharisees and scribes confront Jesus about his disciples eating with unwashed hands, violating tradition. Jesus responds that external things do not defile a person, but rather evil thoughts and actions proceeding from within the heart defile the person.

day-0807.key_verse_text: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink! He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”
day-0807.summary: Some in Jerusalem recognize Jesus as the one authorities seek to kill, yet he teaches openly in the temple. Many believe in him based on his signs, though others dispute whether the Christ comes from Galilee. The Pharisees send officers to arrest him, but they return amazed by his words instead.

day-0792.key_verse_text: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.
day-0792.summary: Simon of Cyrene carries Jesus's cross to The Skull, where Jesus is crucified between 2 criminals. Jesus asks the Father's forgiveness for those executing him. Darkness covers the land; the temple veil tears. Jesus dies committing his spirit to the Father. Joseph of Arimathaea buries Jesus in a tomb, and women from Galilee witness the burial.

day-0939.key_verse_text: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
day-0939.summary: God's kindness and love appear, saving people through regeneration and the Holy Spirit's renewal, not through their own righteous works. Those justified by grace become heirs of eternal life and maintain good works, while avoiding foolish disputes and factious persons.

day-0925.key_verse_text: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,
day-0925.summary: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write to the Thessalonians, giving thanks for their growing faith and love amid persecution. They describe God's righteous judgment, whereby the afflicted receive relief when Jesus returns with mighty angels in flaming fire to punish the disobedient. The writers pray that God counts the Thessalonians worthy of their calling and fulfills their faith with power.

day-0145.key_verse_text: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
day-0145.summary: When an unsolved murder occurs, the nearest city's elders perform a ritual with a heifer to cleanse the land. The passage then details laws governing captive women, inheritance rights, rebellious sons, proper burial, lost property, clothing distinctions, agricultural practices, and sexual conduct within marriage and betrothal.

day-0219.key_verse_text: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”
day-0219.summary: David inquires of the Lord and travels to Hebron with his wives and men, where the men of Judah anoint him king. Meanwhile, Abner establishes Saul's son Ishbosheth as king over Israel. Forces clash at Gibeon, resulting in severe fighting where Abner kills Asahel and eventually withdraws.

day-0071.key_verse_text: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”
day-0071.summary: Bezalel and Oholiab lead skilled craftsmen in constructing the tabernacle. The people contribute abundant materials, so much that Moses halts further offerings. The workers then fabricate the tabernacle's components: linen and goat hair curtains with clasps, acacia wood boards with silver sockets, gold-overlaid bars, and the veil with embroidered cherubim.

day-0367.key_verse_text: Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
day-0367.summary: The Lord's voice thunders across the waters with power and majesty, breaking cedars, shaking the wilderness, and stripping forests bare. The Lord sits enthroned as King forever and will give strength to his people, blessing them with peace.

day-0144.key_verse_text: for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”
day-0144.summary: The Lord commands the establishment of 3 cities of refuge for those who kill unintentionally, with provisions to add 3 more if borders expand. False witnesses face the punishment they sought for others. Before battle, priests assure soldiers the Lord fights with them, and officers exempt those with new houses, vineyards, or betrothals.

day-0662.key_verse_text: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem;
day-0662.summary: In the latter days, the Lord's temple becomes exalted and nations stream to it seeking instruction in the Lord's ways. The Lord judges between peoples and brings peace, transforming weapons into tools and establishing security. Though nations currently assemble against Zion, the Lord gathers them for judgment and promises to restore the lame as a strong nation under eternal reign.

day-0293.key_verse_text: The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, “God says, ‘Why do you disobey Yahweh’s commandments, so that you can’t prosper? Because you have forsaken Yahweh, he has also forsaken you.’”
day-0293.summary: Jehoram walks in evil ways and faces divine judgment through plagues and invasions. His son Ahaziah continues in wickedness and dies in conflict. Athaliah seizes power but Jehoiada the priest orchestrates young Joash's coronation and restoration of the temple. After Jehoiada's death, Joash abandons the Lord, rejects the prophet Zechariah, and faces Syrian invasion and assassination.

day-0515.key_verse_text: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
day-0515.summary: A prophet sees the Lord enthroned in the temple surrounded by seraphim. After a seraph cleanses his lips with a coal from the altar, the Lord asks whom to send. The prophet volunteers, and the Lord commissions him to deliver a message of judgment to a people who will hear but not understand.

day-0737.key_verse_text: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
day-0737.summary: Jesus travels to Tyre and Sidon, where a Greek woman begs him to heal her demon-possessed daughter. He grants her request based on her faith. Later, near the Sea of Galilee, he heals a deaf man with a speech impediment, and witnesses declare that he does all things well.

day-0663.key_verse_text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from ancient times.
day-0663.summary: Bethlehem Ephrathah, though small, produces a ruler whose origins extend to ancient times. This figure stands and shepherds in the Lord's strength, bringing peace and deliverance from Assyria. The remnant of Jacob becomes powerful among nations. The Lord removes horses, chariots, cities, witchcraft, and idols from the land, executing vengeance on disobedient nations.

day-0778.key_verse_text: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”
day-0778.summary: Jesus instructs his followers to remain vigilant and prepared, comparing readiness to servants awaiting their master's return. Faithful stewards who fulfill their duties receive reward, while unfaithful ones face judgment. Jesus declares he brings division among households and criticizes those who interpret weather signs but fail to discern the present time.

day-0910.key_verse_text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
day-0910.summary: Paul and Timothy greet the saints at Philippi, expressing thanksgiving for their partnership in spreading the Good News. Paul prays that their love increases in knowledge and discernment, trusting that God completes the good work begun in them until Christ's day, filling them with righteousness's fruits.

day-0763.key_verse_text: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”
day-0763.summary: Jesus teaches crowds from Simon's boat by the lake of Gennesaret. After instructing Simon to cast nets into deep water, an enormous catch of fish nearly sinks both boats. Simon, James, and John abandon their boats and nets to follow Jesus. Later, Jesus heals a leprous man and withdraws to pray as crowds gather seeking healing.

day-0589.key_verse_text: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.”
day-0589.summary: Jeremiah warns Judah not to flee to Egypt, but the people reject his message and go anyway. In Egypt, the Lord commands Jeremiah to prophesy that Nebuchadnezzar will conquer Egypt. The people refuse to listen and insist on burning incense to other gods, so the Lord declares they will be consumed by sword and famine.

day-0146.key_verse_text: When you reap your harvest in your field, and have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you shall not go again to get it. It shall be for the foreigner, for the fatherless, and for the widow, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
day-0146.summary: The Lord establishes rules for assembly membership, camp cleanliness, servant protection, lending practices, and vow-keeping. Laws address divorce, new marriage, pledges, and worker treatment. Provisions require leaving harvest gleanings for foreigners, orphans, and widows, grounded in remembrance of Egyptian slavery.

day-0441.key_verse_text: Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.
day-0441.summary: When Israel departs Egypt, the Lord transforms the natural world in response, causing the sea to flee and mountains to skip like rams. Glory belongs to the Lord's name alone. The Lord dwells in the heavens while idols, crafted by human hands, remain powerless and silent. The Lord blesses those who trust in him.

day-0294.key_verse_text: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper.
day-0294.summary: Amaziah begins his reign doing right but not wholeheartedly, then turns to idolatry after military victory and faces defeat by Israel. Uzziah prospers while seeking God through the prophet Zechariah but becomes leprous after presuming to burn incense. Jotham reigns righteously and grows mighty. Ahaz abandons the Lord entirely, walking in idolatry and facing severe military defeats and captivity.

day-0442.key_verse_text: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples! For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
day-0442.summary: A speaker expresses love for the Lord because he hears cries for mercy and delivers from death's grip. The Lord is gracious and merciful, preserving the simple. The speaker vows to offer thanksgiving and pay vows before all people, then calls all nations to praise the Lord for his enduring faithfulness and loving kindness.

day-0072.key_verse_text: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
day-0072.summary: Bezalel constructs the ark, table, lampstand, and incense altar from acacia wood and gold. He makes the bronze altar of burnt offering, basin, and court furnishings. The materials include 29 talents of gold, 100 talents of silver from the congregation, and 70 talents of bronze, all used according to the Lord's command.

day-0516.key_verse_text: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
day-0516.summary: During Ahaz's reign, Syria and Israel attack Judah but fail to prevail. The Lord instructs Isaiah to assure the king that the threat will not succeed. Though Ahaz refuses to ask for a sign, the Lord promises one: a virgin will conceive and bear a son called Immanuel, and before the child matures, the threatening kingdoms will be forsaken.

day-0664.key_verse_text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
day-0664.summary: The Lord brings charges against Israel, reminding the people of redemption from Egypt and asking what burden has been placed upon them. The Lord requires justice, mercy, and humility rather than sacrifices. Israel's wickedness brings desolation, but a remnant looks to the Lord for salvation and restoration, trusting in divine compassion and faithfulness to ancestral promises.

day-0368.key_verse_text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
day-0368.summary: The psalmist praises the Lord for raising him from distress and healing him, declaring that the Lord's anger lasts only a moment while his favor endures forever. The Lord transforms the psalmist's mourning into dancing and clothes him with gladness, prompting eternal thanksgiving.

day-0220.key_verse_text: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.
day-0220.summary: A prolonged conflict between Saul's and David's houses sees David strengthening while Saul's line weakens. David fathers 6 sons in Hebron. Abner, gaining power in Saul's house, eventually negotiates with David to unite Israel under his rule. Joab kills Abner in revenge for his brother's death, and David mourns publicly, demonstrating his innocence in the matter.

day-0738.key_verse_text: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
day-0738.summary: Jesus feeds 4,000 people with 7 loaves and a few fish, and they eat until satisfied. Pharisees demand a sign from heaven, but Jesus refuses, saying no sign will be given to this generation. Later, the disciples misunderstand Jesus's warning about the yeast of the Pharisees and Herod, thinking he speaks of bread.

day-0881.key_verse_text: Let all things be done decently and in order.
day-0881.summary: The text contrasts speaking in other languages with prophesying, establishing that prophecy builds up the assembly while speaking in other languages requires interpretation to benefit others. Specific guidelines govern the use of these gifts in gatherings, prioritizing clarity and mutual edification while maintaining orderly conduct.

day-0073.key_verse_text: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
day-0073.summary: The craftsmen construct all the priestly garments and tabernacle furnishings according to the Lord's specifications, including the ephod, breastplate, robe, and tunics adorned with gold, precious stones, and fine materials. Moses inspects the completed work, confirms it matches the Lord's commands, and blesses the people.

day-0866.key_verse_text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service. Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
day-0866.summary: The passage describes how believers present themselves as living sacrifices through transformed minds, avoid worldly conformity, and exercise diverse spiritual gifts within the body of Christ. It outlines conduct marked by genuine love, mutual affection, diligence, hospitality, blessing of persecutors, empathy with others, humility, peacemaking, and overcoming evil with good.

day-0221.key_verse_text: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.
day-0221.summary: Rechab and Baanah murder Ishbosheth and bring his head to David, expecting reward, but David executes them for killing a righteous man. All Israel's tribes then anoint David king at Hebron. David captures Jerusalem from the Jebusites, grows in power as the Lord strengthens him, and defeats the Philistines in 2 successive battles.

day-0590.key_verse_text: “But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant. Don’t be dismayed, Israel; for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your offspring from the land of their captivity. Jacob will return, and will be quiet and at ease. No one will make him afraid. Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”
day-0590.summary: Jeremiah conveys the Lord's message to Baruch, warning against seeking great things while judgment comes on all flesh, though Baruch escapes with his life. The Lord then pronounces judgment on Egypt and its allies through Nebuchadnezzar, yet promises Jacob and Israel salvation and restoration despite correction.

day-0369.key_verse_text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
day-0369.summary: The speaker seeks refuge in the Lord, asking for deliverance from enemies and affliction. Though experiencing distress, grief, and contempt from others, the speaker trusts in the Lord's protection and loving kindness. The Lord preserves those who take refuge in him and hides them from danger.

day-0295.key_verse_text: For if you turn again to Yahweh, your brothers and your children will find compassion with those who led them captive, and will come again into this land, because Yahweh your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you if you return to him.”
day-0295.summary: Hezekiah becomes king at 25 and immediately repairs the temple, directing priests and Levites to cleanse it. He organizes sacrifices and worship, then invites all Israel to celebrate Passover in Jerusalem. The people respond with great rejoicing, destroy idolatrous altars, and bring abundant offerings. Hezekiah establishes priestly divisions and ensures faithful distribution of tithes and consecrated gifts throughout the land.

day-0147.key_verse_text: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments. He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.
day-0147.summary: The passage establishes laws governing disputes, property, family obligations, and honest commerce, then commands the offering of firstfruits and tithes to the Lord at the chosen place. The Lord declares the people his own possession and promises to exalt them above all nations if they keep his commandments.

day-0517.key_verse_text: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized. Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
day-0517.summary: The Lord instructs the prophet to write a name signifying swift judgment and to father a son bearing that name, indicating that before the child matures, Assyria will plunder Damascus and Samaria. The Lord warns against fearing human conspiracies, commanding reverence for the Lord alone, who becomes both sanctuary and stumbling stone for Israel.

day-0591.key_verse_text: “Yet I will reverse the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
day-0591.summary: The Lord declares judgment against the Philistines through waters and destruction, then pronounces extensive judgment on Moab for its pride and trust in false gods, describing devastation across its cities and people. Yet the Lord promises to restore Moab's captivity in the latter days.

day-0665.key_verse_text: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
day-0665.summary: Nahum receives a vision concerning Nineveh, declaring that the Lord is jealous and avenges his enemies with great power and wrath. Though the Lord is slow to anger, he will not leave the guilty unpunished. Yet the Lord proves good to those seeking refuge in him, and he will destroy his adversaries while delivering his people from oppression.

day-0443.key_verse_text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
day-0443.summary: The Lord's loving kindness endures forever. A speaker calls upon the Lord from distress and receives freedom, declaring the Lord's protection superior to human confidence. Surrounded by enemies, the speaker cuts them off through the Lord's name. The rejected stone becomes the cornerstone, a marvelous work of the Lord on this day.

day-0852.key_verse_text: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
day-0852.summary: The high priest Ananias and an orator named Tertullus accuse Paul before Governor Felix of being a plague and instigator of insurrections. Paul defends himself, stating he was in the temple peacefully and that his accusers cannot prove their charges. Felix defers judgment and keeps Paul in custody with privileges.

day-0739.key_verse_text: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
day-0739.summary: Jesus restores sight to a blind man at Bethsaida through a 2-stage healing. He then questions his disciples about his identity, and Peter identifies him as the Christ. Jesus teaches that the Son of Man must suffer, be rejected, and rise again, then calls the multitude to deny themselves and follow him.

day-0222.key_verse_text: David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.
day-0222.summary: David gathers 30,000 men to transport the Lord's ark to Jerusalem on a new cart. When the cattle stumble, Uzzah touches the ark and dies from the Lord's anger. David leaves the ark at Obed-Edom's house for 3 months, then retrieves it with sacrifices, dancing, and celebration, distributing food to all Israel.

day-0984.key_verse_text: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”
day-0984.summary: A reed measures God's temple while 2 witnesses prophesy for 1,260 days, wielding power over sky and waters. The beast kills them, but after 3.5 days they resurrect and ascend. An earthquake follows, then the 7th angel announces the Lord's kingdom has come, prompting heavenly worship and the opening of God's temple.

day-0074.key_verse_text: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
day-0074.summary: The Lord commands Moses to assemble the tabernacle on the first day of the first month, positioning the ark, table, lampstand, altar, basin, and court, then anointing all furnishings and Aaron with his sons to consecrate them for priestly service. Moses executes every instruction precisely as commanded.

day-0296.key_verse_text: An arm of flesh is with him, but Yahweh our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
day-0296.summary: Hezekiah fortifies Jerusalem against Sennacherib's invasion, and the Lord sends an angel to destroy the Assyrian army. After Hezekiah's death, his son Manasseh reigns 55 years doing evil, then repents after captivity and reforms. Manasseh's son Amon reigns briefly in wickedness before his servants assassinate him.

day-0444.key_verse_text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
day-0444.summary: Those whose ways are blameless and who walk according to the Lord's law are blessed. A person who hides the Lord's word in their heart seeks the Lord with their whole heart, meditates on his statutes, and delights in his ordinances rather than wandering from his commandments.

day-0370.key_verse_text: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
day-0370.summary: The psalmist describes blessedness as having sin forgiven and covered by the Lord. Silence about wrongdoing brings physical anguish, but confession brings relief and forgiveness. The Lord protects the godly from trouble and offers guidance, while the wicked experience many sorrows unless they trust in the Lord's loving kindness.

day-0518.key_verse_text: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
day-0518.summary: The Lord promises an end to darkness and gloom, with a child born who will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, and Prince of Peace, ruling with endless justice and righteousness. Yet Israel refuses to turn from wickedness, and the Lord's anger burns against the people as they devour one another.

day-0592.key_verse_text: Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”
day-0592.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment against Ammon, Edom, Damascus, Kedar, Hazor, and Elam for their pride and unfaithfulness. Cities will be destroyed, populations scattered, and desolation will follow. Yet the Lord promises eventual restoration of Ammon and Elam's captives in latter days.

day-0837.key_verse_text: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
day-0837.summary: Persecution scatters believers throughout Judea and Samaria, who preach the word. Philip proclaims Christ in Samaria, performing signs that bring healing and joy. Simon, a sorcerer, believes and is baptized. Peter and John lay hands on believers to impart the Holy Spirit. Philip later encounters an Ethiopian eunuch reading Isaiah, explains Jesus to him, and baptizes him.

day-0740.key_verse_text: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”
day-0740.summary: Jesus takes 3 disciples up a mountain where he transforms, appearing brilliantly white while Moses and Elijah speak with him. A cloud overshadows them and a voice declares Jesus the beloved Son. Descending, Jesus casts out a mute spirit from a boy after the father expresses belief, telling his disciples later that such spirits require prayer and fasting.

day-0970.key_verse_text: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
day-0970.summary: Belief in Jesus as the Christ demonstrates being born of God and loving the Father. Those born of God overcome the world through faith. Jesus came by water and blood, with the Spirit testifying to this truth. God's testimony concerning his Son grants eternal life to those who believe and have the Son.

day-0666.key_verse_text: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?
day-0666.summary: The Lord declares judgment against Nineveh, describing an invading army that overwhelms the city's defenses and plunders its wealth. The city, once powerful like a lion's den, faces complete destruction. Its fortresses crumble, its people scatter, and its wound proves fatal, leaving all nations to rejoice at its downfall.

day-0148.key_verse_text: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
day-0148.summary: Moses and the elders command the people to set up stones inscribed with the law upon crossing the Jordan, build an altar on Mount Ebal, and offer sacrifices. Specific tribes stand on Mount Gerizim and Mount Ebal while Levites pronounce curses for idolatry, dishonoring parents, removing landmarks, and other violations, with the people responding "Amen" to each.

day-0955.key_verse_text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
day-0955.summary: The tongue, though small, wields great power to bless or curse and defiles the whole body. True wisdom from above is pure, peaceful, gentle, merciful, and free from partiality and hypocrisy, while earthly wisdom breeds jealousy, selfish ambition, and confusion. Righteousness bears fruit through peacemakers.

day-0075.key_verse_text: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.
day-0075.summary: The cloud covers the Tent of Meeting and fills it with the Lord's glory, preventing Moses from entering. The cloud directs the children of Israel's travels: they journey when it lifts and remain encamped when it stays. The cloud appears by day and fire by night throughout their journeys.

day-0297.key_verse_text: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and against its inhabitants, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,” says Yahweh.
day-0297.summary: Josiah becomes king at age 8 and pursues religious reform, destroying idols and repairing the temple. Workers discover the book of the law, which deeply moves the king. A prophetess conveys the Lord's message that judgment will come but Josiah will be spared. Josiah leads a great Passover celebration before dying in battle against Egypt.

day-0149.key_verse_text: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth. All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
day-0149.summary: The Lord promises abundant blessings to those who obey his commandments: prosperity in crops, livestock, and offspring, military victory, and elevated status among nations. Conversely, disobedience brings curses: famine, disease, military defeat, captivity, and exile, with the Lord scattering the people among foreign lands to serve other gods.

day-0371.key_verse_text: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
day-0371.summary: The righteous are called to praise the Lord with musical instruments and new songs, for his word is right and his work faithful. The Lord created the heavens and earth by his command, governs nations, and watches over all people. Those who fear him and hope in his kindness receive his protection and deliverance.

day-0445.key_verse_text: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
day-0445.summary: The speaker petitions the Lord for understanding and guidance in keeping divine statutes and commandments, expressing delight in them while turning away from worthless pursuits. The speaker promises obedience, finds comfort in the Lord's word during affliction, and remains steadfast despite mockery and opposition from the wicked.

day-0519.key_verse_text: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
day-0519.summary: God pronounces judgment on those who write unjust decrees and oppress the poor. The Lord uses Assyria as a rod of anger against Israel, though Assyria acts with prideful intent beyond God's command. Eventually the Lord punishes Assyria's arrogance, and a remnant of Israel returns to lean on the Lord rather than their oppressor.

day-0593.key_verse_text: Their Redeemer is strong. Yahweh of Armies is his name. He will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
day-0593.summary: The Lord speaks judgment against Babylon through the prophet Jeremiah. Nations from the north will devastate the land while Israel and Judah return to seek the Lord. Babylon's pride against God brings destruction: its armies fall, waters dry up, and the land becomes desolate. The Lord pleads the cause of his oppressed people and appoints their deliverer.

day-0667.key_verse_text: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days which you will not believe though it is told you.
day-0667.summary: Habakkuk cries out to the Lord about violence and injustice prevailing in the land. The Lord responds that he is raising up the Chaldeans, a fierce and dreaded nation, to sweep across the earth. Habakkuk then questions how the Lord tolerates the wicked devouring the righteous.

day-0823.key_verse_text: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”
day-0823.summary: Jesus enters a garden with his disciples where Judas arrives with soldiers. When Jesus identifies himself, they fall backward. Peter draws a sword and cuts off a servant's ear, but Jesus tells him to put it away. Soldiers seize and bind Jesus, leading him to the high priest while Peter denies knowing him three times.

day-0940.key_verse_text: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
day-0940.summary: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, writes to Philemon and the church in his house, appealing on behalf of Onesimus, a formerly useless slave now transformed into a beloved brother in Christ. Paul requests Philemon receive Onesimus not as a slave but as a cherished companion, offering to repay any debt owed.

day-0223.key_verse_text: Your house and your kingdom will be made sure forever before you. Your throne will be established forever.”’”
day-0223.summary: David proposes building a house for God's ark, but the Lord sends Nathan with a message rejecting the plan. Instead, the Lord promises to establish David's dynasty forever, declaring that David's offspring will build the temple and his throne will endure eternally. David responds with prayer, acknowledging God's greatness and faithfulness.

day-0926.key_verse_text: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.
day-0926.summary: The passage describes the coming of Jesus Christ and warns against deception regarding the day of Christ. A rebellion and the man of sin must come first before the Lord destroys the lawless one. God chooses believers for salvation through the Spirit and truth, and they are called to stand firm in the traditions taught to them.

day-0793.key_verse_text: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
day-0793.summary: On the first day of the week, women find Jesus' tomb empty and encounter two men in dazzling clothing who announce his resurrection. Later, the risen Jesus appears to two disciples on the road to Emmaus, explains the Scriptures concerning himself, and reveals his identity during a meal before vanishing from their sight.

day-0150.key_verse_text: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
day-0150.summary: Moses recounts the Lord's mighty deeds in Egypt and the wilderness, calling all Israel to enter into covenant. The Lord warns against turning to other gods, declaring that those who break covenant will face curses, desolation, and removal from the land, while revealed things belong to the people to obey.

day-0076.key_verse_text: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
day-0076.summary: The Lord instructs Moses to tell the Israelites how to present burnt offerings from the herd, flock, or birds, with specific procedures for killing, preparing, and burning each type. The Lord also describes meal offerings made from fine flour with oil and frankincense, and peace offerings from the herd or flock, with detailed instructions for handling fat and blood.

day-0224.key_verse_text: David said to him, “Don’t be afraid, for I will surely show you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore to you all the land of Saul your father. You will eat bread at my table continually.”
day-0224.summary: David conquers the Philistines, Moab, Syria, and Edom, establishing his kingdom and dedicating spoils to the Lord. Later, David seeks survivors of Saul's house to show kindness for Jonathan's sake, locates Mephibosheth, and grants him Saul's land while inviting him to eat perpetually at the royal table.

day-0298.key_verse_text: “Cyrus king of Persia says, ‘Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given all the kingdoms of the earth to me; and he has commanded me to build him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, Yahweh his God be with him, and let him go up.’”
day-0298.summary: Judah's kings reign in succession, doing evil and rejecting the Lord's prophets. Nebuchadnezzar conquers Jerusalem, destroys the temple, and carries the people into exile. After 70 years, Cyrus of Persia decrees that the Lord has commanded him to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem, and the Lord's people may return.

day-0741.key_verse_text: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”
day-0741.summary: Jesus travels through Galilee teaching the 12 that the Son of Man will be handed over and killed, then rise on the third day. The disciples argue about who is greatest, so Jesus teaches that whoever wants to be first must be last and servant of all, using a child as an example of receiving him.

day-0808.key_verse_text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
day-0808.summary: Jesus teaches in the temple after scribes and Pharisees bring an adulteress, testing him about stoning. He tells the sinless one to cast the first stone, and all depart. Jesus declares himself the light of the world and testifies about his origin and relationship with the Father, though many fail to understand his words about the Father.

day-0446.key_verse_text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.
day-0446.summary: The speaker affirms the Lord's goodness and describes how affliction has led to obedience and delight in God's law. Despite persecution from the proud, the speaker treasures God's word above wealth and finds life through God's statutes, which remain eternal and boundless.

day-0520.key_verse_text: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.
day-0520.summary: A shoot from Jesse's stock bears fruit, filled with the Lord's Spirit and wisdom, judging the poor with righteousness. Wild animals dwell peacefully together, and the earth fills with knowledge of the Lord. The Lord gathers the dispersed remnant from many nations, establishing a highway for his people's return.

day-0372.key_verse_text: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
day-0372.summary: The Lord delivers those who seek refuge in him from their fears and troubles. The righteous cry out and the Lord hears them, remaining near to the broken-hearted. Those who fear the Lord lack nothing good, while the wicked face condemnation and the Lord redeems his servants.

day-0594.key_verse_text: “Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity, for it is the time of Yahweh’s vengeance. He will give to her a recompense.
day-0594.summary: The Lord declares Babylon's destruction through invading armies, describing the city's fall as punishment for its violence against Israel and Judah. The Lord commands the people to flee and promises to execute judgment on Babylon's idols and inhabitants, making the city a desolate wasteland.

day-0668.key_verse_text: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
day-0668.summary: The Lord instructs the prophet to write a vision plainly on tablets for those who read it. Though the vision delays, it will surely come. The righteous live by faith, while the arrogant and violent face judgment through 5 woes pronounced against their greed, bloodshed, shame, and idolatry. The Lord remains in his holy temple.

day-0299.key_verse_text: Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of Yahweh, the God of Israel ( he is God ), which is in Jerusalem.
day-0299.summary: King Cyrus of Persia, moved by the Lord, proclaims that exiles may return to Jerusalem to rebuild the Lord's house. The returning exiles, led by Zerubbabel and others, number over 42,000 people plus servants. They bring back the temple vessels and offer gifts for the reconstruction work.

day-0764.key_verse_text: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
day-0764.summary: Jesus teaches while Pharisees and teachers observe. Men lower a paralyzed man through a roof; Jesus forgives his sins and heals him, demonstrating authority on earth. Jesus calls Levi the tax collector to follow him, then eats with tax collectors and sinners, explaining that the sick need a physician and sinners need repentance.

day-0911.key_verse_text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
day-0911.summary: Paul reports that his imprisonment has advanced the Gospel, emboldening believers to speak God's word fearlessly. Though some preach Christ from selfish motives and others from love, Paul rejoices that Christ is proclaimed. He expresses confidence that he will magnify Christ whether through life or death, and anticipates remaining with the Philippians for their spiritual progress.

day-0077.key_verse_text: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.
day-0077.summary: The Lord instructs Moses on sin offerings for unintentional transgressions. An anointed priest, the whole congregation, a ruler, or a common person each brings an appropriate animal—bull, goat, or lamb—which the priest sacrifices, applies blood to the altar, and burns, making atonement so the offerer receives forgiveness. Poorer individuals may substitute birds or flour.

day-0779.key_verse_text: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.
day-0779.summary: Jesus tells people that suffering does not indicate greater sinfulness and warns of judgment unless they repent. He heals a bent woman on the Sabbath, describing God's Kingdom through parables of a mustard seed and yeast. He teaches that many will seek entry through the narrow door but fail, and laments Jerusalem's rejection of prophets.

day-0151.key_verse_text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants, to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
day-0151.summary: When the Lord's blessings and curses come upon the people and they remember them among the nations, returning to the Lord with all their heart and soul, the Lord will restore them from captivity, gather them from all places, bring them to their ancestral land, and circumcise their hearts to love the Lord, ensuring their prosperity and life.

day-0225.key_verse_text: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahweh.
day-0225.summary: David shows kindness to the new Ammonite king, but his servants are humiliated. War erupts; David's forces defeat the Ammonites and Syrians. Later, David sees Bathsheba bathing, takes her, and she becomes pregnant. David arranges for her husband Uriah to die in battle, then marries her. The Lord disapproves of David's actions.

day-0373.key_verse_text: My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
day-0373.summary: The psalmist calls on the Lord to fight against enemies who pursue without cause, laying hidden traps and repaying good with evil. The psalmist's soul rejoices in the Lord's salvation and deliverance of the poor, trusting the Lord to vindicate and shame those who wrongfully rejoice at calamity.

day-0447.key_verse_text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
day-0447.summary: The speaker expresses deep love for the Lord's law and commandments, which provide wisdom, understanding, and guidance. The Lord's word serves as a lamp and shield, offering protection from evil and false ways. The speaker commits to obedience despite affliction and opposition from the wicked.

day-0521.key_verse_text: Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
day-0521.summary: Isaiah pronounces judgment against Babylon, describing the Lord's day of destruction arriving with cosmic upheaval and military devastation. The Lord musters armies to desolate the land, darken celestial bodies, and reduce the population to scarcity. Babylon falls to the Medes, becoming permanently uninhabited, overtaken by wild animals.

day-0742.key_verse_text: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
day-0742.summary: Jesus teaches multitudes in Judea, addresses Pharisees' question about divorce by pointing to God's original design for marriage, welcomes little children and states that entering God's Kingdom requires receiving it like a child, and tells a rich man to sell his possessions and follow him, explaining that salvation comes through God's power rather than wealth.

day-0743.key_verse_text: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
day-0743.summary: Jesus travels toward Jerusalem and predicts his suffering and death to the 12 disciples. James and John request positions of honor, but Jesus teaches that greatness comes through servanthood. Near Jericho, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus calls out to Jesus, who restores his sight and the man follows him.

day-0669.key_verse_text: Yahweh, the Lord, is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.
day-0669.summary: The prophet recounts God's mighty deeds and terrifying power, describing how the Lord comes in judgment, shaking the earth and nations while saving the people. Despite facing deprivation and invasion, the speaker declares rejoicing in God and affirms that the Lord provides strength to overcome all obstacles.

day-0595.key_verse_text: For through Yahweh’s anger this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
day-0595.summary: Zedekiah reigns in Jerusalem but does evil, prompting the Lord's anger and his rebellion against Babylon. Nebuchadnezzar besieges the city, captures Zedekiah, blinds him, and carries him to Babylon. Nebuzaradan burns Jerusalem's houses and temple, breaks down walls, takes captives and temple vessels, and executes leaders. Later, Evilmerodach releases Jehoiachin from prison and provides for him.

day-0897.key_verse_text: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
day-0897.summary: After 14 years, Paul returns to Jerusalem with Barnabas and Titus to present the Gospel to the respected apostles. They affirm his mission to the Gentiles while Peter, James, and John commit to the circumcised. Later at Antioch, Paul confronts Peter for withdrawing from Gentiles, emphasizing that justification comes through faith in Christ, not the law.

day-0882.key_verse_text: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
day-0882.summary: Paul declares the Gospel he received and preached: Christ died for sins, was buried, and was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures, appearing to Cephas, the twelve, over 500 brothers, James, all apostles, and finally to Paul. Paul argues that denying resurrection contradicts Christ's resurrection and renders faith futile.

day-0226.key_verse_text: David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against Yahweh.” Nathan said to David, “Yahweh also has put away your sin. You will not die.
day-0226.summary: Nathan tells David a parable about a rich man who takes a poor man's lamb, prompting David's angry judgment. Nathan reveals David himself is the man, having taken Uriah's wife and caused his death. David confesses his sin, and the Lord forgives him but declares the child will die as consequence.

day-0960.key_verse_text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
day-0960.summary: Wives submit to husbands through pure conduct; beauty comes from a gentle, quiet spirit rather than outward adornment. Husbands honor wives as joint heirs of grace. All believers live compassionately, bless rather than curse, seek peace, and remain ready to explain their hope with humility. Christ suffered for the unrighteous and rose through God's power.

day-0867.key_verse_text: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
day-0867.summary: Every person stands under authority ordained by God, and resistance to authority opposes God's ordinance. Love fulfills all the law's commandments, doing no harm to neighbors. The time grows short, calling believers to awaken from sleep and cast off darkness while putting on the armor of light.

day-0300.key_verse_text: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahweh, because the foundation of Yahweh’s house had been laid.
day-0300.summary: The returned exiles gather in Jerusalem, rebuild the altar, and resume offerings according to the law. After securing materials, they lay the foundation of the Lord's temple in the second year. Priests and Levites lead worship with instruments and song, while the people respond with great shouting, though some elders weep at the sight.

day-0152.key_verse_text: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
day-0152.summary: Moses addresses Israel, announcing his age and inability to cross the Jordan, then commissions Joshua as leader. The Lord will go before them to destroy the nations ahead. Moses writes the law, delivers it to the priests and elders, and instructs them to read it publicly every 7 years so all Israel learns to fear the Lord.

day-0374.key_verse_text: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.
day-0374.summary: A revelation describes the wicked person's disobedience, lacking fear of God and flattering himself in his own eyes. The Lord's loving kindness reaches the heavens, his righteousness like mountains, and those who know him find refuge under his wings and drink from the river of his pleasures. The workers of iniquity fall and cannot rise.

day-0078.key_verse_text: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.
day-0078.summary: The Lord instructs Moses on trespass offerings for those who sin unwittingly against holy things or commit fraud against neighbors, requiring restitution plus a fifth part and a ram for atonement. Regulations follow for maintaining the altar fire continually, preparing meal offerings, and handling sin offerings in the sanctuary with prescribed holiness standards.

day-0596.key_verse_text: “Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, with which Yahweh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
day-0596.summary: Jerusalem sits desolate and abandoned, transformed from a great city into a widow. The Lord has afflicted the city for its transgressions, and its people weep without comfort. Enemies prosper while former allies betray, and the city's majesty has departed entirely.

day-0448.key_verse_text: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
day-0448.summary: The speaker treasures the Lord's testimonies, finding that divine words bring light and understanding. Though small and despised, facing trouble and persecution, the speaker clings to the Lord's commandments with passionate devotion, rising early to seek help and remaining steadfast while enemies ignore the Lord's law.

day-0522.key_verse_text: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
day-0522.summary: The Lord restores Jacob to their land while foreigners join them, and the oppressed become rulers over their former oppressors. A taunt arises against Babylon's king, whose fall brings rest to the earth. The Lord declares plans against Assyria and warns Philistia of coming judgment, while Zion becomes a refuge for the afflicted.

day-0744.key_verse_text: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations ’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”
day-0744.summary: Jesus sends disciples to retrieve a donkey, then rides it into Jerusalem while crowds hail him with branches and garments. He inspects the temple, curses a barren fig tree, and returns to cleanse the temple by overturning merchants' tables, declaring it should be a house of prayer rather than a den of robbers.

day-0670.key_verse_text: The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries there bitterly.
day-0670.summary: The Lord declares through Zephaniah that he will sweep away all creation from the earth, particularly punishing Judah and Jerusalem for idolatry and wickedness. The great day of the Lord approaches swiftly, bringing wrath, distress, darkness, and destruction. Neither wealth nor possessions will deliver the people from this coming judgment.

day-0853.key_verse_text: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’
day-0853.summary: Festus hears accusations against Paul from Jewish leaders and later presents the case to King Agrippa. Paul defends himself, recounting his former persecution of believers and his encounter with Jesus on the Damascus road, which transformed him into a witness proclaiming repentance to Jews and Gentiles. Agrippa and Festus conclude Paul has done nothing worthy of death.

day-0985.key_verse_text: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
day-0985.summary: A woman clothed with the sun gives birth to a son destined to rule all nations. A great red dragon attempts to devour the child, but the son is caught up to God's throne. War erupts in heaven as Michael and his angels fight the dragon, casting him down to earth where he pursues the woman and her offspring.

day-0079.key_verse_text: This is the law of the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, the trespass offering, the consecration, and the sacrifice of peace offerings which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.
day-0079.summary: The Lord establishes laws for trespass offerings, peace offerings, and priestly portions. Priests receive designated portions of sacrifices, including skins and meal offerings. Fat and blood are forbidden for consumption. Peace offerings have specific timing requirements and purity standards. These ordinances, given at Mount Sinai, govern how the Israelites present their offerings to the Lord.

day-0301.key_verse_text: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.
day-0301.summary: Adversaries oppose the Jews rebuilding the temple, hiring counselors to frustrate their work through successive Persian reigns. King Artaxerxes orders construction halted. Later, prophets Haggai and Zechariah encourage Zerubbabel and Jeshua to resume building. When officials question their authority, the elders explain their work stems from Cyrus's original decree and request verification from the king.

day-0153.key_verse_text: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
day-0153.summary: Moses recites a song proclaiming the Lord's perfect justice and faithfulness, recounting how the Lord cared for Israel in the wilderness. The song describes Israel's rebellion through idolatry and the Lord's consequent judgment, followed by promises of vengeance on enemies and atonement for the land. Moses then receives instructions to ascend Mount Nebo and view Canaan before his death.

day-0838.key_verse_text: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
day-0838.summary: Saul persecutes disciples until Jesus appears to him on the Damascus road, striking him blind. Ananias restores his sight, and Saul is baptized and begins proclaiming Jesus in synagogues. Peter heals a paralyzed man and raises Tabitha from death, leading many to believe in the Lord.

day-0375.key_verse_text: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
day-0375.summary: The psalmist instructs against fretting over evildoers, who will soon wither like grass. Those who trust in the Lord, delight in him, and commit their ways to him receive the desires of their hearts and inherit the land, while the wicked perish and their schemes fail against the righteous whom the Lord upholds.

day-0227.key_verse_text: But when King David heard of all these things, he was very angry.
day-0227.summary: Amnon deceives his father King David to bring his sister Tamar to his house, where he forces her despite her protests. After the assault, he sends her away in shame. King David grows angry upon hearing of these things. Two years later, Absalom invites the king's sons to a feast and kills Amnon in revenge, then flees to Geshur.

day-0449.key_verse_text: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
day-0449.summary: A speaker describes persecution by princes yet maintains reverence for the Lord's words, rejoicing in them and praising 7 times daily. Those loving the Lord's law experience great peace and stability. The speaker has observed the Lord's testimonies, obeyed the commandments, and longs for salvation, requesting understanding and deliverance while acknowledging straying like a lost sheep.

day-0523.key_verse_text: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
day-0523.summary: Moab faces sudden destruction and devastation across its cities and lands. The people mourn with weeping and wailing, fleeing their homes. A future ruler will establish a throne of justice and righteousness. The Lord declares that within 3 years, Moab's glory will diminish greatly, leaving only a small, weakened remnant.

day-0597.key_verse_text: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches! Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord. Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, who faint for hunger at the head of every street.
day-0597.summary: The Lord destroys Zion in anger, casting down Israel's beauty and burning Jacob like fire. Enemies rejoice as gates sink, prophets fail, and children starve in streets. The speaker calls for cries of anguish before the Lord, describing the slaughter of youth and elders alike.

day-0671.key_verse_text: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
day-0671.summary: The Lord calls the humble to seek righteousness before his anger comes, then pronounces judgment on surrounding nations and Jerusalem's rebellious leaders. After purifying the peoples, the Lord removes the proud, preserves a faithful remnant, and restores Jerusalem with joy, declaring he will save, calm, and rejoice over his people.

day-0956.key_verse_text: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
day-0956.summary: Wars and conflicts arise from desires that battle within people. The Lord resists the proud but gives grace to the humble. Those who draw near to God find God drawing near to them. Judging others violates the law, and boasting about future plans ignores human mortality and dependence on the Lord's will.

day-0971.key_verse_text: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
day-0971.summary: The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children, commending those walking in truth and urging love for one another according to the Lord's commandments. The elder warns against deceivers who deny Jesus Christ came in flesh and instructs the recipients to reject those who don't hold to Christ's teaching.

day-0080.key_verse_text: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons ’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons ’ garments with him.
day-0080.summary: Moses assembles the congregation and consecrates Aaron and his sons as priests. He washes them, dresses them in priestly garments, anoints the tabernacle and altar, and performs sacrifices including a sin offering, burnt offering, and ram of consecration. Moses applies blood and anointing oil to Aaron and his sons, sanctifying them for 7 days of service.

day-0154.key_verse_text: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
day-0154.summary: Moses pronounces blessings on the 12 tribes of Israel before his death, describing the Lord's protection and provision for each tribe, affirming that the eternal God serves as their dwelling place with everlasting arms beneath them, and declaring Israel's safety and happiness as a people saved by the Lord.

day-0228.key_verse_text: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.
day-0228.summary: Joab arranges for a wise woman from Tekoa to present a case to the king about a banished son, paralleling the king's estrangement from Absalom. The king grants permission to bring Absalom back to Jerusalem, though initially forbids him from seeing the king's face. After 2 years, Absalom forces a meeting through Joab, and the king reconciles with him.

day-0302.key_verse_text: and kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; because Yahweh had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of God, the God of Israel’s house.
day-0302.summary: King Darius discovers Cyrus's original decree authorizing the temple's reconstruction and issues his own decree providing resources and protection for the work. The elders complete the temple, and the returned exiles dedicate it with sacrifices, then celebrate Passover and the feast of unleavened bread with joy.

day-0376.key_verse_text: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
day-0376.summary: A sufferer describes physical affliction and emotional anguish stemming from sin, with wounds that fester and strength that fails. Loved ones withdraw while enemies multiply and lay snares. The sufferer resolves to declare iniquity and sorrow for sin, hoping the Lord will answer and provide salvation.

day-0450.key_verse_text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
day-0450.summary: A distressed voice cries to the Lord for deliverance from deceitful speech and those who hate peace. The Lord, maker of heaven and earth, keeps the traveler's feet from stumbling, remaining vigilant day and night, protecting from all harm and evil both going out and coming in forever.

day-0745.key_verse_text: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
day-0745.summary: The disciples observe the fig tree withered from its roots. Jesus teaches that faith in God enables believers to receive whatever they ask for, provided they believe without doubting and forgive others when praying. Chief priests and elders question Jesus's authority, but he counters with a question about John's baptism that leaves them unable to answer.

day-0524.key_verse_text: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
day-0524.summary: Damascus falls to ruin while Jacob's glory diminishes like scattered grain. People turn to their Maker, forsaking idols and altars. Nations rush like waters but are rebuked and scattered. A distant land sends ambassadors; the Lord prunes branches before harvest, leaving them for birds and beasts. Eventually a gift comes to Mount Zion.

day-0598.key_verse_text: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
day-0598.summary: A man describes experiencing severe affliction and divine judgment, feeling abandoned in darkness and pain. Yet he recalls the Lord's mercies are new each morning, and he finds hope in waiting for the Lord's salvation. He calls for the Lord to see his suffering and judge his enemies.

day-0746.key_verse_text: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.
day-0746.summary: Jesus tells a parable about a vineyard owner whose servants and son are rejected and killed by farmers, then answers questions about paying taxes to Caesar and about resurrection, demonstrating that taxes belong to Caesar while devotion belongs to God, and that the dead rise to a state unlike earthly marriage.

day-0941.key_verse_text: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
day-0941.summary: God spoke to the fathers through prophets in various ways, but has now spoken through his Son in these final days. The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the image of his substance, upholding all things by his power. After purifying sins, the Son sat at the right hand of the Majesty on high, becoming superior to angels.

day-0927.key_verse_text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
day-0927.summary: The Lord remains faithful to establish and guard believers from evil. Those who refuse to work and live disorderly among the community are to be avoided until they repent, though they remain brothers deserving admonition rather than enmity. The Lord of peace grants peace to all.

day-0936.key_verse_text: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
day-0936.summary: Paul commands the proclamation of sound doctrine with patience and teaching, warning that people will turn from truth to false teachers. Paul describes completing his course faithfully and receiving a crown of righteousness, while requesting Timothy's presence and mentioning various companions and adversaries.

day-0672.key_verse_text: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says Yahweh.
day-0672.summary: The Lord sends Haggai the prophet to rebuke Zerubbabel and Joshua for neglecting the temple while dwelling in their own paneled houses. The Lord declares that drought and scarcity plague the people because the house lies waste. Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the remnant obey the Lord's voice and begin rebuilding the house on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month.

day-0794.key_verse_text: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
day-0794.summary: Jesus appears among the disciples, reassures them of his physical reality, and opens their minds to understand Scripture. He instructs them that repentance and forgiveness of sins must be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem. He then ascends into heaven, and the disciples return to Jerusalem, worshiping in the temple with great joy.

day-0809.key_verse_text: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
day-0809.summary: Jesus tells believing Jews that remaining in his word makes them true disciples and that truth sets them free. They dispute this, claiming Abraham's lineage. Jesus counters that sin creates bondage and only the Son brings true freedom. The dialogue escalates as Jesus claims preexistence before Abraham, prompting the crowd to attempt stoning him.

day-0155.key_verse_text: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,
day-0155.summary: Moses ascends Mount Nebo where the Lord shows him all the promised land from Gilead to the Western Sea, then dies at 120 years old in Moab. The children of Israel mourn him 30 days, and Joshua, filled with wisdom through Moses' laying on of hands, succeeds him as the people's leader.

day-0229.key_verse_text: David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, “Arise! Let’s flee, or else none of us will escape from Absalom. Hurry to depart, lest he overtake us quickly and bring down evil on us, and strike the city with the edge of the sword.”
day-0229.summary: Absalom gains popular support by positioning himself as a judge, then deceives David to go to Hebron where he declares himself king. David flees Jerusalem with his followers, sending priests and loyal advisors back to gather intelligence. Along the way, Shimei curses David while Absalom enters Jerusalem with Ahithophel's counsel.

day-0451.key_verse_text: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
day-0451.summary: The speaker expresses joy at going to the Lord's house in Jerusalem, a city built for the tribes to gather and give thanks. The speaker then lifts eyes heavenward, comparing watchful servants to those awaiting the Lord's mercy, having endured contempt from the proud.

day-0303.key_verse_text: For Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh’s law, and to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.
day-0303.summary: Ezra, a skilled scribe descended from Aaron, leads a group of Israelites from Babylon to Jerusalem with King Artaxerxes' authorization and generous support. After gathering Levites and procuring temple vessels and offerings, the company fasts for protection, departs safely, and delivers the treasures to Jerusalem's temple.

day-0377.key_verse_text: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
day-0377.summary: A speaker resolves to guard speech before the wicked, then grows troubled in silence. The speaker asks the Lord to reveal life's brevity and fragility, acknowledging human days as fleeting shadows. The speaker expresses hope in the Lord, requests deliverance from transgressions and divine affliction, and pleads for mercy before life ends.

day-0081.key_verse_text: Then Moses said to Aaron, “This is what Yahweh spoke of, saying, ‘I will show myself holy to those who come near me, and before all the people I will be glorified.’” Aaron held his peace.
day-0081.summary: On the eighth day, Moses directs Aaron to perform sacrifices before the Lord, and fire from the Lord consumes the offerings, causing the people to shout and fall on their faces. When Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu offer unauthorized fire, the Lord's fire devours them. Moses explains the Lord shows himself holy to those near him, and Aaron remains silent.
