day-0525.key_verse_text: because Yahweh of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”
day-0525.summary: The Lord comes against Egypt with judgment, stirring internal conflict, drying its waters, and confusing its leaders. Yet after striking Egypt, the Lord heals it, and Egypt, Assyria, and Israel become blessed peoples worshiping together. Isaiah walks naked as a sign of Egypt's coming captivity by Assyria.

day-0599.key_verse_text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Yahweh, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, under his shadow we will live among the nations.
day-0599.summary: The city's precious resources and people have been devastated by famine and war. The Lord's anger has been poured out, destroying Zion's foundations. The anointed one has been captured, and the people face pursuit and suffering. Edom will eventually face judgment while Zion's punishment reaches completion.

day-0780.key_verse_text: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can ’t be my disciple.
day-0780.summary: Jesus heals a man with dropsy on the Sabbath, then teaches about humility through parables about seating at feasts and a rejected dinner invitation. He tells his followers that discipleship requires disregarding family ties, bearing one's cross, and renouncing all possessions.

day-0673.key_verse_text: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
day-0673.summary: The Lord speaks through Haggai to the leaders and people, calling them to strength and work, promising that the rebuilt temple's latter glory will exceed its former glory and bring peace. The Lord later uses priestly instruction about holiness to show the people's uncleanness, then pledges future blessing and exaltation of Zerubbabel.

day-0912.key_verse_text: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
day-0912.summary: Christ Jesus, existing in God's form, emptied himself to take the form of a servant and humbled himself to death on a cross. God then exalted him highly, giving him the name above every name, so that every knee bows and every tongue confesses Jesus Christ as Lord.

day-0230.key_verse_text: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, “The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel.” For Yahweh had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahweh might bring evil on Absalom.
day-0230.summary: Ahithophel proposes swift pursuit of David, but Hushai counters with a strategy to gather all Israel. Absalom accepts Hushai's counsel instead. Hushai alerts David to flee across the Jordan immediately. David escapes safely while Ahithophel, seeing his advice rejected, takes his own life.

day-0304.key_verse_text: and I said, “My God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God, for our iniquities have increased over our head, and our guiltiness has grown up to the heavens.
day-0304.summary: Princes inform Ezra that the people have intermarried with foreign nations, violating separation laws. Ezra tears his garments and prays, confessing the community's guilt. The people gather and agree to put away foreign wives. A commission examines those who married foreign women, and numerous priests, Levites, and laymen are identified and agree to separate from their wives.

day-0765.key_verse_text: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.
day-0765.summary: Jesus defends his disciples' grain-plucking on the Sabbath and heals a withered hand on that day, declaring the Son of Man lord of the Sabbath. After praying all night, he selects 12 apostles. Speaking to his disciples and a large crowd, Jesus pronounces blessings on the poor, hungry, and persecuted, and pronounces woes on the rich, full, and well-spoken-of.

day-0082.key_verse_text: For I am Yahweh your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am holy. You shall not defile yourselves with any kind of creeping thing that moves on the earth. For I am Yahweh who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
day-0082.summary: The Lord instructs Moses and Aaron to tell the Israelites which animals are clean and unclean to eat. Animals with split hooves that chew cud are clean; water creatures with fins and scales are clean; certain birds and insects are forbidden. Touching carcasses of unclean animals causes uncleanness until evening, and contaminated vessels must be destroyed or washed.

day-0156.key_verse_text: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
day-0156.summary: After Moses dies, the Lord commands Joshua to lead the people across the Jordan into the promised land. The Lord assures Joshua of divine presence and success if he remains strong, courageous, and obedient to the law. Joshua then directs the officers to prepare the people for crossing within 3 days, and the tribes affirm their commitment to follow him.

day-0378.key_verse_text: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”
day-0378.summary: The speaker waited patiently for the Lord, who rescued him from a horrible pit and set his feet on solid ground. The Lord put a new song of praise in his mouth, and many witness this and trust in the Lord. The speaker delights to do the Lord's will and proclaims the Lord's righteousness and faithfulness to the assembly.

day-0747.key_verse_text: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment. The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”
day-0747.summary: A scribe asks Jesus about the greatest commandment. Jesus identifies loving the Lord with all one's heart, soul, mind, and strength as first, and loving one's neighbor as oneself as second. The scribe affirms this wisdom. Jesus then teaches about scribes who seek honor while devouring widows' houses, observing a poor widow give all she has to the treasury.

day-0526.key_verse_text: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
day-0526.summary: A prophet receives visions of coming judgments against distant nations and Jerusalem. The Lord announces Babylon's fall, warns Dumah and Arabia of upheaval, and declares Kedar's glory will fail. Jerusalem faces destruction for its unfaithfulness, yet the Lord removes the unfaithful treasurer Shebna and establishes Eliakim with authority over David's house.

day-0452.key_verse_text: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
day-0452.summary: The Lord has protected Israel from enemies who would have destroyed the people, and those who trust in the Lord remain secure like Mount Zion. The Lord surrounds his people and will not allow wickedness to prevail over the righteous, while those who turn to crooked ways face judgment.

day-0600.key_verse_text: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
day-0600.summary: The people petition the Lord to remember their suffering: their land given to strangers, their families destroyed, their bodies weakened by famine and violence, their joy replaced by mourning. They acknowledge the Lord's eternal throne while questioning why abandonment continues, then request restoration to former days.

day-0674.key_verse_text: Therefore tell them, Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
day-0674.summary: The Lord's word comes to Zechariah, calling the people to return and promising restoration. Through visions of horsemen, horns, and a measuring line, the Lord reveals plans to rebuild Jerusalem with mercy, gather the scattered people, and dwell among them as their protector and glory.

day-0748.key_verse_text: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.
day-0748.summary: Jesus tells 4 disciples that the temple will be destroyed. He warns them that many will come claiming to be him, wars and earthquakes will occur, and his followers will face persecution and be delivered to councils. The Good News must be preached to all nations before the end arrives. False christs and prophets will arise to deceive.

day-0883.key_verse_text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord ’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
day-0883.summary: Paul explains that the dead rise with transformed bodies, comparing the process to a seed that dies before becoming a living plant. The resurrected body changes from perishable to imperishable, from weakness to power, from natural to spiritual. Death's power is ultimately defeated through Jesus Christ.

day-0868.key_verse_text: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord ’s.
day-0868.summary: The passage addresses divisions over dietary practices and observance of days. Believers with different convictions about eating meat or observing certain days each act according to their faith toward the Lord. Those with stronger faith should not despise the weaker, nor should the weaker judge the stronger, since all stand accountable to God alone.

day-0231.key_verse_text: The king was much moved, and went up to the room over the gate and wept. As he went, he said, “My son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! I wish I had died instead of you, Absalom, my son, my son!”
day-0231.summary: David divides his forces into 3 groups under Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, then commands them to deal gently with Absalom. The battle rages in the forest of Ephraim; Israel's forces suffer 20,000 casualties. Absalom becomes caught in an oak tree, and Joab strikes him down. Messengers bring news to David, who learns of his son's death and grieves deeply.

day-0305.key_verse_text: Lord, I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant today, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” Now I was cup bearer to the king.
day-0305.summary: Nehemiah learns of Jerusalem's ruined walls and gates, then fasts and prays, confessing Israel's sins. The king grants his request to rebuild the city. Nehemiah inspects the walls at night, then rallies the people to reconstruct them despite opposition from local adversaries.

day-0379.key_verse_text: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
day-0379.summary: The Lord blesses those who consider the poor and delivers them in times of evil, preserving and sustaining them even through sickness. A speaker cries out for mercy and healing while enemies conspire against him, yet the Lord upholds him in integrity and raises him up, worthy of blessing forever.

day-0453.key_verse_text: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
day-0453.summary: Those returning to Zion experience joy and laughter, prompting nations to acknowledge the Lord's great works. The Lord's blessing proves essential to all human endeavors, whether building houses, guarding cities, or laboring. Children represent the Lord's heritage and reward, serving as strength in conflict.

day-0601.key_verse_text: As the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. This was the appearance of the likeness of Yahweh’s glory. When I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
day-0601.summary: Ezekiel the priest experiences a vision by the river Chebar in which the heavens open. He sees 4 living creatures with multiple faces and wings, accompanied by wheels full of eyes, moving in perfect coordination. Above them sits a throne with a figure whose appearance radiates glory like a rainbow, and Ezekiel falls on his face as a voice speaks.

day-0749.key_verse_text: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.
day-0749.summary: Following oppression, celestial signs appear as the Son of Man arrives in clouds with power and glory, sending angels to gather the chosen from all directions. The fig tree's budding signals nearness of these events. No one knows the day or hour, so constant watchfulness and prayer remain necessary.

day-0854.key_verse_text: preaching God ’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.
day-0854.summary: Paul sails to Italy as a prisoner but warns of danger during the voyage. A violent storm drives the ship for 14 days until it wrecks on Malta. All 276 aboard escape safely. Paul heals the island's sick, then travels to Rome where he spends 2 years preaching God's Kingdom and teaching about Jesus with boldness and without hindrance.

day-0083.key_verse_text: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”
day-0083.summary: The Lord instructs Moses regarding purification after childbirth. A woman bearing a male child remains unclean 7 days, then continues in purification 33 more days. A female child results in 14 days unclean, then 66 days purification. After completion, the mother brings offerings to the priest for atonement. Those unable to afford a lamb may substitute birds.

day-0527.key_verse_text: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
day-0527.summary: Tyre faces destruction and seventy years of obscurity before restoration to commerce. The Lord orchestrates widespread devastation across the earth, emptying it of inhabitants and silencing joy. Survivors emerge scattered like olive gleanings. The Lord punishes heavenly and earthly powers, gathering them as prisoners. Finally, the Lord reigns on Mount Zion while celestial bodies lose their brightness.

day-0928.key_verse_text: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.
day-0928.summary: Paul writes to Timothy at Ephesus, instructing him to prevent certain men from teaching false doctrine and myths. The goal of such commands is love from a pure heart and sincere faith. Paul describes the law's proper use and recounts his own transformation from blasphemer to apostle, illustrating Christ's patience toward sinners.

day-0675.key_verse_text: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.
day-0675.summary: An angel shows Joshua the high priest standing before the Lord with Satan as his adversary. The Lord rebukes Satan and removes Joshua's filthy garments, clothing him in rich garments. The angel assures Joshua of future blessing and describes a golden lampstand with 7 lamps and 2 olive trees, representing the Lord's Spirit empowering Zerubbabel to complete the temple.

day-0707.key_verse_text: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.
day-0707.summary: Pharisees question Jesus about his disciples' hand-washing practices. Jesus responds by contrasting God's commandments with human traditions, explaining that defilement comes from the heart rather than external practices. Later, a Canaanite woman's persistent faith moves Jesus to heal her daughter. He then feeds 4,000 people with 7 loaves and a few fish.

day-0157.key_verse_text: As soon as we had heard it, our hearts melted, and there wasn’t any more spirit in any man, because of you: for Yahweh your God, he is God in heaven above, and on earth beneath.
day-0157.summary: Joshua sends 2 spies to Jericho. They lodge with Rahab, a prostitute, who hides them from the king's men. Rahab declares that the Lord has given the land to Israel and requests protection for her family. The spies agree and escape. They return to Joshua reporting that the inhabitants fear Israel.

day-0824.key_verse_text: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”
day-0824.summary: The Jewish leaders bring Jesus to Pilate, who questions him about being King of the Jews. Jesus explains his kingdom is not of this world and exists to testify to truth. Pilate finds no charge against him but offers to release either Jesus or Barabbas according to custom. The crowd demands Barabbas's release instead.

day-0839.key_verse_text: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism; but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
day-0839.summary: Cornelius, a devout centurion, receives a vision directing him to summon Peter. Peter experiences a vision about clean and unclean foods, then meets Cornelius and declares that God shows no favoritism. As Peter preaches about Jesus, the Holy Spirit falls on the Gentiles present, and Peter orders their baptism.

day-0957.key_verse_text: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
day-0957.summary: The rich face judgment for hoarding wealth and defrauding laborers. Believers must wait patiently for the Lord's coming, avoid grumbling, and follow the prophets' example of perseverance. The sick receive healing through prayer and anointing with oil. Confession and righteous prayer prove powerfully effective, as demonstrated by Elijah's intercession.

day-0986.key_verse_text: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
day-0986.summary: A beast with 10 horns and 7 heads rises from the sea, empowered by the dragon to blaspheme God and wage war against the saints for 42 months. A second beast emerges from the earth, performing signs and compelling all people to receive a mark to buy or sell, with the number 666.

day-0306.key_verse_text: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.
day-0306.summary: Eliashib the high priest and various groups rebuild Jerusalem's walls and gates in sequential sections. The Tekoites participate in repairs, though their nobles refuse to contribute. Priests, rulers, craftsmen, and inhabitants work on different portions, from the sheep gate around to the corner.

day-0084.key_verse_text: “The leper in whom the plague is shall wear torn clothes, and the hair of his head shall hang loose. He shall cover his upper lip, and shall cry, ‘Unclean! Unclean!’ All the days in which the plague is in him he shall be unclean. He is unclean. He shall dwell alone. His dwelling shall be outside of the camp.
day-0084.summary: The Lord instructs Moses and Aaron on leprosy diagnosis and isolation procedures. Priests examine skin conditions, swellings, and marks to determine if leprosy is present, isolating suspected cases for observation periods. Those confirmed unclean wear torn clothes, cover their lips, and dwell alone outside the camp. Similar examination procedures apply to garments and leather goods showing plague signs.

day-0454.key_verse_text: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
day-0454.summary: The Lord blesses those who fear him and walk in his ways, granting them prosperity, a fruitful family, and long life. Israel testifies that despite affliction from youth, the Lord's righteousness has protected the nation, cutting the cords of the wicked while those who hate Zion wither like grass.

day-0380.key_verse_text: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.
day-0380.summary: A soul thirsts intensely for God like a deer pants for water, yet feels distant and abandoned while enemies mock and tears become daily sustenance. Despite despair and overwhelming waves of trouble, the soul repeatedly turns toward hope, remembering God's presence and resolving to praise him as the source of strength and salvation.

day-0010.key_verse_text: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing. I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
day-0010.summary: The genealogy from Shem to Terah establishes Abram's lineage. The Lord commands Abram to leave his country and relatives, promising to make him a great nation and bless all families through him. Abram departs at 75 years old with Sarai, Lot, and their possessions, entering Canaan. He builds altars at Shechem and Bethel, continuing southward.

day-0602.key_verse_text: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them from me.
day-0602.summary: The Lord commissions a prophet to speak warnings to rebellious Israel, giving him a scroll inscribed with lamentations to consume. The prophet is strengthened with a hardened face and sent to the captives by the river Chebar, where the Lord establishes him as a watchman responsible for warning both the wicked and the righteous of coming judgment.

day-0528.key_verse_text: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.
day-0528.summary: The Lord destroys enemy cities and becomes a refuge for the poor and needy. On a mountain, the Lord prepares a feast for all peoples, removes the veil covering nations, swallows up death forever, and wipes away tears. The Lord humbles Moab and brings down fortified walls to dust.

day-0158.key_verse_text: The priests who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan; and all Israel crossed over on dry ground, until all the nation had passed completely over the Jordan.
day-0158.summary: Joshua leads Israel to the Jordan River where priests bearing the ark enter the water and stand on dry ground as the waters part, allowing all the people to cross. Twelve men collect stones from the riverbed to establish a memorial, and the waters return once everyone passes over and the priests exit.

day-0942.key_verse_text: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
day-0942.summary: Jesus, made lower than angels and crowned with glory through suffering, became like his brothers to serve as a merciful high priest. Having himself suffered temptation, he is able to help those who are tempted and delivers those held in bondage by fear of death.

day-0810.key_verse_text: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.
day-0810.summary: Jesus encounters a man blind from birth and explains that his blindness reveals God's works. Jesus makes mud, anoints the man's eyes, and sends him to wash in the pool of Siloam. The man returns seeing. Neighbors and Pharisees question him, divided over whether Jesus keeps the Sabbath. The man's parents confirm his blindness but fear testifying about Jesus.

day-0795.key_verse_text: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
day-0795.summary: The Word exists from the beginning with God and is God, creating all things and giving life and light to humanity. Though the world does not recognize the Word, those who receive him gain the right to become God's children. The Word becomes flesh, full of grace and truth, surpassing all that came before.

day-0159.key_verse_text: He said, “No; but I have come now as commander of Yahweh’s army.” Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and worshiped, and asked him, “What does my lord say to his servant?”
day-0159.summary: The Lord dries up the Jordan, causing Canaanite kings to lose heart. Joshua circumcises the new generation of Israelites at Gilgal, rolling away Egypt's reproach. The people celebrate Passover and begin eating the land's produce as manna ceases. A commander of the Lord's army appears to Joshua with a drawn sword, declaring the ground holy.

day-0232.key_verse_text: David said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you should be adversaries to me today? Shall any man be put to death today in Israel? For don’t I know that I am king over Israel today?”
day-0232.summary: After Absalom's death, the king grieves deeply, shaming his servants. Joab urges him to comfort them or lose their support. The king returns to the gate, and Israel debates bringing him back. Judah sends word of his return, and various figures meet him at the Jordan, seeking his favor or offering service.

day-0233.key_verse_text: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
day-0233.summary: A Benjamite named Sheba incites Israel to rebel against David. Joab pursues him and kills Amasa, then besieges Abel of Beth Maacah. A wise woman negotiates with Joab, and the city delivers Sheba's head, ending the rebellion. Joab returns to Jerusalem, and David's officials are listed.

day-0085.key_verse_text: then the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meal offering on the altar. The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
day-0085.summary: The Lord instructs Moses on cleansing rituals for those healed of leprosy. A priest examines the person, performs ceremonies with birds, cedar wood, and hyssop, then requires offerings of lambs and flour. Provisions exist for those unable to afford full sacrifices. Similar procedures apply to houses with mildew and contaminated garments, determining cleanness or uncleanness.

day-0676.key_verse_text: and speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build Yahweh’s temple. He will build Yahweh’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.
day-0676.summary: Zechariah sees a flying scroll representing a curse against thieves and false swearers, an ephah basket containing Wickedness carried away by 2 women, and 4 chariots with horses representing the 4 winds. The Lord instructs him to crown Joshua the high priest, declaring the Branch will build the temple, bear glory, rule as priest-king, and bring peace.

day-0381.key_verse_text: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
day-0381.summary: The community recalls the Lord's past victories over nations and credits divine favor rather than human strength for their ancestors' success. Currently experiencing defeat and shame, the people affirm their faithfulness to the Lord's covenant despite crushing affliction, then appeal for the Lord to rise up and redeem them.

day-0307.key_verse_text: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”
day-0307.summary: Sanballat and his allies mock the wall-building effort and conspire to attack Jerusalem, but the builders arm themselves and continue working. Later, internal conflict arises as poorer Jews cry out against wealthy creditors exploiting them through debt and slavery, prompting the governor to confront the nobles and demand restoration of seized property.

day-0455.key_verse_text: I wait for Yahweh. My soul waits. I hope in his word.
day-0455.summary: A speaker cries from distress, asking the Lord to hear and attend to petitions. The Lord keeps no record of sins but offers forgiveness, inspiring reverence. The speaker waits for the Lord, longing intensely, and calls Israel to hope in the Lord's loving kindness and redemption. The speaker's heart remains humble and calm, like a weaned child.

day-0529.key_verse_text: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
day-0529.summary: In that day, the Lord grants salvation and peace to the righteous nation that trusts steadily in him, bringing down the lofty and exalting the humble. The Lord punishes the wicked and their adversaries, ordains peace, and restores Jacob and Israel to flourish and fill the earth with fruit, gathering the scattered people to worship at Jerusalem.

day-0011.key_verse_text: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
day-0011.summary: Abram travels to Egypt during a famine, deceives Pharaoh about Sarai's identity, and receives wealth. After leaving Egypt, Abram and Lot separate due to their possessions' size. The Lord promises Abram all the land he sees and countless offspring, then Abram settles near Hebron and builds an altar.

day-0781.key_verse_text: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
day-0781.summary: Tax collectors and sinners gather to hear Jesus speak. The Pharisees and scribes complain that he welcomes sinners and eats with them. Jesus responds with 2 parables: a shepherd who rejoices upon finding his lost sheep, and a woman who celebrates finding her lost coin, illustrating the joy in heaven over one repenting sinner.

day-0603.key_verse_text: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.
day-0603.summary: The Lord commands Ezekiel to enact symbolic sieges of Jerusalem through drawings, prolonged body positions, rationed food and water, and the burning and scattering of hair, signifying the coming judgment on Israel and Judah for their rebellion and defilement of the sanctuary, resulting in famine, pestilence, and dispersal among the nations.

day-0677.key_verse_text: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates, and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says Yahweh.
day-0677.summary: Zechariah receives a word from the Lord addressing fasting practices and calling people to execute true judgment, show kindness, and refrain from oppressing the vulnerable. The Lord promises restoration to Jerusalem, declaring it the City of Truth, and describes a future of peace, prosperity, and blessing where many nations seek the Lord.

day-0913.key_verse_text: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
day-0913.summary: The writer warns against false teachers and describes his former confidence in Jewish credentials as worthless compared to knowing Christ. He presses forward toward the goal of Christ's high calling, forgetting the past and straining toward what lies ahead, while noting that citizens of heaven await the Savior's return.

day-0898.key_verse_text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
day-0898.summary: Paul questions the Galatians about how they received the Spirit, contrasting faith with works of the law. Abraham believed God and was counted righteous; those of faith are Abraham's children and blessed with him. Christ redeems from the law's curse, bringing Abraham's blessing to the Gentiles through faith in the Spirit.

day-0904.key_verse_text: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, that no one would boast.
day-0904.summary: The passage describes how God makes alive those who were dead in transgressions and sins. God, rich in mercy and great in love, raises believers up with Christ and seats them in heavenly places. Salvation comes by grace through faith, not by works, so that no one boasts. Believers are God's workmanship, created for good works.

day-0160.key_verse_text: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.
day-0160.summary: The Lord instructs Joshua to march around Jericho with armed men and priests bearing trumpets for 6 days, then 7 times on the 7th day. When the priests blow the trumpets and the people shout, the wall collapses. The Israelites enter and destroy the city, sparing Rahab and her household, and the Lord's fame spreads throughout the land.

day-0086.key_verse_text: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”
day-0086.summary: The Lord instructs Moses and Aaron to tell the Israelites that various bodily discharges render a person unclean, along with anything the person touches or sits on. Those who contact such items must wash and bathe, remaining unclean until evening. After 7 days, the afflicted person cleanses themselves and offers sacrifices on the 8th day for atonement.

day-0382.key_verse_text: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom. You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
day-0382.summary: A poet's heart overflows with noble verses for the king, praising his excellence, majesty, and righteousness. His throne endures forever, his kingdom ruled with equity. He is anointed with gladness above his companions, and his name shall be remembered throughout all generations.

day-0308.key_verse_text: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.
day-0308.summary: Enemies attempt to intimidate the wall builder through false accusations and hired prophets, but the wall is completed in 52 days. After appointing leaders and establishing security measures, a genealogical census is recorded of those who returned from captivity, along with their possessions and contributions to the temple work.

day-0456.key_verse_text: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
day-0456.summary: David vows to find a dwelling place for the Lord and the ark. The Lord chooses Zion as his resting place, blesses it abundantly, and establishes David's throne forever if his descendants keep the covenant. Brothers dwelling together in unity are like precious oil and dew, where the Lord bestows blessing and eternal life.

day-0530.key_verse_text: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
day-0530.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment on drunken Ephraim's pride, which will be trampled underfoot like a fading flower. He offers a tested cornerstone in Zion as a foundation for those who believe. The Lord will use justice and righteousness as measuring tools against those who trust in lies and false covenants with death.

day-0604.key_verse_text: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
day-0604.summary: The Lord commands Ezekiel to prophesy destruction against Israel's mountains and idols. Sword, famine, and pestilence will devastate the land, yet a remnant escapes to remember the Lord among nations. The end comes swiftly; the Lord's wrath judges according to their ways until all recognize the Lord's sovereignty.

day-0766.key_verse_text: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
day-0766.summary: Jesus teaches listeners to love enemies, do good to those who hate them, and treat others as they wish to be treated. He contrasts genuine goodness with hypocrisy, using images of trees bearing fruit according to their nature. Those who hear and obey his words build on solid rock; those who ignore them build on unstable ground.

day-0234.key_verse_text: They buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father; and they performed all that the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer for the land.
day-0234.summary: A 3-year famine prompts David to discover that Saul's bloodshed against the Gibeonites caused it. David arranges for 7 of Saul's descendants to be executed. After Rizpah's vigil and the proper burial of Saul and Jonathan's bones, the Lord answers prayer for the land. David and his men then defeat Philistine giants in subsequent battles.

day-0678.key_verse_text: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
day-0678.summary: The Lord declares judgment against surrounding nations while promising a righteous king coming humbly on a donkey to bring peace and universal dominion. The Lord will protect the people, strengthen Judah and Joseph, and restore the scattered exiles to their land with abundant blessing.

day-0012.key_verse_text: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
day-0012.summary: Four kings wage war against five kings in the valley of Siddim. Abram hears his relative Lot has been captured, pursues the invaders with trained men, and recovers all goods and people. Melchizedek blesses Abram and receives a tenth of the spoils. The king of Sodom offers Abram the goods, but Abram refuses, keeping only what his men consumed.

day-0751.key_verse_text: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”
day-0751.summary: Jesus prays in Gethsemane, asking the Lord to remove the cup from him while submitting to the Lord's will. Judas betrays him with a kiss, and soldiers arrest him. The council questions Jesus, who affirms being the Christ. Peter denies knowing Jesus 3 times before the rooster crows twice.

day-0884.key_verse_text: Let all that you do be done in love.
day-0884.summary: Paul instructs the Corinthians to collect funds weekly for the saints in Jerusalem, outlines his travel plans through Macedonia, and requests they receive Timothy and honor those serving the saints. He closes with greetings from Asian assemblies and exhortations to stand firm in faith and conduct all matters in love.

day-0087.key_verse_text: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before Yahweh.
day-0087.summary: The Lord instructs Aaron on the Day of Atonement ritual. Aaron enters the Holy Place with sacrificial animals, makes atonement for himself and the people through blood sprinkling, and transfers Israel's sins onto a scapegoat sent into the wilderness. This annual observance on the 10th day of the 7th month cleanses the people from all their sins.

day-0013.key_verse_text: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.
day-0013.summary: The Lord appears to Abram in a vision, promising him a great reward and a biological heir despite his childlessness. Abram believes the Lord's promise, and this faith is credited to him as righteousness. The Lord then establishes a covenant, revealing that Abram's offspring will inhabit a vast land stretching from Egypt to the Euphrates.

day-0869.key_verse_text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
day-0869.summary: The strong bear the weaknesses of the weak and build up neighbors as Christ accepted all to God's glory. Christ served the circumcision to confirm promises to the fathers so Gentiles glorify God for mercy. The writer serves as a priest of the Good News to the Gentiles and greets numerous fellow workers and saints in the assemblies.

day-0309.key_verse_text: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”
day-0309.summary: The people gather to hear Ezra read the law of Moses. Levites help them understand the text, and the people weep upon hearing it. Leaders tell them the day is holy and instruct them to celebrate with food and joy. The people then observe the Feast of Booths for 7 days as commanded in the law.

day-0161.key_verse_text: Therefore the children of Israel can’t stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.
day-0161.summary: Achan takes devoted things from Jericho, bringing the Lord's anger on Israel. After Israel's defeat at Ai, Joshua discovers the transgression through tribal selection. Achan confesses to hiding a robe, silver, and gold. Joshua executes Achan and his household, and the Lord's anger turns away.

day-0235.key_verse_text: and he said: “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
day-0235.summary: David sings a song of deliverance, describing the Lord as his rock, fortress, and shield. The Lord responds to David's distress with cosmic power, descending with thunder and fire to rescue him from his enemies and bring him to a spacious place, rewarding his righteousness and faithfulness.

day-0457.key_verse_text: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
day-0457.summary: The Lord's servants who stand in his house lift their hands in praise, for the Lord is good and his name is pleasant. The Lord chose Israel as his possession, demonstrates power over creation and nations, and his name endures forever. Idols crafted by human hands lack life, while those who trust the Lord receive his compassion and blessing.

day-0383.key_verse_text: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
day-0383.summary: God serves as a refuge and strength during trouble, remaining present even when the earth shakes and waters roar. A river gladdens the city of God, where the Lord dwells and provides help. The Lord ceases wars, breaks weapons, and calls creation to stillness, declaring divine exaltation among all nations.

day-0605.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to him, “Go through the middle of the city, through the middle of Jerusalem, and set a mark on the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry over all the abominations that are done within it.”
day-0605.summary: The Lord brings Ezekiel in vision to Jerusalem, where he witnesses widespread idolatry including hidden idol worship by elders, women weeping for Tammuz, and men worshiping the sun. The Lord then sends 6 men with weapons to strike the city, marking only those who grieve over the abominations, while destroying all others without mercy.

day-0855.key_verse_text: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek. For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”
day-0855.summary: Paul introduces himself as an apostle set apart for the Good News concerning Jesus Christ, the Son of God. The Good News holds power for salvation to all who believe. God's righteousness is revealed through faith, and the righteous live by faith. God's wrath is revealed against ungodliness and unrighteousness.

day-0987.key_verse_text: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
day-0987.summary: The Lamb stands on Mount Zion with 144,000 redeemed ones bearing his name. Angels proclaim eternal Good News, call for worship of the Creator, announce Babylon's fall, and warn against worshiping the beast. A figure on a cloud reaps the earth's harvest while another gathers grapes into God's wine press of wrath.

day-0236.key_verse_text: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
day-0236.summary: David speaks his final words, declaring that the Lord's Spirit spoke through him and that a righteous ruler who fears God shines like morning light. David affirms his covenant with God is secure and eternal, while the ungodly will be destroyed. The passage then lists the names and deeds of David's mighty warriors.

day-0679.key_verse_text: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver. Yahweh said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in Yahweh’s house.
day-0679.summary: The Lord commands a shepherd to feed a flock destined for slaughter. The shepherd takes 2 staffs named Favor and Union, removes 3 shepherds, then breaks the Favor staff to nullify a covenant. The flock's poor recognize the Lord's word. The shepherd receives 30 pieces of silver as wages and throws them to the potter, then breaks the Union staff.

day-0088.key_verse_text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.
day-0088.summary: The Lord commands that all sacrifices from the house of Israel and resident foreigners must be brought to the Tent of Meeting and offered to the priest. Blood consumption is forbidden because blood represents life and serves for atonement on the altar. Those who eat blood or offer sacrifices elsewhere face being cut off from their people.

day-0531.key_verse_text: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;
day-0531.summary: The Lord pronounces woe on Ariel, describing siege and distress followed by sudden deliverance when attacking nations vanish like dreams. The people draw near with lips but remove their hearts far away, their fear taught by human commandment. The Lord will perform a marvelous work, hiding wisdom from the wise, yet the deaf will hear and the humble rejoice.

day-0458.key_verse_text: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
day-0458.summary: The psalm calls for giving thanks to the Lord, the God of gods and Lord of lords, whose loving kindness endures forever. The Lord is praised for creating the heavens and earth, making the great lights, delivering Israel from Egypt through the Red Sea, defeating mighty kings, and providing sustenance to all creatures.

day-0310.key_verse_text: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.
day-0310.summary: The children of Israel assemble in fasting and confession, with Levites reading the law and recounting the Lord's faithfulness from Abraham through the wilderness and conquest, acknowledging their repeated disobedience and the Lord's mercies. The people then seal a covenant committing to observe God's law, maintain temple worship, keep the Sabbath, and avoid intermarriage with foreigners.

day-0384.key_verse_text: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
day-0384.summary: The Lord Most High reigns over all nations and sits on his holy throne. Mount Zion stands as his city and refuge, where kings assemble and tremble before his power. The Lord establishes his city forever, and his praise extends to the ends of the earth.

day-0162.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed. Take all the warriors with you, and arise, go up to Ai. Behold, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, with his people, his city, and his land.
day-0162.summary: The Lord instructs Joshua to attack Ai with all warriors. Joshua positions 30,000 men in ambush while leading the main force to feign retreat, drawing Ai's army away from the city. The ambush force then captures and burns Ai. All 12,000 inhabitants are destroyed, the king is hanged, and Joshua builds an altar and reads the law to all Israel.

day-0014.key_verse_text: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.
day-0014.summary: Sarai gives her servant Hagar to Abram; Hagar conceives and is mistreated, then encounters the Lord's angel in the wilderness who promises her a son named Ishmael. Years later, when Abram is 99, the Lord appears and establishes an everlasting covenant, changing his name to Abraham and promising a son through Sarah. Abraham and his household are circumcised.

day-0680.key_verse_text: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.
day-0680.summary: The Lord declares that Jerusalem becomes a burdensome stone to surrounding nations who attack it, yet the Lord defends the inhabitants and pours out grace and supplication upon them. They mourn deeply for the one pierced, and afterward a fountain opens for cleansing from sin and uncleanness.

day-0532.key_verse_text: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,
day-0532.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment on rebellious people who seek counsel from Egypt rather than from God's Spirit, rejecting the prophets' warnings. Though the Lord offers salvation through returning and rest, the people refuse and will face destruction like a shattered vessel, yet afterward experience restoration, guidance, and abundance.

day-0606.key_verse_text: I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them. I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh, that they may walk in my statutes, and keep my ordinances, and do them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
day-0606.summary: Ezekiel observes the Lord's glory departing from the temple on cherubim with wheels, then encounters 25 leaders devising wickedness in Jerusalem. The Lord pronounces judgment against them through the prophet, yet promises to gather the scattered people, give them a new heart and spirit, and restore them to the land of Israel.

day-0972.key_verse_text: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.
day-0972.summary: The elder writes to Gaius, expressing joy at hearing of his faithful work and truthful walk. He commends Gaius for supporting traveling brothers and urges proper treatment of such workers. The elder also addresses Diotrephes, who refuses to receive these brothers and expels those who do, contrasting his behavior with Demetrius's good testimony.

day-0825.key_verse_text: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
day-0825.summary: Pilate flogs Jesus and allows soldiers to mock him with a crown of thorns and purple robe. Though Pilate finds no basis for charges, the chief priests demand crucifixion, claiming Jesus made himself God's Son. Jesus tells Pilate his authority comes from above. Pressured by accusations against Caesar, Pilate delivers Jesus to be crucified.

day-0958.key_verse_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
day-0958.summary: Peter addresses scattered believers across multiple regions, declaring that God's mercy has granted them rebirth into living hope through Christ's resurrection, securing an imperishable inheritance reserved in Heaven and guarded by God's power through faith until salvation's final revelation.

day-0840.key_verse_text: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
day-0840.summary: Peter recounts his vision of unclean animals and his visit to Cornelius, convincing the Jerusalem apostles that God grants repentance to Gentiles. The gospel spreads to Antioch where many believe. King Herod persecutes the assembly, killing James and imprisoning Peter, who escapes through an angel's intervention. Herod later dies after accepting divine praise. God's word continues multiplying.

day-0163.key_verse_text: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.
day-0163.summary: The kings beyond the Jordan unite to fight Israel, but Gibeon's inhabitants deceive Joshua by posing as distant ambassadors with worn provisions. Joshua's men examine the food but fail to consult the Lord before making a covenant. Only after 3 days does Israel discover the deception, yet the princes uphold the oath, making Gibeonites servants of wood and water.

day-0089.key_verse_text: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
day-0089.summary: The Lord commands the children of Israel through Moses to keep divine statutes and ordinances rather than follow the practices of Egypt or Canaan. Detailed prohibitions forbid sexual relations with close relatives, neighbors' wives, animals, and other practices the surrounding nations committed. Those who violate these laws face being cut off from their people.

day-0311.key_verse_text: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem. The rest of the people also cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
day-0311.summary: The princes settle in Jerusalem while others are chosen by lot to inhabit the holy city. Detailed lists identify the residents from Judah and Benjamin, the priests, Levites, and gatekeepers. Later, priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel are recorded, and at the wall's dedication, two processions give thanks with music and sacrifices, rejoicing greatly.

day-0896.key_verse_text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
day-0896.summary: Paul identifies himself as an apostle called through Jesus Christ and God the Father. He expresses astonishment that the Galatians are abandoning the grace of Christ for a distorted gospel. Paul emphasizes that his gospel comes through revelation of Jesus Christ, not from human sources, and recounts his transformation from persecuting God's assembly to preaching Christ among Gentiles.

day-0385.key_verse_text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
day-0385.summary: A speaker addresses all peoples, declaring that wisdom reveals how wealth cannot redeem anyone from death. The rich and poor alike perish and leave their possessions behind, yet God redeems the speaker's soul from Sheol's power and receives him, distinguishing him from those who trust only in riches.

day-0459.key_verse_text: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
day-0459.summary: Exiles by Babylon's rivers weep for Zion and refuse to sing their sacred songs for captors. A speaker later gives thanks before the gods, praising the Lord's exaltation and strength. The Lord looks after the lowly, revives those in trouble, and fulfills what concerns them, with loving kindness enduring forever.

day-0533.key_verse_text: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
day-0533.summary: The Lord condemns reliance on Egypt and horses rather than on him, promising that Assyria will fall by divine judgment. A future king will reign in righteousness, bringing justice and peace. After judgment comes restoration, when the Spirit transforms the wilderness into fruitful land and righteousness establishes lasting peace and security.

day-0015.key_verse_text: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”
day-0015.summary: The Lord appears to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre. Abraham welcomes 3 men with hospitality, providing food and rest. One visitor announces Sarah will bear a son within a year. Sarah laughs in disbelief, but the Lord questions her doubt. Abraham then intercedes with the Lord regarding Sodom's destruction, negotiating the number of righteous needed to spare the city.

day-0681.key_verse_text: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.
day-0681.summary: A day comes when nations gather against Jerusalem; the Lord fights them and stands on the Mount of Olives, splitting it in two. Living waters flow from Jerusalem, the Lord becomes King over all the earth, and survivors of the nations worship annually at the feast of booths or face drought and plague.

day-0237.key_verse_text: The king said to Araunah, “No, but I will most certainly buy it from you for a price. I will not offer burnt offerings to Yahweh my God which cost me nothing.” So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
day-0237.summary: The Lord's anger burns against Israel, prompting David to order a census. After 9 months of counting, David repents of his sin. The Lord offers 3 punishments; David chooses pestilence, which kills 70,000 men. David purchases Araunah's threshing floor for 50 shekels of silver and builds an altar, offering sacrifices until the plague stops.

day-0607.key_verse_text: “Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “None of my words will be deferred any more, but the word which I speak will be performed,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
day-0607.summary: The Lord commands Ezekiel to perform symbolic acts of exile before the rebellious house of Israel, demonstrating that the prince will be captured and scattered among nations. The Lord declares that visions will no longer be delayed and that all spoken words will be performed, ending false prophecies and prolonged expectations.

day-0943.key_verse_text: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
day-0943.summary: Jesus holds greater honor than Moses, being faithful as a Son over his house rather than as a servant. The Lord warns against hardening hearts through unbelief, as the wilderness generation did, and exhorts steadfastness in confidence until the end.

day-0090.key_verse_text: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.
day-0090.summary: The Lord commands the Israelites to be holy, instructing them to honor parents, keep the Sabbath, avoid idols, and make proper sacrifices. The Lord establishes laws regarding harvests, theft, honesty, wages, treatment of the disabled, fair judgment, and relations with neighbors, including leaving gleanings for the poor and loving neighbors as themselves.

day-0238.key_verse_text: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the Tent, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet; and all the people said, “Long live King Solomon!”
day-0238.summary: Aging King David appoints Solomon as king after learning that Adonijah has claimed the throne. David orders Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah to anoint Solomon at Gihon. Zadok anoints Solomon, the trumpet sounds, and the people celebrate. Adonijah flees to the altar in fear.

day-0164.key_verse_text: There was no day like that before it or after it, that Yahweh listened to the voice of a man; for Yahweh fought for Israel.
day-0164.summary: Five Amorite kings unite against Gibeon after learning of Joshua's victories. The Lord confuses them in battle, kills many with hailstones, and stops the sun at Joshua's command. Joshua pursues the kings, executes them, then systematically conquers their cities, destroying all inhabitants as the Lord fights for Israel.

day-0811.key_verse_text: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
day-0811.summary: The formerly blind man testifies that Jesus opened his eyes, refusing to condemn Jesus as a sinner. The Pharisees reject his account and expel him. Jesus finds the man and reveals himself as the Son of God, whom the man then believes and worships. Jesus declares that he came for judgment, and those claiming to see remain in sin.

day-0016.key_verse_text: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
day-0016.summary: 2 angels arrive in Sodom where Lot offers them hospitality. The city's men demand the visitors; the angels strike them blind and urge Lot's family to flee. The Lord destroys Sodom and Gomorrah with fire and sulfur. Lot's wife looks back and becomes salt. Lot settles in a cave with his 2 daughters, who bear sons by their father.

day-0386.key_verse_text: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
day-0386.summary: The Mighty One, God, speaks from Zion to summon the earth and judge his people. God declares that sacrifices matter less than thanksgiving and calling upon him in trouble. The Lord warns the wicked against hypocrisy and covenant-breaking, promising to rebuke those who forget God while showing salvation to those who offer thanksgiving.

day-0312.key_verse_text: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.
day-0312.summary: The people read Moses's law and separate foreign elements from Israel. A priest had improperly housed an enemy in God's house, which the narrator corrects upon returning. The narrator then enforces Sabbath observance, restores Levite provisions, addresses intermarriage with foreign nations, and cleanses the priesthood of violations.

day-0460.key_verse_text: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
day-0460.summary: The Lord knows the speaker completely, perceiving thoughts, words, and ways from all directions. No location exists beyond the Lord's presence or knowledge. The Lord formed the speaker in the womb and ordained all days. The speaker expresses gratitude for being wonderfully made and requests the Lord to examine the heart and guide toward the everlasting way.

day-0534.key_verse_text: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
day-0534.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment on destroyers and betrayers while promising salvation to the righteous. The Lord will arise and exalt himself, scattering nations and devouring the wicked with fire. The Lord serves as judge, lawgiver, and king, establishing Zion in peace and righteousness. The Lord's vengeance extends to Edom, transforming it into a desolate wasteland inhabited only by wild creatures.

day-0796.key_verse_text: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
day-0796.summary: John testifies that Jesus is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. Two disciples hear this and follow Jesus to where he stays. Andrew finds his brother Simon, who becomes Peter. Jesus calls Philip and encounters Nathanael, revealing knowledge of him before their meeting and promising greater revelations.

day-0682.key_verse_text: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.
day-0682.summary: The Lord declares love for Israel through Malachi, contrasting favor toward Jacob with rejection of Esau. The Lord rebukes the priests for offering defiled sacrifices and despising the Lord's name through contemptible worship. Despite their unfaithfulness, the Lord's name remains great among all nations, receiving pure offerings everywhere.

day-0608.key_verse_text: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only their own souls by their righteousness,” says the Lord Yahweh.
day-0608.summary: The Lord condemns false prophets and prophetesses who deceive Israel with lies and visions of peace. He declares judgment against those who lead people astray through divination and magic. Even the righteous cannot save others from coming judgment; only their own souls are delivered by their righteousness. Jerusalem's inhabitants are like useless vine wood fit only for fire.

day-0929.key_verse_text: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus, who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,
day-0929.summary: Prayers and intercessions are made for all people, including leaders, so that peaceful lives may be lived in godliness. Christ Jesus serves as the sole mediator between God and humanity, having given himself as a ransom for all. Overseers and servants in God's assembly must demonstrate specific virtues and character qualities befitting their roles.

day-0914.key_verse_text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
day-0914.summary: The passage calls believers to stand firm in the Lord, rejoice always, and present requests to God through prayer with thanksgiving rather than anxiety. God's peace guards hearts and minds in Christ Jesus. Believers think on virtuous things, practice contentment in all circumstances, and share in one another's needs.

day-0767.key_verse_text: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.
day-0767.summary: Jesus enters Capernaum and heals a centurion's servant through faith. He raises a widow's dead son at Nain, prompting crowds to glorify God. John's disciples ask if Jesus is the coming one; Jesus describes his works of healing and preaching good news to the poor, then praises John as the greatest prophet.

day-0782.key_verse_text: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.
day-0782.summary: A man's younger son requests his inheritance early, then squanders it in a distant land. Facing starvation, the son returns home to ask forgiveness. His father welcomes him with joy and celebration, while the elder son, angry at this reception, refuses to join the festivities.

day-0899.key_verse_text: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!” So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
day-0899.summary: An heir under guardianship remains like a bondservant until maturity. God sent his Son to redeem those under the law and grant adoption as children. The Spirit of the Son cries "Abba, Father" in their hearts, making them heirs rather than bondservants.

day-0091.key_verse_text: You shall be holy to me, for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.
day-0091.summary: The Lord commands Moses to communicate laws regarding prohibited practices and relationships. Those who sacrifice offspring to Molech, consult mediums, commit adultery, engage in sexual perversions, or curse parents face death. The Lord declares the people must be holy and keep statutes so the land does not reject them, having separated them from other nations.

day-0165.key_verse_text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
day-0165.summary: Multiple Canaanite kings unite against Israel at the waters of Merom. The Lord assures Joshua of victory, and Israel defeats them decisively, destroying their horses and chariots. Joshua systematically conquers all the kings and cities of Canaan, distributing the land to the tribes of Israel according to the Lord's command to Moses.

day-0017.key_verse_text: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.
day-0017.summary: Abraham deceives Abimelech about Sarah, but the Lord protects her through a dream warning. After restoration and prayer, Sarah conceives and bears Isaac. When Hagar's son mocks Isaac, Abraham sends them away; the Lord sustains Hagar and her child in the wilderness. Abraham and Abimelech establish a covenant at Beersheba.

day-0239.key_verse_text: and keep the instruction of Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, his commandments, his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself.
day-0239.summary: David instructs Solomon to keep the Lord's commandments and laws, then dies after reigning 40 years. Solomon consolidates power by executing Adonijah and Joab, removing Abiathar as priest, and executing Shimei for breaking oath. Solomon's kingdom becomes firmly established.

day-0535.key_verse_text: Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
day-0535.summary: The wilderness transforms into a blooming garden as the blind see, the deaf hear, and the lame leap. Waters flow through the desert, and a holy highway appears where the redeemed walk safely. The Lord's ransomed ones return to Zion singing, their heads crowned with everlasting joy as sorrow flees away.

day-0461.key_verse_text: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
day-0461.summary: The speaker petitions the Lord for deliverance from violent and deceitful enemies who devise traps and speak poison. The speaker affirms trust in the Lord's protection and justice, then requests that the Lord guard speech and heart from wickedness while keeping the speaker safe from snares set by evildoers.

day-0387.key_verse_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
day-0387.summary: A petitioner appeals to God for mercy and cleansing from transgressions, acknowledging sin's constant presence and its offense against God alone. The petitioner requests purification, restoration of joy, and renewal of spirit, promising to teach others God's ways. God desires truth and a broken heart rather than sacrificial offerings.

day-0313.key_verse_text: for he sent letters into all the king’s provinces, into every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.
day-0313.summary: King Ahasuerus hosts lavish feasts displaying his wealth across 127 provinces. When Queen Vashti refuses his command to appear, the king consults his wise men. Memucan advises that her disobedience threatens all husbands' authority, so the king issues a decree removing Vashti and establishing that men rule their households in their own languages.

day-0609.key_verse_text: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
day-0609.summary: The Lord describes Jerusalem's origins as abandoned and helpless, then rescued, clothed, and beautified through covenant. Jerusalem betrays this covenant through prostitution and idolatry, prompting judgment through enemies. Despite this unfaithfulness, the Lord promises to remember the original covenant and establish an everlasting one, restoring Jerusalem and bringing shame and knowledge of forgiveness.

day-0683.key_verse_text: One who hates and divorces ”, says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.
day-0683.summary: The Lord addresses priests, warning that failure to honor his name brings curses and rebuke. Priests are called to uphold truth and turn people from iniquity, yet they have corrupted the covenant. The Lord condemns treachery in marriage and false worship, declaring that those who hate and divorce cover themselves with violence.

day-0885.key_verse_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
day-0885.summary: Paul and Timothy greet the assembly at Corinth, blessing God as the Father of mercies and God of all comfort who comforts believers in affliction so they may comfort others. The sufferings and comfort of Christ abound together, and God's promises find their fulfillment in Jesus Christ, who establishes and seals believers with the Spirit.

day-0018.key_verse_text: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
day-0018.summary: God tests Abraham by commanding him to offer his son Isaac as a burnt offering. Abraham obeys, but the Lord's angel stops him before he kills the boy, revealing a ram caught in a thicket to sacrifice instead. The Lord then blesses Abraham with countless offspring and promises that all nations will be blessed through his descendants.

day-0092.key_verse_text: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,
day-0092.summary: The Lord establishes regulations for priests regarding defilement, marriage, physical defects, and handling of holy things. Priests must maintain ritual purity and avoid profaning the Lord's name. Offerings must be unblemished animals, and specific procedures govern their preparation and consumption.

day-0166.key_verse_text: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”
day-0166.summary: Joshua, now aged, receives instruction from the Lord to divide remaining unconquered lands among 9 tribes and half of Manasseh. Moses had already allocated territory east of the Jordan to Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh. The Levites receive no land inheritance but the Lord's offerings. Caleb requests the hill country, and Joshua grants him Hebron.

day-0240.key_verse_text: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
day-0240.summary: Solomon sacrifices at Gibeon where the Lord appears in a dream and offers him anything. Solomon requests an understanding heart to judge the people wisely. God grants him wisdom, riches, and honor, then conditions his reign on obedience. Solomon later demonstrates his wisdom by discerning the true mother of a disputed child.

day-0314.key_verse_text: The king loved Esther more than all the women, and she obtained favor and kindness in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown on her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.
day-0314.summary: King Ahasuerus seeks a new queen to replace Vashti. Beautiful young virgins are gathered, including Esther, a Jewish orphan raised by her cousin Mordecai. Esther finds favor with everyone and the king loves her most, making her queen. Mordecai later discovers an assassination plot against the king and reports it through Esther.

day-0388.key_verse_text: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.
day-0388.summary: A speaker condemns a deceitful person who boasts in evil and trusts in riches rather than God, contrasting this with personal trust in the Lord's kindness. The passage then describes widespread human corruption and the Lord's examination of humanity, concluding with hope for Israel's restoration and rejoicing.

day-0870.key_verse_text: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
day-0870.summary: Paul addresses the assembly at Corinth, thanking God for their enrichment in Christ. He urges unity against divisions forming around different leaders. The message of Christ crucified appears foolish to the world, yet God's apparent foolishness proves wiser and stronger than human wisdom and strength.

day-0462.key_verse_text: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.
day-0462.summary: A distressed person cries to the Lord for mercy, describing enemies who pursue and persecute, overwhelming circumstances, and isolation.
