The petitioner appeals for deliverance, remembers the Lord's past faithfulness, and requests guidance and revival, trusting in the Lord's loving kindness and righteousness.

day-0536.key_verse_text: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, who is enthroned among the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.
day-0536.summary: In the 14th year of Hezekiah's reign, Sennacherib's Assyrian forces capture Judah's fortified cities and demand Jerusalem's surrender through Rabshakeh's taunts. Hezekiah seeks Isaiah's counsel, who assures him the Lord will protect the city. The Lord's angel destroys 185,000 Assyrian soldiers, and Sennacherib returns to Nineveh, where his sons assassinate him.

day-0752.key_verse_text: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.
day-0752.summary: The chief priests deliver Jesus to Pilate, who questions him while perceiving envy as the motive. The crowd, stirred by the chief priests, demands crucifixion over releasing Barabbas. Pilate grants their request, and soldiers flog Jesus, mock him with purple garments and a thorns crown, then crucify him at Golgotha between 2 robbers while passersby and chief priests mock him.

day-0856.key_verse_text: For there is no partiality with God.
day-0856.summary: Those who judge others condemn themselves by practicing the same things. God judges according to truth without partiality, repaying each person according to their works. Doers of the law are justified, not merely hearers. True identity as a Jew is inward and of the heart, not outward observance alone.

day-0019.key_verse_text: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
day-0019.summary: Sarah dies at age 127 in Hebron. Abraham requests a burial place from the Hittites, identifying himself as a stranger and foreigner. Ephron offers his field and cave freely, but Abraham insists on paying the full price of 400 shekels of silver. The transaction is completed, and Abraham buries Sarah in the cave of Machpelah.

day-0988.key_verse_text: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations. Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
day-0988.summary: John sees 7 angels with the final plagues through which God's wrath is completed. Those who overcame the beast stand on a sea of glass with harps, singing praise to God's greatness and righteousness. The heavenly temple opens, and the angels emerge clothed in linen with golden sashes, receiving bowls of God's wrath from one of the 4 living creatures.

day-0093.key_verse_text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
day-0093.summary: The Lord commands Moses to instruct Israel about the appointed feasts: the Sabbath, Passover, unleavened bread, first fruits, Pentecost, the memorial of blowing of trumpets, the day of atonement, and the feast of booths. Each observance includes specific offerings and work restrictions throughout the year.

day-0684.key_verse_text: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.
day-0684.summary: The Lord sends a messenger to prepare the way before him and will come suddenly to his temple as a refiner's fire to purify offerings. The Lord judges those who practice sorcery, adultery, perjury, and oppression. Those who return and bring tithes receive blessings, while the wicked face burning. The righteous who fear the Lord's name experience healing and restoration.

day-0167.key_verse_text: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
day-0167.summary: The tribe of Judah receives its territorial allotment with borders extending from the Salt Sea to the Mediterranean, encompassing southern and central regions. Caleb drives out the 3 sons of Anak from Hebron, and Othniel captures Debir and receives Caleb's daughter as wife. The passage lists Judah's numerous cities across different regions, though the Jebusites remain in Jerusalem.

day-0389.key_verse_text: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
day-0389.summary: A speaker calls on God for salvation and vindication against violent enemies who reject God. The speaker affirms that God serves as helper and sustainer, will repay enemies, and expresses intention to offer sacrifices and thanks, having experienced deliverance and victory.

day-0463.key_verse_text: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
day-0463.summary: The Lord trains hands for battle and serves as refuge, fortress, and shield. Though humans are fleeting like breath and shadows, the Lord is asked to descend, scatter enemies with lightning, and rescue from foreigners who speak deceit. A new song rises in praise, and the blessed people are those whose God is the Lord.

day-0241.key_verse_text: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, as Yahweh spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’
day-0241.summary: Solomon establishes his kingdom with 12 officers managing provisions across Israel. God grants him exceptional wisdom, surpassing all surrounding nations. Hiram of Tyre agrees to supply cedar and cypress timber, and Solomon organizes a massive labor force of thousands to prepare materials and cut stones for building the house for the Lord's name.

day-0610.key_verse_text: For I have no pleasure in the death of him who dies,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Therefore turn yourselves, and live!
day-0610.summary: The Lord presents a riddle about 2 eagles and a vine to illustrate Judah's covenant breach with Babylon and Egypt. The Lord then declares that individual souls bear responsibility for their own sins, not their parents'. The righteous live, the wicked die, yet the wicked who repent will live, and the righteous who turn to wickedness will die.

day-0537.key_verse_text: Behold, for peace I had great anguish, but you have in love for my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption; for you have cast all my sins behind your back.
day-0537.summary: Hezekiah receives a terminal diagnosis from Isaiah but prays earnestly, and the Lord grants him 15 additional years with a miraculous sign. After recovering, Hezekiah welcomes Babylonian envoys and displays his treasures, prompting Isaiah to prophesy that Babylon will eventually plunder Judah's wealth and take royal descendants into captivity.

day-0685.key_verse_text: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
day-0685.summary: The genealogy of Jesus Christ traces his lineage from Abraham through David to Joseph. Mary becomes pregnant by the Holy Spirit before marrying Joseph. An angel instructs Joseph to name the son Jesus, who will save his people from their sins. Joseph obeys and takes Mary as his wife, and she gives birth to Jesus.

day-0315.key_verse_text: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows if you haven’t come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
day-0315.summary: King Ahasuerus promotes Haman, who becomes enraged when Mordecai refuses to bow. Haman persuades the king to issue a decree destroying all Jews on the thirteenth of Adar. Mordecai informs Esther of the plot and urges her to petition the king. Esther agrees to approach the king and requests the Jews fast for 3 days.

day-0611.key_verse_text: Fire has gone out of its branches. It has devoured its fruit, so that there is in it no strong branch to be a scepter to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.”
day-0611.summary: The Lord directs a lamentation for Israel's princes, comparing the nation's mother to a lioness whose cubs become mighty lions but are captured by foreign nations. The mother is then likened to a vine planted by waters, growing strong branches, but plucked up in fury, dried by the east wind, and consumed by fire, leaving no strong branch to rule.

day-0841.key_verse_text: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”
day-0841.summary: The assembly at Antioch sends Barnabas and Saul by the Holy Spirit's direction. They travel to Cyprus and Pamphylia, encountering a sorcerer whose blindness convinces a proconsul. Paul then addresses a synagogue in Pisidia, proclaiming Jesus as the promised salvation. Gentiles respond with gladness while jealous Jews oppose them, prompting Paul and Barnabas to turn toward the Gentiles.

day-0959.key_verse_text: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
day-0959.summary: Believers put away wickedness and grow in spiritual nourishment, coming to Jesus as a living stone. They form a holy priesthood and chosen race called to proclaim God's excellence. They abstain from fleshly desires, conduct themselves honorably among nations, submit to authorities, and endure suffering as Christ did, following his example of righteousness.

day-0826.key_verse_text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
day-0826.summary: Jesus is crucified at Golgotha between 2 criminals while soldiers divide his garments by lot. His mother and disciples stand nearby. After declaring his thirst and receiving vinegar, Jesus announces "It is finished" and dies. A soldier pierces his side; Joseph and Nicodemus prepare his body for burial in a nearby garden tomb.

day-0973.key_verse_text: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy, to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
day-0973.summary: Jude writes to the called and sanctified, urging them to contend for the faith against ungodly men who distort grace and deny Jesus Christ. He describes their corruption through historical examples of judgment and characterizes them as divisive, sensual, and lacking the Spirit. The letter concludes with doxology ascribing glory to God.

day-0168.key_verse_text: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;
day-0168.summary: The children of Joseph receive their tribal inheritance divided between Ephraim and Manasseh, with detailed boundary descriptions from the Jordan to the sea. Zelophehad's daughters receive land portions, and the tribes fail to fully drive out Canaanite inhabitants. Joshua directs Joseph's descendants to expand into forested hill country despite Canaanite opposition.

day-0316.key_verse_text: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.
day-0316.summary: Esther gains the king's favor and invites him and Haman to banquets. Haman grows angry at Mordecai and prepares a gallows. The king discovers Mordecai's past service, honors him instead, and Haman's plan unravels. At the second banquet, Esther reveals Haman as the enemy threatening her people, and the king orders Haman hanged on the gallows he built.

day-0390.key_verse_text: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
day-0390.summary: The speaker cries out to God in anguish over enemies and betrayal, experiencing terror and longing for escape. A close companion has turned against the speaker with deceptive words. The speaker calls on the Lord for salvation, affirming that God sustains the righteous and will judge the wicked.

day-0242.key_verse_text: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.
day-0242.summary: Solomon begins building the Lord's house in the 480th year after Israel's exodus, constructing a 60-by-20-by-30-cubit structure with cedar, cypress, and gold. The Lord speaks to Solomon, promising to dwell among Israel if Solomon keeps the Lord's statutes and commandments. The construction takes 7 years to complete.

day-0464.key_verse_text: Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.
day-0464.summary: The psalmist declares intention to praise God daily and forever, describing God's greatness, mercy, and righteousness. God's works span generations, God sustains all creatures, answers those who call truthfully, and preserves those who love him while destroying the wicked.

day-0538.key_verse_text: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
day-0538.summary: God commands comfort for Jerusalem, announcing her warfare is finished and sins pardoned. A voice cries to prepare the Lord's way in the wilderness. The Lord's glory shall be revealed to all flesh. Though grass withers, God's word stands forever. The Lord comes as a mighty shepherd, incomparably great and sustaining the weak with renewed strength.

day-0686.key_verse_text: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
day-0686.summary: Wise men from the east follow a star to Jerusalem seeking the newborn King of the Jews. King Herod, troubled by this news, directs them to Bethlehem. The star guides them to Jesus, whom they worship and present with gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Warned in a dream, they return home by another route.

day-0020.key_verse_text: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
day-0020.summary: Abraham's elderly servant journeys to Mesopotamia to find a wife for Isaac, setting a sign involving water. Rebekah appears and fulfills the sign perfectly. Her family consents to the union, and the servant returns with Rebekah to Isaac, who takes her as his wife.

day-0797.key_verse_text: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
day-0797.summary: At a wedding in Cana, Jesus transforms water into wine when the supply runs out. Later in Jerusalem during Passover, he clears the temple of merchants and money changers. Many observe his signs and believe, though Jesus does not fully trust them, knowing human nature completely.

day-0812.key_verse_text: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
day-0812.summary: Jesus describes a shepherd who enters the sheep fold by the door, calls his sheep by name, and leads them out as they follow his voice. He identifies himself as the door and the good shepherd who lays down his life for the sheep, contrasting himself with thieves, robbers, and hired hands. His words divide the crowd.

day-0944.key_verse_text: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
day-0944.summary: The passage describes God's rest as an ongoing promise available to believers through faith. The word of God penetrates human hearts and thoughts, discerning intentions. Jesus, the great high priest, has experienced temptation without sin and stands ready to offer mercy and grace to those who approach God's throne.

day-0094.key_verse_text: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
day-0094.summary: The Lord commands the children of Israel to provide pure olive oil for a continual lamp and to prepare 12 cakes of fine flour with frankincense for the table before the Lord. Aaron and his sons eat this bread in a holy place. The Lord also establishes laws regarding blasphemy, murder, and injury, requiring equal punishment for all people.

day-0169.key_verse_text: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?
day-0169.summary: The congregation assembles at Shiloh where Joshua urges 7 tribes to possess their allotted land. He directs 3 men from each tribe to survey the territory, divide it into 7 portions, and report back. Joshua casts lots before the Lord and distributes the land, with Benjamin's inheritance detailed by its borders and 26 cities.

day-0095.key_verse_text: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
day-0095.summary: The Lord commands Israel to observe a Sabbath year every 7 years when the land rests, and a jubilee year every 50 years when property returns to original owners, debts are forgiven, and enslaved Israelites go free. Land transactions and redemptions follow specific rules based on years remaining until jubilee.

day-0243.key_verse_text: Thus all the work that King Solomon did in Yahweh’s house was finished. Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the vessels—and put them in the treasuries of Yahweh’s house.
day-0243.summary: Solomon constructs his palace over 13 years with elaborate cedar and stone structures, then commissions Hiram to craft bronze pillars, a molten sea, 10 bases, and basins for the Lord's house. Solomon also makes golden altar, table, lampstands, and vessels. All work finishes as Solomon deposits David's dedicated treasures in the Lord's house treasury.

day-0391.key_verse_text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
day-0391.summary: A speaker under attack by numerous enemies requests God's mercy and protection. Despite fear and constant opposition, the speaker declares trust in God and confidence that enemies will be defeated. God records the speaker's suffering and has delivered the soul from death.

day-0465.key_verse_text: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God,
day-0465.summary: The psalmist calls for praise of the Lord, who alone deserves trust and provides help to those in need. The Lord executes justice, feeds the hungry, frees prisoners, and heals the broken-hearted. The Lord governs creation, strengthens Jerusalem, and shows favor to those who fear and hope in his loving kindness.

day-0612.key_verse_text: Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
day-0612.summary: Elders of Israel come seeking the Lord, but the Lord refuses to be inquired of by them. The Lord recounts Israel's rebellion from Egypt through the wilderness, repeatedly rejecting statutes and profaning Sabbaths despite warnings. The Lord promises to gather the scattered people, judge them, and ultimately accept them in the holy mountain when they know the Lord's name.

day-0539.key_verse_text: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
day-0539.summary: The Lord summons the nations to present their case and declares his sovereignty over history, having raised up a conqueror from the east. Israel, chosen as the Lord's servant, receives assurance of divine strength and protection against enemies. The Lord promises to transform the wilderness into abundance and demonstrates superiority over all other gods and idols.

day-0613.key_verse_text: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
day-0613.summary: The Lord commands Ezekiel to prophesy judgment against Jerusalem and Israel through vivid imagery of a sharpened sword. The Babylonian king will attack Judah and the Ammonites. Jerusalem stands guilty of bloodshed, idolatry, corruption among princes and priests, and oppression of the vulnerable. The Lord finds no one to intercede and pours out wrath upon the land.

day-0783.key_verse_text: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”
day-0783.summary: Jesus teaches that no servant can serve two masters, illustrating through parables how faithfulness in small matters determines trustworthiness in greater ones. The rich man and Lazarus story demonstrates the reversal of earthly fortunes in the afterlife, with Abraham explaining that those who reject Moses and the prophets will not be convinced even by resurrection.

day-0930.key_verse_text: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
day-0930.summary: The Spirit warns that some will abandon the faith by heeding deceptive spirits and false doctrines promoted by hypocritical liars. God created all things good to be received with thanksgiving. A servant of Christ instructs others in sound doctrine while refusing worldly fables and pursuing godliness, which holds value for both present and future life.

day-0317.key_verse_text: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.
day-0317.summary: King Ahasuerus grants Esther Haman's house and empowers Mordecai and the Jews to defend themselves against their enemies on the thirteenth day of Adar. The Jews gather in their cities, defeat those who oppose them, and establish the festival of Purim to commemorate their deliverance. Mordecai rises to prominence in the kingdom.

day-0687.key_verse_text: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
day-0687.summary: John the Baptizer preaches repentance in the wilderness of Judea, baptizing people who confess their sins in the Jordan. He rebukes the Pharisees and Sadducees, declaring that one mightier than himself comes after him. Jesus arrives and is baptized by John, after which the heavens open, the Spirit descends as a dove, and a voice declares Jesus the beloved Son.

day-0915.key_verse_text: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love, in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
day-0915.summary: Paul and Timothy write to the saints at Colossae, giving thanks for their faith in Christ Jesus and love toward all saints. The Gospel bears fruit and grows among them. The Lord has delivered believers from darkness into the Kingdom of the Son, providing redemption and forgiveness of sins.

day-0768.key_verse_text: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
day-0768.summary: A sinful woman anoints Jesus' feet with ointment while he dines at a Pharisee's house. Jesus tells Simon a parable about forgiveness and debt, then contrasts Simon's coldness with the woman's devotion. Jesus declares her sins forgiven and tells her that her faith has saved her.

day-0900.key_verse_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
day-0900.summary: Paul exhorts the Galatians to stand firm in the freedom Christ provides and warns against returning to circumcision and law-keeping, which nullify grace. Walking by the Spirit produces love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control, while the flesh produces adultery, hatred, jealousy, and similar deeds that exclude from God's Kingdom.

day-0022.key_verse_text: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”
day-0022.summary: During a famine, Isaac settles in Gerar and deceives the king about Rebekah's identity. The Lord blesses Isaac's crops abundantly, causing Philistine envy. After disputes over wells, the Lord appears to Isaac at Beersheba, reaffirming the covenant with Abraham. Abimelech seeks a peace treaty, which Isaac accepts.

day-0096.key_verse_text: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.
day-0096.summary: The Lord establishes a covenant with Israel, promising blessings for obedience to statutes and commandments, including abundant harvests, peace, and military victory. Disobedience brings progressive curses: disease, famine, defeat, and exile. Yet even in exile, if the people confess their iniquity, the Lord remembers the covenant and does not utterly reject them.

day-0170.key_verse_text: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
day-0170.summary: The tribes of Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Dan receive their territorial inheritances by lot, with specific cities and borders designated for each. Joshua receives Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim. Eleazar the priest and Joshua complete the land distribution before the Lord at Shiloh.

day-0021.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”
day-0021.summary: Abraham marries Keturah and fathers 6 sons, then dies at 175 years old. Isaac inherits Abraham's wealth while other sons receive gifts and are sent away. Isaac's wife Rebekah conceives twins after prayer. The Lord tells her the elder will serve the younger. Esau is born first, Jacob second. Jacob later trades stew for Esau's birthright.

day-0318.key_verse_text: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be Yahweh’s name.”
day-0318.summary: Job, a blameless and wealthy man with 10 children, faces catastrophic losses when Satan challenges his faith. Messengers report the destruction of his livestock and the death of all his children. Job tears his robe and worships, acknowledging the Lord's sovereignty. Satan then afflicts Job with painful sores, and his three friends arrive to sit with him in silence.

day-0392.key_verse_text: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies. Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
day-0392.summary: The speaker seeks God's mercy and refuge from pursuers, describing enemies as fierce and dangerous. God sends salvation and rebukes the adversaries. The speaker's heart remains steadfast, and the speaker resolves to sing praises and give thanks to God among the peoples, declaring that God's loving kindness and truth reach to the heavens.

day-0466.key_verse_text: Let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
day-0466.summary: All creation from the heavens to the earth praises the Lord, whose name alone is exalted and whose glory surpasses the earth and heavens. Israel rejoices in their Maker and King, dancing and singing praises, for the Lord takes pleasure in his people and crowns the humble with salvation.

day-0540.key_verse_text: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.
day-0540.summary: God presents a servant chosen and upheld, upon whom the Spirit rests, who will bring justice to the nations quietly and faithfully without breaking the bruised or quenching the dim. The Lord calls this servant in righteousness to be a covenant and light for the peoples, opening blind eyes and freeing prisoners from darkness.

day-0614.key_verse_text: They will recompense your lewdness on you, and you will bear the sins of your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.’”
day-0614.summary: The Lord describes 2 sisters, Oholah and Oholibah, who prostituted themselves to foreign nations and their idols. The Lord delivers them to their lovers for judgment, stripping them, destroying their possessions, and executing them. Their lewdness ceases, and they bear the consequences of their idolatry.

day-0688.key_verse_text: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”
day-0688.summary: Jesus is led by the Spirit into the wilderness and fasts for 40 days. The devil tempts him 3 times: to turn stones into bread, to jump from the temple, and to worship him in exchange for all kingdoms. Jesus resists each temptation by citing Scripture. The devil departs, and angels serve Jesus.

day-0753.key_verse_text: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”
day-0753.summary: Darkness covers the land as Jesus cries out in anguish at the ninth hour, then dies. The temple veil tears, and a centurion declares Jesus the Son of God. Women watch from afar as Joseph of Arimathaea obtains the body, wraps it in linen, and places it in a rock tomb, which he seals with a stone.

day-0244.key_verse_text: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!
day-0244.summary: Solomon assembles Israel's leaders and people to bring the ark of the covenant into the temple's inner sanctuary. After the priests place the ark, the Lord's glory fills the house in a cloud. Solomon then stands before the altar and offers an extended prayer, acknowledging the Lord's greatness while requesting divine attention to prayers made toward this place.

day-0245.key_verse_text: As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,
day-0245.summary: The Lord appears to Solomon after the temple's completion, promising an eternal throne if Solomon walks in integrity and obedience, but warning of exile and ruin if he turns to other gods. Solomon builds cities, establishes trade routes, and receives the queen of Sheba, whose visit confirms his legendary wisdom and wealth, which exceeds all other kings.

day-0886.key_verse_text: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
day-0886.summary: Paul explains his decision to visit without bringing sorrow, having written a previous letter from deep affliction to demonstrate his love. The congregation should forgive and comfort the one who caused grief, confirming their love toward him. God leads in triumph through Christ, revealing knowledge's sweet aroma everywhere.

day-0023.key_verse_text: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
day-0023.summary: Aging Isaac instructs Esau to hunt venison so he may bless him before death. Rebekah overhears, directs Jacob to deceive his father with prepared goats and borrowed clothing. Isaac, deceived by the disguise, blesses Jacob with abundance and dominion. Esau returns too late, discovers the deception, and Rebekah sends Jacob away to escape his brother's murderous rage.

day-0171.key_verse_text: Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
day-0171.summary: The Lord commands Joshua to establish 6 cities of refuge where those who kill unintentionally may flee from blood avengers until trial. The Levites receive 48 cities with pasture lands distributed by lot among the tribes. The Lord fulfills all promises made to Israel's fathers, giving them the land and rest from enemies.

day-0097.key_verse_text: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.
day-0097.summary: The Lord establishes valuations for persons, animals, houses, and fields dedicated through vows, with priests determining assessments based on age, gender, and condition. Redemption requires adding a fifth of the valuation. Firstborn animals, permanently devoted items, and tithes of land and herds belong entirely to the Lord and cannot be exchanged or redeemed.

day-0467.key_verse_text: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
day-0467.summary: The passage calls for praise of God in his sanctuary and heavens, celebrating his mighty acts and excellent greatness. Praise occurs through various instruments including trumpet, harp, lyre, tambourine, stringed instruments, flute, and cymbals, accompanied by dancing. Everything that has breath is summoned to praise God.

day-0393.key_verse_text: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
day-0393.summary: The psalmist questions whether leaders speak righteousness and judge fairly, then declares that the wicked plot injustice from birth and speak lies. The psalmist calls on God to destroy them, and when vengeance comes, the righteous rejoice, confirming that God judges the earth and rewards righteousness.

day-0319.key_verse_text: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.
day-0319.summary: Job curses the day of his birth, wishing darkness upon it and longing for death. He questions why he survived birth and expresses that death would bring rest like kings and prisoners experience. Job describes his suffering: sighing before eating, groaning like water, and the very fears he dreads coming upon him.

day-0541.key_verse_text: But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel, says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
day-0541.summary: The Lord declares that Jacob and Israel are redeemed and called by name. The Lord promises protection through waters and fire, offers Egypt and Ethiopia as ransom, and gathers offspring from distant lands. The Lord establishes Israel as witnesses to divine uniqueness and power, promising new things in the wilderness while blotting out transgressions.

day-0689.key_verse_text: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
day-0689.summary: Jesus withdraws to Galilee after hearing of John's arrest and settles in Capernaum, fulfilling Isaiah's prophecy. He begins preaching repentance as the Kingdom of Heaven approaches. Jesus calls 4 fishermen—Simon Peter, Andrew, James, and John—to follow him. He teaches in synagogues, preaches the Good News, and heals diseases and demons. Large crowds from surrounding regions gather to follow him.

day-0708.key_verse_text: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
day-0708.summary: The Pharisees and Sadducees request a sign, but Jesus refuses and departs. The disciples misunderstand his warning about their teaching as concern for bread. Jesus asks who the disciples believe he is, and Simon Peter declares him the Christ, the Son of the living God. Jesus affirms Peter and announces his coming suffering and resurrection.

day-0857.key_verse_text: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God; being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
day-0857.summary: The passage establishes that all humanity has sinned and falls short of God's glory, yet God offers justification freely through grace and redemption in Christ Jesus. This righteousness comes through faith rather than works of the law, applying equally to both Jews and Gentiles who believe.

day-0024.key_verse_text: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
day-0024.summary: Isaac blesses Jacob and sends him to Paddan Aram to find a wife, while Esau takes an additional wife from Ishmael's line. During his journey, Jacob dreams of a stairway to heaven with ascending and descending angels, and the Lord promises to be with him and give him the land and countless offspring.

day-0098.key_verse_text: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one, from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.
day-0098.summary: The Lord commands Moses to conduct a census of all Israelite males aged 20 and older able to go to war, with 12 tribal leaders assisting. Moses and Aaron count the tribes, recording their numbers. The total reaches 603,550 men. The Levites are excluded from this count and instead assigned to care for the Tabernacle.

day-0989.key_verse_text: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”
day-0989.summary: Seven angels pour out bowls of God's wrath upon the earth, causing sores, blood in waters, scorching heat, darkness, and drying of the Euphrates. Demon spirits gather kings for battle at Harmagedon. The seventh bowl brings a massive earthquake, destroying cities and Babylon, with great hailstones falling on people.

day-0615.key_verse_text: “‘“I, Yahweh, have spoken it. It will happen, and I will do it. I won’t go back. I won’t spare. I won’t repent. According to your ways and according to your doings, they will judge you,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
day-0615.summary: The Lord commands Ezekiel to record the day Babylon approaches Jerusalem, then speaks a parable about a bloody cauldron representing the city's violence and filthiness. The Lord declares judgment will come without mercy. Ezekiel's wife dies, and his restrained response becomes a sign to Israel of the coming destruction and exile they will experience.

day-0394.key_verse_text: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.
day-0394.summary: A person calls on God to deliver from enemies who lie in wait without cause. The Lord laughs at the nations while the speaker trusts in God's strength and loving kindness, declaring intention to sing praises as God serves as a refuge and high tower.

day-0320.key_verse_text: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
day-0320.summary: Eliphaz speaks to Job, recounting how Job once strengthened others but now falters under affliction. Eliphaz describes a vision revealing human frailty before God, then argues that the wicked perish while God protects the righteous, delivering them from trouble and blessing them with prosperity and long life.

day-0468.key_verse_text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
day-0468.summary: Solomon's proverbs aim to impart wisdom, instruction, and understanding to the simple and young. Fearing the Lord begins knowledge, while fools despise wisdom. Wisdom calls publicly to the simple and mockers, offering her spirit to those who heed her reproof, but those who refuse her counsel face calamity and death.

day-0690.key_verse_text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
day-0690.summary: Jesus ascends a mountain and sits with his disciples, then teaches them a series of blessings. The poor in spirit, those who mourn, the gentle, those hungering for righteousness, the merciful, the pure in heart, peacemakers, and the persecuted all receive blessings and promises of divine reward.

day-0246.key_verse_text: Therefore Yahweh said to Solomon, “Because this is done by you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
day-0246.summary: King Solomon loves many foreign women whose gods turn his heart away from the Lord. The Lord grows angry and declares the kingdom will be torn from Solomon's hand and given to his servant. The Lord raises up adversaries against Solomon: Hadad, Rezon, and Jeroboam, whom the prophet Ahijah tells will receive ten tribes.

day-0710.key_verse_text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
day-0710.summary: Jesus teaches that humility and childlikeness characterize greatness in God's kingdom, warns against causing believers to stumble, and instructs on reconciliation with offending brothers. He illustrates God's concern for the lost through a shepherd's parable and emphasizes unlimited forgiveness through a king's debt-forgiveness story.

day-0974.key_verse_text: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”
day-0974.summary: God gives Jesus a revelation to show his servants what must happen soon, which Jesus communicates through an angel to John. John receives a greeting of grace and peace from God and Jesus Christ, then encounters a figure like a son of man among 7 golden lamp stands, who commands him to write messages to 7 assemblies.

day-0172.key_verse_text: Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments, to hold fast to him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.”
day-0172.summary: Joshua dismisses the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh to their eastern lands after they faithfully serve during the conquest. When they build an altar at the Jordan, Israel suspects rebellion. The 2 tribes explain the altar witnesses their covenant loyalty, not defiance. Phinehas and the princes accept this explanation, and conflict resolves peacefully.

day-0842.key_verse_text: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.
day-0842.summary: In Iconium, Paul and Barnabas preach and perform miracles, dividing the city. Fleeing persecution, they travel to Lystra where Paul heals a crippled man, prompting the crowd to worship them as gods. After correcting this misunderstanding, Paul is stoned but survives. The apostles return to strengthen new disciples before sailing home to Antioch.

day-0616.key_verse_text: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am Yahweh, when I lay my vengeance on them.”’”
day-0616.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia for their hostility toward Judah, declaring these nations will face destruction and know the Lord's vengeance. Tyre faces similar judgment through Nebuchadnezzar's siege, becoming desolate. A lamentation describes Tyre's former glory as a merchant city with extensive trade networks before its catastrophic fall into the sea.

day-0025.key_verse_text: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
day-0025.summary: Jacob arrives in Haran, meets Rachel at a well, and falls in love with her. He agrees to serve Laban 7 years for Rachel's hand. After the years pass, Laban deceives Jacob by giving Leah instead, then offers Rachel for 7 more years of service. Jacob marries both daughters. Leah bears 4 sons while Rachel remains barren.

day-0099.key_verse_text: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.
day-0099.summary: The Lord commands Moses and Aaron to organize the children of Israel into 4 camps around the Tent of Meeting, each with assigned tribes, princes, and numbered divisions. The camps set out in order: Judah first, Reuben second, Ephraim third, and Dan last. The Levites remain uncounted and positioned centrally. The people comply fully with these instructions.

day-0542.key_verse_text: This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.
day-0542.summary: The Lord addresses Jacob and Israel, promising to pour out water and spirit upon descendants. The Lord declares himself first and last, with no god beside him. Craftsmen fashion idols from wood, using part for fuel and part for worship, yet remain blind to their folly. The Lord redeems Jacob, blots out transgressions, and confirms his word through his servant.

day-0247.key_verse_text: So the king didn’t listen to the people; for it was a thing brought about from Yahweh, that he might establish his word, which Yahweh spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
day-0247.summary: Rehoboam rejects the counsel of elders to ease the people's burden and instead adopts harsh advice from young men, promising increased oppression. The people rebel, Israel splits from Judah, and Jeroboam becomes king over Israel. Jeroboam then establishes golden calves and unauthorized priests to prevent his people from returning to Jerusalem.

day-0395.key_verse_text: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
day-0395.summary: The psalmist describes God's rejection and the people's suffering through trembling land and difficult circumstances, then reports God's declaration from the sanctuary that the Lord will triumph and possess the territories of Israel's enemies, concluding that victory comes through God's strength against adversaries.

day-0469.key_verse_text: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
day-0469.summary: A father instructs his son to receive wisdom through diligent seeking, promising that the Lord grants understanding to those who pursue it earnestly. Wisdom protects from evil paths and delivers from destructive influences. The righteous dwell securely in the land while the wicked are cut off. Honoring the Lord with trust and obedience brings health, provision, and peace.

day-0321.key_verse_text: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
day-0321.summary: Job responds to his friends by describing his suffering as heavier than sand, caused by the Almighty's arrows and terrors. He wishes for death, compares his friends to unreliable streams, and accuses them of cruelty. He then laments his miserable existence, sleepless nights, and decaying flesh, declaring he will speak his anguish and complaint openly.

day-0543.key_verse_text: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
day-0543.summary: The Lord declares to Cyrus that he will subdue nations and open doors before him. The Lord affirms his unique sovereignty, stating there is no God besides him, and promises to raise Cyrus in righteousness to rebuild the city and free exiles. Nations will acknowledge the Lord's power, and Israel will find everlasting salvation in him alone.

day-0173.key_verse_text: If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve Yahweh.”
day-0173.summary: An elderly Joshua addresses Israel, recounting the Lord's victories and warning against covenant disobedience. At Shechem, Joshua presents Israel's history and calls the people to serve the Lord alone. The people pledge loyalty, Joshua establishes a covenant and memorial stone, then dies at 110 years old. Israel continues serving the Lord throughout Joshua's lifetime.

day-0617.key_verse_text: “Son of man, tell the prince of Tyre, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because your heart is lifted up, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of God, in the middle of the seas;’ yet you are man, and no god, though you set your heart as the heart of a god—
day-0617.summary: The Lord sends Ezekiel to condemn the prince of Tyre for claiming divinity through wisdom and wealth, promising judgment by foreign nations. A lament follows, describing the king's former perfection in Eden before corruption led to his destruction. The Lord then pronounces judgment on Sidon and promises to restore Israel to security in their land.

day-0691.key_verse_text: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can ’t be hidden.
day-0691.summary: Jesus describes his followers as salt and light in the world, comparing them to a city on a hill that cannot be hidden. He states he came to fulfill the law and prophets, not destroy them, and declares that all of the law remains valid until all things are accomplished.

day-0827.key_verse_text: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”
day-0827.summary: Mary Magdalene discovers the stone removed from the tomb early on the first day of the week. The disciples find the linen cloths inside. Jesus appears to Mary, then to the gathered disciples behind locked doors, showing his hands and side. Thomas later encounters the risen Jesus and declares his faith. Jesus pronounces blessing on those who believe without seeing.

day-0248.key_verse_text: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, “Yahweh says, ‘Because you have been disobedient to Yahweh’s word, and have not kept the commandment which Yahweh your God commanded you,
day-0248.summary: A man of God from Judah prophesies against Jeroboam's altar at Bethel, and the Lord confirms his message through signs. When an old prophet deceives the man of God into breaking his command, the Lord sends a lion to kill him. The old prophet retrieves the body and buries it, recognizing the Lord's judgment for disobedience.

day-0100.key_verse_text: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,
day-0100.summary: The Lord designates the Levites as substitutes for all firstborn Israelites, making them his own. Moses counts 22,000 Levites by family groups and assigns them specific duties around the tabernacle under Aaron's oversight. When firstborn males exceed Levites in number, Moses collects redemption money and gives it to Aaron and his sons.

day-0026.key_verse_text: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
day-0026.summary: Rachel, unable to bear children, gives her servant Bilhah to Jacob, who bears 2 sons. Leah follows suit with her servant Zilpah, bearing 2 sons. Leah then conceives and bears 4 more children. The Lord opens Rachel's womb, and she bears Joseph. Jacob negotiates wages with Laban, acquiring spotted livestock through selective breeding and becoming exceedingly wealthy.

day-0798.key_verse_text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
day-0798.summary: Nicodemus, a Pharisee ruler, visits Jesus at night and acknowledges his divine authority through signs. Jesus explains that entry into God's Kingdom requires being born anew of water and Spirit. Jesus describes God's love for the world through giving his Son, whose lifting up offers eternal life to believers, while judgment falls on those rejecting him.

day-0945.key_verse_text: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
day-0945.summary: Every high priest comes from among men and is appointed to represent them before God, offering gifts and sacrifices for sins. Christ, though a Son, learned obedience through suffering and became a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek, providing eternal salvation to those who obey him.

day-0174.key_verse_text: Yahweh was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
day-0174.summary: After Joshua's death, the Lord directs Judah to lead the conquest against the Canaanites. Judah and Simeon achieve victories in the hill country and capture several cities, though they fail to drive out inhabitants of the valleys who possess iron chariots. Other tribes similarly experience mixed success, often coexisting with remaining Canaanite populations rather than completely displacing them.

day-0322.key_verse_text: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
day-0322.summary: Bildad the Shuhite responds to Job, asserting that God does not pervert justice and that the righteous prosper while the godless perish. He urges seeking God diligently and promises that the blameless receive blessing, laughter, and vindication while the wicked face shame and destruction.

day-0396.key_verse_text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
day-0396.summary: The psalmist calls to God from distant places, asking to be led to safety when overwhelmed. God serves as a refuge and strong tower, and the psalmist vows to dwell in God's shelter forever, receiving the heritage of those who fear God's name. The king's life is prolonged, and praise continues daily.

day-0470.key_verse_text: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
day-0470.summary: A father instructs his son to pursue wisdom and understanding above all else, for wisdom preserves, exalts, and brings honor. The righteous walk in straight paths that grow brighter, while the wicked dwell in darkness and stumble. The son must guard his heart, keep his father's words, avoid evil, and fix his gaze forward on the established way.

day-0813.key_verse_text: I and the Father are one.”
day-0813.summary: During the Feast of the Dedication, Jesus walks in Solomon's porch while the Jews demand he state plainly whether he is the Christ. Jesus responds that his works testify about him, and he declares unity with the Father. The Jews attempt to stone him for blasphemy, but he escapes beyond the Jordan, where many believe in him.

day-0692.key_verse_text: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,
day-0692.summary: Jesus deepens the law by addressing internal attitudes alongside external actions. Anger, lust, divorce, false oaths, and retaliation all fall short of God's standard. The righteous reconcile with others, guard against temptation, keep simple speech, and love enemies through blessing, doing good, and prayer, reflecting the Father's perfection.

day-0931.key_verse_text: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
day-0931.summary: Timothy receives instructions on addressing people of different ages with appropriate respect, honoring widows genuinely devoted to God, ensuring family members support their relatives, establishing criteria for enrolling widows in church support, compensating elders fairly, and handling accusations against leaders with careful witness requirements.

day-0544.key_verse_text: Remember the former things of old; for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
day-0544.summary: Bel and Nebo's idols are burdensome loads that cannot save, while the Lord carries the house of Jacob from birth to old age. Babylon, proud and secure in sorcery, will fall suddenly to disaster, and the astrologers and enchantments it trusts cannot deliver it from ruin.

day-0784.key_verse_text: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”
day-0784.summary: Jesus teaches the disciples about causing stumbling, forgiveness, and faith's power. He instructs about servanthood's humility. Ten lepers encounter Jesus and are cleansed; only one returns to give thanks. Jesus tells Pharisees God's Kingdom comes without observation, then warns disciples about the Son of Man's future coming and the judgment it brings.

day-0618.key_verse_text: It will no longer be the confidence of the house of Israel, bringing iniquity to memory, when they turn to look after them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”’”
day-0618.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment against Pharaoh and Egypt for pride and false confidence. Egypt will become desolate for 40 years, then restored as a lowly kingdom. Nebuchadnezzar will conquer Egypt as payment for his service. The Lord will break Pharaoh's arms and scatter Egyptians among nations, establishing divine sovereignty.

day-0916.key_verse_text: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
day-0916.summary: Christ is the image of the invisible God and firstborn of creation, through whom all things were made and held together. He reconciles all things to himself through his blood, having reconciled those formerly alienated through his death, presenting them holy and blameless before him.

day-0769.key_verse_text: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
day-0769.summary: Jesus travels through cities preaching God's Kingdom with the twelve and women healed of evil spirits. He teaches a parable about a farmer sowing seed, explaining that the word of God produces fruit only in those with honest hearts who hold it firmly. Jesus then calms a storm on the lake, demonstrating his authority over nature.

day-0249.key_verse_text: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”
day-0249.summary: Jeroboam's wife visits the prophet Ahijah, who reveals that the king's son will die and that the Lord will destroy Jeroboam's house because of his idolatry and sins. The child dies upon her return home. Rehoboam reigns in Judah, leading the people into evil practices, and Egypt's king plunders Jerusalem's treasures.

day-0901.key_verse_text: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
day-0901.summary: Spiritual believers restore the fallen in gentleness while bearing one another's burdens. Each person examines their own work and reaps what they sow. Those sowing to the Spirit reap eternal life. The cross of Christ matters more than circumcision, which signifies nothing in Christ Jesus.

day-0397.key_verse_text: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
day-0397.summary: The speaker declares that the Lord alone provides rest, salvation, and security against those who scheme to destroy. The Lord is an unshakeable rock and refuge. All people are urged to trust in God at all times and pour out their hearts before him, for power and loving kindness belong to the Lord.

day-0323.key_verse_text: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
day-0323.summary: Job describes God's immense power over creation and argues that no mortal can stand in judgment against such a being. God destroys both the blameless and wicked indiscriminately. Job expresses his weariness with life, questioning why God formed him only to afflict him, and wishes he had never been born.

day-0471.key_verse_text: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
day-0471.summary: A father instructs his sons to heed wisdom and avoid adultery, whose initial sweetness leads to bitterness and death. He warns of ruin and urges them instead to find satisfaction in their own wives, rejoicing in their youth. The Lord observes all paths, and the wicked become ensnared by their own deeds.

day-0027.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
day-0027.summary: The Lord commands Jacob to return to his homeland. Jacob flees with his family and possessions while Laban shears sheep. Laban pursues and catches Jacob, but the Lord warns Laban in a dream not to harm him. After Laban searches unsuccessfully for stolen household gods, the men establish a covenant with a stone pillar and heap, then part ways.

day-0545.key_verse_text: Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by the way that you should go.
day-0545.summary: The Lord addresses Jacob and Israel, declaring that he has revealed former things and now shows hidden things. He has refined them through affliction and will lead them according to his purpose. The Lord calls them to leave Babylon and announces redemption for his servant Jacob.

day-0101.key_verse_text: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.
day-0101.summary: The Lord directs Moses and Aaron to count Levites aged 30 to 50 from 3 families for Tent of Meeting service. Aaron and sons cover sanctuary items before the Kohathites carry them without touching holy things. Gershonites transport curtains and coverings, while Merarites carry structural components. The census totals 8,580 Levites across all 3 families.

day-0619.key_verse_text: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and its top was among the thick boughs.
day-0619.summary: The Lord compares Pharaoh to a great cedar that once towered above all trees, nourished by abundant waters and sheltering all creatures, but pride leads to his downfall. Foreigners cut him down, and his fall causes mourning throughout the earth. The Lord declares Pharaoh will be cast down to Sheol with other slain nations.

day-0693.key_verse_text: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us today our daily bread. Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’
day-0693.summary: Jesus instructs followers to practice charity, prayer, and fasting in secret rather than for public recognition. Hypocrites seek human approval and receive no reward from the Father. The Lord teaches a model prayer honoring God's name and kingdom, requesting daily provision and forgiveness. Those who forgive others receive forgiveness from the Father.

day-0754.key_verse_text: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
day-0754.summary: 3 women discover the stone rolled away from the tomb and encounter a young man who announces Jesus has risen. Jesus appears to Mary Magdalene, then to 2 others, then to the 11 disciples, commissioning them to preach the Good News to all creation. The Lord ascends to heaven while the disciples proclaim the message everywhere.

day-0887.key_verse_text: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
day-0887.summary: Paul establishes that the Corinthians themselves serve as a letter of Christ written by the Spirit on hearts of flesh rather than stone. The Spirit's service brings greater glory and life compared to the old covenant's letter, which kills. Those who turn to the Lord have the veil removed and are transformed into the Lord's image through the Spirit's liberty.

day-0961.key_verse_text: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
day-0961.summary: Christ's suffering calls believers to abandon fleshly desires and live for God's will. As the end approaches, they are to love earnestly, serve faithfully with their gifts, and speak God's words. Suffering for Christ's name brings blessing, and those enduring trials according to God's will entrust themselves to their faithful Creator.

day-0028.key_verse_text: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
day-0028.summary: Jacob encounters God's angels, then sends messengers to his brother Esau with gifts and humble greetings. After wrestling with a man through the night and receiving the name Israel, Jacob meets Esau, who embraces him. The brothers reconcile, and Jacob settles in Canaan, building an altar.

day-0175.key_verse_text: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
day-0175.summary: The Lord's angel declares that Israel has broken covenant by failing to destroy the inhabitants' altars. After Joshua's death, a new generation abandons the Lord for other gods, prompting divine anger and oppression. The Lord raises judges to deliver Israel, yet the people repeatedly return to idolatry after each judge dies, establishing a cycle of disobedience and judgment.

day-0102.key_verse_text: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty, then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.
day-0102.summary: The Lord commands the Israelites to remove those with leprosy, discharge, or corpse defilement from camp. The Lord establishes procedures for confessing sin and making restitution with an added fifth part, and prescribes a ritual involving bitter water to determine whether a wife suspected of infidelity has been unfaithful.

day-0176.key_verse_text: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.
day-0176.summary: The children of Israel do evil and are oppressed by foreign kings in cycles. The Lord raises up judges to deliver them: Othniel defeats Cushan Rishathaim, bringing 40 years of peace. Later, Ehud, a left-handed Benjamite, assassinates Eglon of Moab and leads Israel to victory, securing 80 years of rest. Shamgar also saves Israel by striking Philistines.

day-0398.key_verse_text: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
day-0398.summary: A person expresses deep longing for God in a barren place, having witnessed the Lord's power and glory in the sanctuary. The Lord's loving kindness surpasses life itself, inspiring continuous praise and blessing. Those who seek to destroy the soul face destruction, while the king rejoices in God and all who swear by the Lord offer praise.

day-0250.key_verse_text: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.
day-0250.summary: Abijam reigns over Judah for 3 years, walking in his father's sins, though the Lord preserves his line for David's sake. Asa then becomes king and reigns 41 years, doing right in the Lord's eyes by removing idolatry and dedicating treasures to the temple. He wages war against Israel's kings and uses diplomacy to stop Baasha's invasion.

day-0472.key_verse_text: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
day-0472.summary: A father warns against pledging oneself for strangers, urges diligence by observing ants, condemns laziness and perversity, lists 7 things the Lord hates, instructs sons to keep parental teaching as protection, and warns against adultery's destructive consequences.

day-0620.key_verse_text: Tell them, ‘“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why will you die, house of Israel?”’
day-0620.summary: The Lord establishes Ezekiel as a watchman to warn the house of Israel of coming judgment. The Lord declares that the wicked who turn from their ways will live, while those who persist in sin will die. Those who hear warnings bear responsibility for their choices, and the Lord judges each person according to their actions.

day-0546.key_verse_text: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel. I will also give you as a light to the nations, that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.”
day-0546.summary: The Lord calls a servant from the womb to restore Jacob and become a light to the nations. Though the servant labors and faces despair, the Lord comforts Zion, promising her children will return and kings will serve her. The servant submits to suffering, trusting the Lord's vindication, while those who reject the Lord's guidance walk in darkness and sorrow.

day-0694.key_verse_text: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
day-0694.summary: Jesus teaches that earthly treasures perish while heavenly treasures endure, and a sound eye fills the body with light. No one serves 2 masters, so God and wealth cannot both be served. Anxiety about food and clothing proves unnecessary since the Lord feeds birds and clothes flowers, and seeking God's Kingdom first ensures provision.

day-0872.key_verse_text: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
day-0872.summary: Paul addresses the Corinthian believers as fleshly rather than spiritual, noting their immaturity shown through jealousy, strife, and factions. He explains that apostles serve as workers in God's field and building, with Jesus Christ as the sole foundation. Works built on this foundation are tested by fire, and worldly wisdom stands opposed to God's wisdom.

day-0990.key_verse_text: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
day-0990.summary: An angel shows a seer a woman called Babylon the Great sitting on a scarlet beast with 7 heads and 10 horns. The woman, dressed in luxury and drunk with martyrs' blood, represents a great city that reigns over earth's kings. Ten kings will war against the Lamb, who overcomes them as Lord of lords and King of kings.

day-0858.key_verse_text: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
day-0858.summary: Abraham's faith is accounted to him for righteousness apart from works. David pronounces blessing on those whose sins the Lord does not charge to them. Abraham received righteousness through faith while uncircumcised, becoming father of all believers. The promise to Abraham and his offspring comes through faith, not law.

day-0103.key_verse_text: ‘Yahweh bless you, and keep you. Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’
day-0103.summary: The Lord instructs Moses on the Nazirite vow, detailing restrictions on wine, grooming, and contact with the dead. Upon completing the vow period, the Nazirite brings offerings and shaves his head. The Lord then commands Aaron and his sons to bless the children of Israel with words of blessing, favor, and peace.

day-0029.key_verse_text: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
day-0029.summary: Dinah is violated by Shechem, whose father seeks marriage through deception. Jacob's sons agree only if all males are circumcised, then slaughter the city and plunder it. God directs Jacob to Bethel, where the Lord renames him Israel and promises nations and kings from his line. Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin. Isaac dies at 180 years old.

day-0324.key_verse_text: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?
day-0324.summary: Zophar responds by questioning Job's words and asserting that God's wisdom and power transcend human understanding. He describes God's vastness and knowledge, then urges Job to set his heart aright and remove iniquity, promising that such repentance brings security and hope while the wicked face despair.

day-0325.key_verse_text: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
day-0325.summary: Job responds to his friends, asserting his own understanding and contending that the Lord controls all things, destroying and exalting as he wills. Job declares his righteousness and desires to argue his case before God, though he acknowledges human mortality and the brevity of life compared to the permanence of the earth.

day-0399.key_verse_text: The righteous shall be glad in Yahweh, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!
day-0399.summary: A speaker asks God to preserve life from enemies who plot secretly with sharp words and hidden arrows. God strikes down the wicked suddenly, their own tongues destroying them. All people witness God's work and fear, while the righteous rejoice and take refuge in the Lord.

day-0251.key_verse_text: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
day-0251.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment against Baasha through the prophet Jehu, and his house falls when Zimri assassinates Elah. Zimri's brief reign ends when Omri besieges Tirzah, and Omri establishes Samaria as his capital. Ahab succeeds Omri and surpasses all previous kings in wickedness, marrying Jezebel and establishing worship of Baal and Asherah.

day-0473.key_verse_text: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.
day-0473.summary: A father instructs his son to internalize his commandments and wisdom as protection against a seductive woman. The father witnesses a naive young man lured by a prostitute's flattery and deceptive promises into her house at night. The man follows her like an animal to slaughter, unaware of the deadly consequences her house brings.

day-0177.key_verse_text: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
day-0177.summary: The prophetess Deborah summons Barak to lead 10,000 men against Sisera's army. The Lord confuses Sisera's forces in battle, and Barak pursues the fleeing commander. Sisera seeks refuge in Jael's tent, where she kills him with a tent peg while he sleeps. Israel's power grows against King Jabin until his destruction.

day-0621.key_verse_text: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I will cause them to lie down,” says the Lord Yahweh.
day-0621.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment against Israel's shepherds for neglecting their flock and feeding themselves instead. The Lord declares he will search out his scattered sheep, gather them, and become their shepherd, feeding them in good pasture and establishing a covenant of peace with them.

day-0711.key_verse_text: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
day-0711.summary: Jesus travels to Judea, heals multitudes, and addresses Pharisees about divorce, explaining that marriage joins two into one flesh and divorce is permitted only for sexual immorality. He later welcomes children, tells a rich young man to sell his possessions and follow him, and teaches disciples that salvation is impossible for humans but possible with God.

day-0843.key_verse_text: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”
day-0843.summary: Men from Judea insist Gentiles must be circumcised to be saved. Paul and Barnabas travel to Jerusalem where apostles and elders debate the matter. Peter argues God gives the Holy Spirit to Gentiles through faith alone. James agrees, and the council writes to Gentile churches requiring only abstinence from idols, blood, and sexual immorality.

day-0828.key_verse_text: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.
day-0828.summary: Jesus appears to 7 disciples fishing at the sea of Tiberias. After they catch nothing all night, Jesus directs them to cast their net on the right side, resulting in 153 large fish. Jesus prepares breakfast on the beach, and the disciples recognize him as the Lord before eating together.

day-0975.key_verse_text: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.
day-0975.summary: Jesus addresses 4 assemblies through their angels, commending their works while identifying specific failings: Ephesus has abandoned its first love, Smyrna faces imminent imprisonment and oppression, Pergamum tolerates false teachings, and Thyatira permits a prophetess promoting idolatry and sexual immorality. Overcomers receive various rewards.

day-0030.key_verse_text: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
day-0030.summary: Esau takes his wives from Canaan and bears 3 sons through them. His possessions grow so great that he separates from Jacob and settles in the hill country of Seir, becoming Edom.
