The passage records Esau's descendants, the Horite inhabitants, and the kings who reign in Edom before any king rules Israel.

day-0104.key_verse_text: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.
day-0104.summary: After Moses finishes setting up and anointing the tabernacle, the 12 tribal princes present wagons and oxen to the Levites for service. Over 12 consecutive days, each prince offers identical dedication gifts for the altar. Moses then enters the Tent of Meeting and hears the Lord speaking from above the mercy seat.

day-0252.key_verse_text: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”
day-0252.summary: Elijah declares a drought to Ahab, then the Lord directs him to hide by a brook where ravens feed him. When the brook dries up, the Lord sends him to a widow in Zarephath whose meal and oil miraculously sustain them. After her son dies, Elijah revives the boy, and the widow recognizes him as a man of God.

day-0178.key_verse_text: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
day-0178.summary: Deborah and Barak sing praise to the Lord for Israel's victory over Canaan's kings. The song recounts how various tribes responded to the call, how the Lord fought through nature and Jael's actions against Sisera, and contrasts the enemy commander's mother waiting in vain with Israel's triumph and 40 years of peace.

day-0695.key_verse_text: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
day-0695.summary: Jesus teaches against judging others while ignoring one's own faults, instructs to treat others as one desires to be treated, and warns that false prophets are known by their fruits. Those who hear and obey his words build on solid ground, while those who ignore them build on sand. The multitudes marvel at his authoritative teaching.

day-0400.key_verse_text: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.
day-0400.summary: God receives praise in Zion and answers prayers from all people. The Lord atones for sins and blesses those chosen to dwell in the divine courts. Through awesome deeds and mighty power, God stills the seas, provides water and grain to the earth, and clothes the land with abundance and joy.

day-0547.key_verse_text: Those ransomed by Yahweh will return, and come with singing to Zion. Everlasting joy shall be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy. Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
day-0547.summary: The Lord calls those seeking righteousness to remember Abraham and Sarah, promising comfort to Zion and transforming wilderness into Eden. The Lord's salvation endures forever while the earth fades. The ransomed return to Zion with singing, obtaining everlasting joy. Jerusalem, afflicted and drunk with the cup of wrath, receives comfort as the Lord removes that cup from her hand.

day-0326.key_verse_text: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
day-0326.summary: Eliphaz rebukes Job for speaking vain words that undermine fear of God, claiming Job's own mouth condemns him. Eliphaz then describes the wicked man's inevitable suffering: he lives in terror, poverty, and desolation, ultimately destroyed by God's judgment for his pride and rebellion against the Almighty.

day-0548.key_verse_text: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed. All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
day-0548.summary: Jerusalem is called to awake and shed captivity, for the Lord redeems without payment. A messenger brings good news of salvation and God's reign. The Lord's servant grows humbly, bears sickness and suffering, is pierced for transgressions, and through his wounds brings healing and justification to many.

day-0814.key_verse_text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
day-0814.summary: Lazarus falls ill in Bethany, and his sisters send word to Jesus. Jesus delays his arrival, stating the sickness serves God's glory. He then tells the disciples Lazarus has died and travels to Bethany. Martha meets Jesus and expresses her faith, and Jesus declares himself the resurrection and the life, asking if Martha believes this truth.

day-0696.key_verse_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”
day-0696.summary: Jesus descends the mountain followed by great crowds. A leper asks for cleansing and is healed immediately. A centurion requests healing for his paralyzed servant, demonstrating remarkable faith. Jesus heals Peter's mother-in-law of fever and casts out demons while healing the sick, fulfilling Isaiah's prophecy about bearing infirmities and diseases.

day-0946.key_verse_text: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
day-0946.summary: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, blesses Abraham and receives tithes from him, demonstrating superiority over the Levitical priesthood. Jesus, arising as a priest after Melchizedek's order rather than Aaron's, establishes a better covenant through an eternal priesthood that perfects what the law could not accomplish.

day-0799.key_verse_text: He must increase, but I must decrease.
day-0799.summary: Jesus baptizes in Judea while John baptizes in Enon. John's disciples report that everyone follows Jesus, and John explains that a man receives only what heaven gives him. John identifies himself as the forerunner, rejoicing in his role as the bridegroom's friend.

day-0937.key_verse_text: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
day-0937.summary: Paul writes to Titus, his true child in faith, explaining that he left Titus in Crete to appoint elders in every city. Elders must be blameless, self-controlled, and hospitable, holding to faithful teaching to exhort and convict those who contradict sound doctrine. Many unruly deceivers teach false things for dishonest gain and must be sharply reproved.

day-0031.key_verse_text: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
day-0031.summary: Jacob's son Joseph, favored by his father with a special tunic, shares dreams of his brothers bowing to him, deepening their hatred. His brothers conspire to kill him, but Reuben urges restraint. Judah persuades them to sell Joseph to passing merchants instead, who transport him to Egypt while his brothers deceive their father with bloodied clothing.

day-0622.key_verse_text: I will also give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit within you. I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh. I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes. You will keep my ordinances and do them.
day-0622.summary: The Lord pronounces judgment against Mount Seir for perpetual hostility toward Israel and declares restoration for the mountains of Israel. The Lord promises to gather the scattered people, cleanse them, give them a new heart and spirit, return them to their land, and multiply their population. The nations will recognize the Lord's power through these acts.

day-0253.key_verse_text: When all the people saw it, they fell on their faces. They said, “Yahweh, he is God! Yahweh, he is God!”
day-0253.summary: After a severe famine, the Lord directs Elijah to confront King Ahab. Elijah challenges the prophets of Baal to a test on Mount Carmel, calling fire down from heaven to consume his offering while Baal's prophets fail. The people declare the Lord is God, and Elijah executes Baal's prophets before rain returns to the land.

day-0474.key_verse_text: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old. I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
day-0474.summary: Wisdom calls out from prominent places, inviting people to receive her instruction and understanding. She declares herself present from the beginning of creation, dwelling with the Lord and influencing rulers. Those who love and seek wisdom gain riches, honor, and life, while those who reject her harm themselves.

day-0401.key_verse_text: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah. That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,
day-0401.summary: All the earth is called to make joyful shouts and sing to God's glory, declaring his awesome deeds and power. God's eyes watch the nations, and he preserves life and refines his people through trials. A speaker vows to offer sacrifices and declare God's faithfulness, while petitioning for God's mercy and blessing so his salvation becomes known among all nations.

day-0475.key_verse_text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
day-0475.summary: Wisdom constructs her house with 7 pillars and prepares a feast, sending maidens to invite the simple and foolish to eat bread and drink wine, leaving their simple ways to walk in understanding. The fear of the Lord begins wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One brings understanding.

day-0549.key_verse_text: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed, but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.
day-0549.summary: The Lord calls the barren to sing and enlarge their dwelling, promising offspring will spread across nations. Though temporarily forsaken, the Lord gathers with great mercy, establishing an everlasting covenant of peace. The Lord's loving kindness remains constant, and no weapon formed against the Lord's servants will prevail.

day-0179.key_verse_text: Yahweh looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”
day-0179.summary: Israel suffers oppression from Midian for 7 years due to evil. After the people cry out, the Lord's angel appears to Gideon and commissions him to save Israel. Gideon requests signs, which the Lord provides through fire and fleece. Gideon destroys Baal's altar, gathers troops, and seeks further confirmation of the Lord's promise.

day-0105.key_verse_text: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.
day-0105.summary: Aaron lights the tabernacle lamps as commanded. The Lord directs the consecration of the Levites through cleansing, sacrifice, and presentation as a wave offering, designating them for service in the Tent of Meeting. The Lord establishes Passover observance and provides provisions for those unclean or traveling. A cloud covers the tabernacle, guiding the people's movements and encampments throughout their journey.

day-0932.key_verse_text: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
day-0932.summary: Bondservants honor their masters so God's name remains unblasphemed. False teachers breed conflict and suppose godliness brings gain, but godliness with contentment is true gain. The love of money leads to ruin, while the righteous pursue faith, love, and gentleness. Timothy guards the faith entrusted to him, avoiding empty chatter and false knowledge.

day-0785.key_verse_text: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
day-0785.summary: Jesus teaches through parables about persistent prayer and humility before God, contrasts a self-righteous Pharisee with a repentant tax collector, welcomes children into God's Kingdom, challenges a rich ruler to sell his possessions, and declares that what is impossible for humans is possible with God. He predicts his suffering and resurrection, then restores sight to a blind beggar near Jericho.

day-0917.key_verse_text: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily, and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
day-0917.summary: Paul expresses his struggle for the Colossians and those at Laodicea, desiring their hearts to be comforted and knit together in love through understanding God's mystery. He warns against deception and philosophy contrary to Christ, affirming that in Christ dwells all fullness of deity and that believers are made complete in him as head of all power.

day-0770.key_verse_text: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”
day-0770.summary: Jesus encounters a demon-possessed man in Gadarenes, casts out many demons into a herd of pigs that drowns, then heals a hemorrhaging woman and raises Jairus's dead daughter to life, commanding secrecy about the miracle.

day-0902.key_verse_text: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
day-0902.summary: Paul writes to the saints at Ephesus, declaring that God has blessed them with spiritual blessings in Christ, choosing them before the foundation of the world for adoption as children and redemption through Christ's blood for the forgiveness of trespasses according to the riches of grace.

day-0327.key_verse_text: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
day-0327.summary: Job responds to his friends' counsel, declaring their comfort worthless. He describes God as his tormentor, afflicting him with physical suffering and social shame. Despite his anguish and approaching death, Job insists a witness exists in heaven who vouches for his innocence, even as his earthly companions mock him.

day-0697.key_verse_text: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—”( then he said to the paralytic ), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”
day-0697.summary: Jesus directs his disciples across the sea, where he calms a violent storm while sleeping. After crossing, he casts demons into a herd of pigs that rushes into the sea. Returning to his city, Jesus forgives a paralyzed man's sins and commands him to walk, demonstrating his authority on earth to forgive sins.

day-0623.key_verse_text: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. Then I will place you in your own land; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it and performed it,” says Yahweh.’”
day-0623.summary: The Lord brings Ezekiel to a valley of dry bones and commands him to prophesy. As Ezekiel speaks, the bones reassemble, gain flesh and skin, then receive breath and stand as a great army. The Lord explains the bones represent Israel and promises to restore the divided nation to their land under one king with an everlasting covenant.

day-0032.key_verse_text: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
day-0032.summary: Judah separates from his brothers, marries a Canaanite woman, and fathers 3 sons. After his firstborn Er dies, his second son Onan refuses his duty to Er's widow Tamar and also dies. Judah later unknowingly lies with disguised Tamar, who bears twins and proves her righteousness when Judah recognizes his own pledged items.

day-0180.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”
day-0180.summary: Gideon reduces his army to 300 men through the Lord's direction, then leads them against the Midianites using trumpets and torches. The enemy forces panic and turn against each other, fleeing in defeat while pursuing Israelites from multiple tribes pursue them and capture Midian's princes.

day-0106.key_verse_text: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!” When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
day-0106.summary: The Lord instructs Moses to make 2 silver trumpets for summoning the congregation and signaling the camps' movements. Priests blow them for gatherings, warfare, and festivals. The Israelites depart from Sinai in organized formation, with the ark leading the way and the cloud of the Lord guiding them.

day-0328.key_verse_text: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
day-0328.summary: Bildad the Shuhite describes the fate of the wicked, whose light is extinguished and whose strength diminishes. He portrays them as trapped by their own feet, pursued by terrors, consumed by calamity, and ultimately uprooted from security. Their memory perishes from the earth, and they are driven into darkness with no descendants remaining.

day-0476.key_verse_text: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
day-0476.summary: Solomon's proverbs contrast the righteous with the wicked across matters of conduct, speech, and consequence. Wisdom, diligence, and integrity lead to blessing and life, while foolishness, laziness, and wickedness bring shame and ruin. The Lord sustains the righteous and opposes the wicked.

day-0550.key_verse_text: so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and it will prosper in the thing I sent it to do.
day-0550.summary: The Lord invites all who thirst to receive sustenance freely and calls people to listen and live. The Lord establishes an everlasting covenant, promising that divine words accomplish their purpose like rain watering the earth. Those who seek the Lord find mercy and pardon, and creation itself responds with joy and transformation.

day-0624.key_verse_text: I will magnify myself and sanctify myself, and I will make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.”’
day-0624.summary: The Lord commands Ezekiel to prophesy against Gog, who will lead a vast army against Israel. The Lord defeats Gog through earthquake, internal conflict, plague, and fire, then declares his name will be known among the nations. Israel buries the dead for months, and the Lord restores Jacob's captivity, pouring out his Spirit on the house of Israel.

day-0402.key_verse_text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
day-0402.summary: God arises to scatter enemies while the righteous rejoice. God protects the fatherless and widows, sets the lonely in families, and brings prisoners out with singing. The Lord bears burdens daily and provides deliverance. God's processions are seen as the people gather to bless the Lord, and kings bring presents to God's temple.

day-0698.key_verse_text: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
day-0698.summary: Jesus calls Matthew to follow him, then eats with tax collectors and sinners, explaining he came to call sinners to repentance. He performs multiple healings and miracles throughout the land. Observing the scattered multitudes, Jesus tells his disciples the harvest is plentiful but laborers are few.

day-0254.key_verse_text: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.
day-0254.summary: Elijah flees from Jezebel's threat, collapses in the wilderness, and receives food from an angel. Strengthened, he travels to God's mountain where the Lord passes by in wind, earthquake, and fire before speaking in a still small voice. The Lord commissions Elijah to anoint 3 successors and reveals 7,000 faithful remain in Israel.

day-0888.key_verse_text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
day-0888.summary: Those proclaiming the Good News renounce deception and commend truth to every conscience. Though the gospel remains veiled to the dying whose minds the god of this world has blinded, believers carry this treasure in fragile vessels, experiencing affliction yet persisting, their inward person renewed daily while awaiting eternal glory.

day-0033.key_verse_text: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”
day-0033.summary: Joseph prospers in Potiphar's house until the master's wife falsely accuses him of assault, landing him in prison. The Lord remains with Joseph, granting him favor with the keeper. Two of Pharaoh's officers arrive as prisoners, and Joseph interprets their dreams, correctly predicting the cup bearer's restoration and the baker's execution, though the cup bearer forgets him.

day-0255.key_verse_text: A man of God came near and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘Because the Syrians have said, “Yahweh is a god of the hills, but he is not a god of the valleys,” therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am Yahweh.’”
day-0255.summary: Ben Hadad of Syria besieges Samaria and demands Ahab's wealth and family. Ahab initially submits but then refuses further demands. A prophet assures Ahab that the Lord will deliver the Syrian army into his hand. Israel defeats the Syrians decisively, but Ahab later releases Ben Hadad through a covenant, prompting a prophet to declare judgment against him.

day-0107.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”
day-0107.summary: The people complain about lacking meat and pine for Egyptian food. Moses grows distressed under the burden and questions the Lord. The Lord appoints 70 elders to share leadership and promises meat for a month. A wind brings quails, but the Lord strikes the people with plague while eating, and they bury the dead at Kibroth Hattaavah.

day-0755.key_verse_text: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother ’s womb.
day-0755.summary: Luke writes an orderly account of fulfilled events. Zacharias, a righteous priest, and his barren wife Elizabeth receive a visitation from the angel Gabriel in the temple. The angel announces that Elizabeth will bear a son named John, who will be great and filled with the Holy Spirit. Zacharias doubts and becomes mute until the events occur. Elizabeth later conceives.

day-0329.key_verse_text: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
day-0329.summary: Job responds to his friends, describing how God has destroyed him and isolated him from all human connection. Despite his suffering and the abandonment of family and companions, Job declares that his Redeemer lives and will ultimately stand upon the earth, and that he himself will see God.

day-0181.key_verse_text: Gideon said to them, “I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you. Yahweh shall rule over you.”
day-0181.summary: Gideon pursues the Midianite kings Zebah and Zalmunna, captures them, and executes them in vengeance for his brothers. Israel offers him rulership, which he refuses, declaring the Lord shall rule. He requests gold from the people, fashions an ephod, and dies in old age after 40 years of peace. Israel subsequently abandons the Lord and turns to Baal worship.

day-0477.key_verse_text: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.
day-0477.summary: The passage contrasts the righteous with the wicked across numerous dimensions: integrity guides the upright while treachery destroys them, righteousness delivers from death while wickedness causes ruin, and the righteous gain wisdom and life while the wicked face shame, poverty, and death. The Lord abhors false dealings and perverse hearts but delights in accurate weights and blameless ways.

day-0403.key_verse_text: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
day-0403.summary: A person in deep distress cries out to God for deliverance from overwhelming waters and enemies who hate them without cause. They have endured reproach and shame for the Lord's sake, suffering mockery and mistreatment. They plead for God's answer and salvation, then declare intention to praise God's name with thanksgiving.

day-0551.key_verse_text: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also who is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.
day-0551.summary: The Lord calls for justice and righteousness, promising salvation to those who keep the Sabbath and hold fast to the covenant, including foreigners and eunuchs. The Lord condemns blind watchmen and idolatrous practices, declaring that the righteous enter peace while the wicked find no rest, though the Lord dwells with the contrite and humble in spirit.

day-0699.key_verse_text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
day-0699.summary: Jesus calls 12 disciples and grants them authority over unclean spirits and disease. He sends them to Israel's lost sheep, instructing them to preach the Kingdom of Heaven, heal the sick, and cast out demons without taking payment or provisions. He warns of persecution ahead and assures them the Spirit will speak through them.

day-0625.key_verse_text: The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”
day-0625.summary: In a vision, the Lord brings Ezekiel to a high mountain where a bronze-like man with measuring instruments shows him a temple complex. The man instructs Ezekiel to observe carefully and report what he sees to the house of Israel, then systematically measures the outer gates, courts, inner gates, sacrificial tables, and priestly chambers.

day-0873.key_verse_text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
day-0873.summary: Servants and stewards of God's mysteries must prove faithful. The Lord alone judges hearts and will reveal hidden things when he comes, giving each person praise from God. Boasting about received gifts lacks sense, and the apostles endure hardship while displaying God's power.

day-0859.key_verse_text: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
day-0859.summary: Those justified by faith possess peace with God through Jesus Christ and access to grace. God demonstrates love toward sinners by sending Christ to die for the ungodly, resulting in reconciliation and salvation from wrath. Sin and death entered the world through one man, yet grace and righteousness abound through Christ to all who receive it.

day-0034.key_verse_text: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
day-0034.summary: After 2 years, Pharaoh dreams of 7 fat cattle consumed by 7 thin ones, then 7 full grain heads swallowed by 7 withered ones. The chief cup bearer recalls Joseph, who interprets the dreams as 7 years of plenty followed by 7 years of famine. Pharaoh appoints Joseph overseer of Egypt to prepare for the coming famine.

day-0991.key_verse_text: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,
day-0991.summary: An angel announces Babylon's fall, declaring the great city a demon-infested ruin. A heavenly voice calls God's people to depart before her plagues arrive. Kings, merchants, and sailors mourn her destruction in a single hour, while heaven rejoices over God's judgment against her.

day-0330.key_verse_text: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
day-0330.summary: Zophar declares that the wicked person's triumph is brief, and though wickedness seems sweet initially, it turns to poison within. The wicked person loses all possessions, faces divine judgment and terror, and ultimately perishes, leaving nothing behind. This is the appointed heritage of the wicked from God.

day-0407.key_verse_text: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
day-0407.summary: The psalmist questions why God has rejected the congregation and allowed enemies to destroy the sanctuary, burn it to the ground, and silence prophets. Yet God remains the eternal King who divided the sea, defeated sea monsters, and established all creation's boundaries and seasons.

day-0627.key_verse_text: He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;
day-0627.summary: The Lord's glory enters the eastern gate and fills the temple. The Lord declares the temple as the eternal dwelling place among Israel and establishes ordinances for the altar's consecration, priestly duties, and temple access, designating the sons of Zadok as priests and restricting entry to the circumcised.

day-0486.key_verse_text: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
day-0486.summary: The passage offers observations about human conduct and character. Wine leads astray, provoking kings brings danger, and strife dishonors a person. Laziness results in poverty while diligence brings satisfaction. Faithfulness is rare, integrity blesses descendants, and the Lord establishes human steps. Dishonest dealings displease the Lord, while wise counsel and careful vows matter greatly.

day-0265.key_verse_text: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of Yahweh, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.
day-0265.summary: Jehu orchestrates the elimination of Ahab's 70 sons and extends his purge to other royal relatives and Baal worshipers through deception. Though the Lord commends his execution of judgment against Ahab's house, Jehu maintains the idolatrous golden calves of Jeroboam and fails to fully obey the Lord's law.

day-0844.key_verse_text: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”
day-0844.summary: Paul recruits Timothy and travels through Asia Minor, delivering apostolic decrees. A vision directs him to Macedonia. In Philippi, Lydia believes and is baptized. Paul casts out a spirit of divination, leading to his imprisonment. An earthquake frees the prisoners, and the jailer believes after hearing the gospel. The magistrates later release Paul and Silas.

day-0706.key_verse_text: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
day-0706.summary: Herod executes John the Baptizer after his daughter requests John's head. Jesus withdraws to a deserted place, where he feeds 5,000 people with 5 loaves and 2 fish. Later, Jesus walks on water to his disciples' boat during a storm, and Peter briefly walks toward him before sinking. Those in the boat worship Jesus as the Son of God.

day-0962.key_verse_text: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
day-0962.summary: Elders shepherd God's flock voluntarily and humbly, receiving a crown of glory when Christ appears. The younger submit to elders while all clothe themselves in humility. Believers cast their worries on God, remain watchful against the devil, and stand firm in faith, knowing others suffer similarly. God's grace perfects and strengthens those who endure.

day-0046.key_verse_text: I will take you to myself for a people. I will be your God; and you shall know that I am Yahweh your God, who brings you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
day-0046.summary: Moses and Aaron request that Pharaoh release the Israelites to worship the Lord, but Pharaoh refuses and increases their labor by withholding straw while demanding the same brick quota. The officers suffer beatings, and Moses questions the Lord about the worsening conditions. The Lord responds by affirming the covenant and promising deliverance through mighty acts.

day-0186.key_verse_text: He judged Israel twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
day-0186.summary: Samson sees a Philistine woman and insists on marrying her despite his parents' objections. The Lord's Spirit empowers him to kill a lion and later defeat 30 Philistine men. After his wife is given to another man, Samson burns the Philistines' crops with foxes, then kills 1,000 men with a donkey's jawbone. He judges Israel 20 years.

day-0266.key_verse_text: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”
day-0266.summary: Jehosheba rescues young Joash from his grandmother Athaliah's purge and hides him in the Lord's house for 6 years. Jehoiada the priest orchestrates Joash's coronation with military protection, executes Athaliah, and establishes a covenant. King Joash later directs temple repairs and reigns 40 years until his servants assassinate him.

day-0487.key_verse_text: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
day-0487.summary: The Lord directs the king's heart as water flows through channels. Every person views his own way as right, yet the Lord weighs hearts. Righteousness and justice please the Lord more than sacrifice. The diligent gain profit while the hasty rush toward poverty. The wicked's violence drives them away, and no wisdom stands against the Lord.

day-0408.key_verse_text: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
day-0408.summary: God judges with authority, putting down the arrogant and lifting up the righteous. The Lord's judgment brings fear to the earth and salvation to the afflicted. Warriors fall powerless before God's rebuke, and nations tremble at divine anger. Kings and princes stand in awe of the Lord's power and majesty.

day-0045.key_verse_text: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,
day-0045.summary: Moses obtains permission from Jethro to return to Egypt. The Lord instructs him to perform wonders before Pharaoh while hardening his heart. After a mysterious encounter at a lodging place, Moses meets Aaron in the wilderness. Together they gather Israel's elders, and Aaron performs signs before the people, who believe and worship upon hearing the Lord has visited them.

day-0712.key_verse_text: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
day-0712.summary: A vineyard master hires laborers throughout the day, paying all the same wage regardless of hours worked. When early workers complain, the master defends his generosity. Jesus then tells his disciples about his coming suffering and teaches that greatness comes through servanthood. Two blind men receive sight through his compassion.

day-0628.key_verse_text: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Enough, you princes of Israel! Remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and righteousness! Stop dispossessing my people!” says the Lord Yahweh.
day-0628.summary: The Lord describes land divisions for priests and Levites, establishes just weights and measures, and prescribes offerings for the prince and people. Temple gates open on Sabbaths and new moons for worship. The prince receives inheritance from his own possession rather than the people's land. Priests prepare sacrifices in designated boiling houses within the temple courts.

day-0845.key_verse_text: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.
day-0845.summary: Paul travels through Amphipolis, Apollonia, and Thessalonica, reasoning in synagogues that Jesus is the Christ. Opposition from unpersuaded Jews drives him to Beroea, where residents examine the Scriptures daily and many believe. Later at Athens, Paul addresses philosophers and citizens, proclaiming the unknown God and calling all people to repent before the appointed day of judgment.

day-0004.key_verse_text: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
day-0004.summary: The serpent deceives the woman into eating forbidden fruit, and she gives some to the man. After eating, they recognize their nakedness and hide from the Lord. The Lord pronounces curses on the serpent, woman, and man, then expels them from the garden and stations cherubim to guard it.

day-0188.key_verse_text: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
day-0188.summary: Micah of Ephraim restores stolen silver to his mother, who dedicates it to make carved and molten images for his house. A Levite from Bethlehem becomes Micah's priest. Later, Danite warriors seize the idols and priest, attack the city of Laish, and establish it as their own, setting up the stolen image for worship.

day-0187.key_verse_text: Samson called to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, remember me, please, and strengthen me, please, only this once, God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.”
day-0187.summary: Samson visits Gaza and later loves Delilah, whom Philistine lords pay to discover his strength. After 3 failed attempts, she learns his power comes from his uncut hair. She shaves him while he sleeps, and the Philistines capture, blind, and imprison him. His hair grows back; at a festival, he pulls down the temple pillars, killing thousands and himself.

day-0409.key_verse_text: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
day-0409.summary: A person in distress cries to God and struggles with doubts about divine favor, but then recalls God's past wonders and mighty deeds. The speaker remembers how God parted the sea, led the people like a flock through the waters, and demonstrated strength among the nations through miraculous acts.

day-0488.key_verse_text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
day-0488.summary: A good name surpasses wealth, and the Lord makes both rich and poor. The prudent avoid danger while the simple suffer. Humility and fear of the Lord bring wealth and honor. Children trained properly maintain their path. Generosity brings blessing, while wickedness and oppression lead to trouble and poverty.

day-0629.key_verse_text: It will happen that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.
day-0629.summary: Waters flow from beneath the temple eastward, deepening as they progress until becoming an impassable river that heals the sea and sustains abundant life. Trees bearing perpetual fruit line the banks. The Lord divides the restored land among the 12 tribes with a central sacred district, a city, and portions for priests and Levites.

day-0756.key_verse_text: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord. My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,
day-0756.summary: The angel Gabriel announces to Mary in Nazareth that she will conceive and bear a son named Jesus, who will reign over Jacob's house forever. Mary accepts God's word, then visits her relative Elizabeth, whose baby leaps at Mary's greeting. Elizabeth blesses Mary, and Mary responds with a song magnifying the Lord for his mercy and mighty deeds.

day-0267.key_verse_text: But Yahweh was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.
day-0267.summary: Jehoahaz reigns over Israel in sin and faces Syrian oppression until crying out to the Lord, who provides deliverance. His successor Jehoash also does evil. Elisha dies after prophesying limited Syrian victories to Jehoash. Amaziah of Judah defeats Edomites but loses a battle against Jehoash, who captures him and plunders Jerusalem. Jeroboam later restores Israel's borders.

day-0108.key_verse_text: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”
day-0108.summary: Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses regarding his Cushite wife, questioning whether the Lord speaks only through him. The Lord appears and declares Moses uniquely faithful, speaking with him directly rather than through visions or dreams. The Lord's anger burns against them, and Miriam becomes leprous. After Moses intercedes, the Lord orders her isolated for 7 days before restoration.

day-0846.key_verse_text: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent; for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
day-0846.summary: Paul arrives in Corinth, works as a tentmaker with Aquila and Priscilla, and reasons in the synagogue. After opposition from Jews, he turns to Gentiles. The Lord assures Paul through a vision that he will be protected. Paul teaches there for 18 months, then travels to Ephesus and beyond, while Apollos preaches in Ephesus.

day-0964.key_verse_text: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
day-0964.summary: False prophets and teachers introduce destructive heresies among the people, exploiting them with deceptive words while many follow their immoral ways. The Lord demonstrates ability to deliver the godly from temptation and reserve the unrighteous for judgment, as shown through past deliverances and condemnations.

day-0963.key_verse_text: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
day-0963.summary: Simon Peter writes to believers sharing a precious faith, declaring that God's divine power grants all things needed for life and godliness through knowledge of Jesus Christ. The Lord's great promises enable believers to escape worldly corruption and become partakers of the divine nature by cultivating virtues from faith through love.

day-0189.key_verse_text: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”
day-0189.summary: A Levite retrieves his concubine from her father's house in Bethlehem and travels homeward. Arriving at Gibeah after dark, an old man offers shelter. Wicked men of the city assault the concubine throughout the night. The Levite dismembers her body and distributes the pieces throughout Israel, prompting shock and outrage among all who witness this atrocity.

day-0005.key_verse_text: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”
day-0005.summary: Adam and Eve bear 2 sons: Cain, a farmer, and Abel, a shepherd. When the Lord accepts Abel's offering but rejects Cain's, Cain becomes angry. The Lord warns that sin crouches at the door, but Cain kills Abel in a field. Cursed to wander the earth, Cain receives a protective mark from the Lord and settles east of Eden.

day-0410.key_verse_text: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.
day-0410.summary: The psalmist calls the people to hear instruction about the Lord's covenant with Jacob and his wondrous deeds in Egypt. Despite the Lord's miraculous provision and guidance through the wilderness, the people repeatedly rebel, doubt, and turn to idolatry. The Lord responds with judgment yet shows mercy, ultimately choosing Judah and David as shepherd.

day-0109.key_verse_text: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”
day-0109.summary: The Lord commands Moses to send 12 spies into Canaan. After 40 days, most report the land is unconquerable, but Caleb and Joshua urge trust in the Lord. The people rebel and threaten to stone them. The Lord declares the faithless generation will die in the wilderness; only Caleb and Joshua will enter the promised land.

day-0860.key_verse_text: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
day-0860.summary: Those baptized into Christ Jesus are baptized into his death and burial, raised with him to walk in newness of life. Christ, raised from the dead, dies no more, and sin no longer has dominion over those united with him. The wages of sin is death, but God gives eternal life freely in Christ Jesus.

day-0757.key_verse_text: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people; and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David
day-0757.summary: Elizabeth gives birth to a son, and neighbors rejoice at the Lord's mercy toward her. On the eighth day, the parents name him John despite relatives' objection. Zacharias, his father, regains speech and prophesies about the child's future role and the Lord's redemption of Israel.

day-0268.key_verse_text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in Yahweh his God’s eyes, like David his father.
day-0268.summary: Azariah reigns righteously in Judah for 52 years but contracts leprosy. Israel experiences rapid succession of kings, all doing evil and perpetuating Jeroboam's sins. Jotham follows Azariah righteously. Ahaz then reigns, walking in Israel's ways and practicing forbidden rituals. Syria and Israel besiege Jerusalem; Ahaz appeals to Assyria for help and later adopts a foreign altar design for the temple.

day-0489.key_verse_text: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
day-0489.summary: The passage offers practical counsel on restraint and wisdom. It warns against pursuing wealth, coveting another's food, or speaking to fools. It instructs on disciplining children, honoring parents, and acquiring truth and understanding. It cautions against envy, excessive drinking, gluttony, and sexual immorality, describing their destructive consequences.

day-0006.key_verse_text: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.
day-0006.summary: The text records Adam's descendants through 10 generations, each living centuries and producing children. As humanity multiplies, wickedness becomes prevalent and evil dominates human hearts. The Lord grieves over creating mankind and determines to destroy all people and animals, yet Noah finds favor in the Lord's eyes.

day-0630.key_verse_text: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
day-0630.summary: Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem and the Lord delivers King Jehoiakim into his hand. The king selects 4 youths from Judah, including Daniel, for training in Chaldean learning. Daniel refuses the king's food and wine, requesting vegetables instead. God grants the youths knowledge and wisdom, and after testing, Daniel and his companions appear healthier than those eating royal provisions.

day-0976.key_verse_text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
day-0976.summary: Jesus addresses 3 assemblies with messages about their spiritual condition. Sardis appears alive but is dead and must repent. Philadelphia has kept his word and receives an open door. Laodicea is lukewarm and spiritually poor, yet Jesus stands at the door knocking, offering restoration to those who overcome.

day-0190.key_verse_text: Then all the children of Israel and all the people went up, and came to Bethel, and wept, and sat there before Yahweh, and fasted that day until evening; then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.
day-0190.summary: All Israel assembles at Mizpah to address a Levite's account of his concubine's murder in Gibeah. Benjamin refuses to surrender the perpetrators, and armed conflict ensues. After 2 devastating defeats, Israel seeks the Lord's counsel at Bethel, fasts, and offers sacrifices. The Lord promises victory, and Israel defeats Benjamin through an ambush strategy, resulting in massive casualties.

day-0331.key_verse_text: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
day-0331.summary: Job responds to his companions, describing how the wicked prosper with healthy families, safe homes, and abundant livestock, yet they reject the Lord and question his value. Job notes that the wicked die in comfort while others suffer, and both end alike in dust, challenging his companions' explanations as false comfort.

day-0411.key_verse_text: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
day-0411.summary: The nations have invaded God's inheritance, defiling the holy temple and laying Jerusalem waste. The dead remain unburied, their bodies exposed to animals and birds. The people cry out for God to turn away divine anger and pour wrath upon the nations instead, asking deliverance and forgiveness for the sake of God's name.

day-0490.key_verse_text: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
day-0490.summary: The passage contrasts wisdom with folly, advising against envy of evil men whose hearts plot violence. Wisdom builds houses and brings strength through knowledge and counsel. The righteous rise after falling while the wicked face calamity. Justice requires rescuing the endangered and convicting the guilty. Laziness brings poverty like an armed robber.

day-0977.key_verse_text: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”
day-0977.summary: A door opens in heaven, revealing a throne with one seated upon it surrounded by 24 elders and 4 living creatures. Lightning and thunder proceed from the throne as the creatures and elders continually worship, declaring the seated one worthy to receive glory, honor, and power as creator of all things.

day-0631.key_verse_text: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.
day-0631.summary: King Nebuchadnezzar demands his magicians reveal and interpret a forgotten dream, threatening death if they fail. Daniel requests time and prays with his companions for divine revelation. God shows Daniel the dream: a statue of descending metals struck by a stone that becomes a mountain. Daniel interprets the kingdoms and reveals that God's eternal kingdom will destroy all others.

day-0110.key_verse_text: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”
day-0110.summary: The Lord instructs Moses on offerings when the Israelites enter their land, specifying meal and drink offerings for various sacrifices. Laws apply equally to native-born and foreigners. Unintentional violations require communal atonement; deliberate disobedience brings death. A man gathering sticks on the Sabbath is executed. The Lord commands fringes on garments with blue cords as reminders of commandments.

day-0874.key_verse_text: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own, for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
day-0874.summary: Paul addresses sexual immorality within the congregation, instructing members to remove the offender and maintain separation from those claiming faith while living sinfully. He instructs believers to resolve disputes among themselves rather than before unbelievers, and emphasizes that bodies belong to the Lord as temples of the Holy Spirit, purchased at a price.

day-0111.key_verse_text: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.
day-0111.summary: Korah and 250 leaders rebel against Moses and Aaron's authority, claiming all Israel is holy. The Lord causes the earth to swallow the rebels alive and fire to consume the 250 men. After a subsequent plague kills thousands, the Lord confirms Aaron's priesthood by making his rod bud with almonds among 12 tribal rods.

day-0758.key_verse_text: For there is born to you today, in David ’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.
day-0758.summary: Caesar Augustus orders a census, prompting Joseph and the pregnant Mary to travel to Bethlehem. Mary gives birth to her firstborn son and places him in a feeding trough. An angel announces the birth to shepherds, and a heavenly multitude praises God. The shepherds visit the child and spread the news widely.

day-0007.key_verse_text: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.
day-0007.summary: Noah, a righteous man, receives God's command to build an ark and gather 2 of every animal species to survive an impending flood. Noah obeys completely. The floodwaters come, covering all high mountains and destroying all flesh on earth for 150 days, while Noah and those with him in the ark remain alive.

day-0332.key_verse_text: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
day-0332.summary: Eliphaz accuses Job of great wickedness, listing specific sins against the poor and vulnerable. He describes the fate of wicked people and then urges Job to reconcile with God, receive instruction, abandon unrighteousness, and trust the Almighty for restoration and blessing.

day-0552.key_verse_text: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break every yoke?
day-0552.summary: The Lord commands declaration of the people's disobedience, exposing their hollow fasting practices. True fasting involves releasing the oppressed, feeding the hungry, clothing the naked, and honoring the Sabbath. Those who practice such justice experience the Lord's guidance, healing, and restoration.

day-0191.key_verse_text: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
day-0191.summary: The Israelites grieve over Benjamin's near destruction and devise a solution to provide wives for the remaining Benjaminites. They attack Jabesh Gilead, securing 400 virgins, then instruct Benjamin to capture dancing women from Shiloh. The people disperse to their territories.

day-0632.key_verse_text: If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.”
day-0632.summary: King Nebuchadnezzar erects a golden image and commands all peoples to worship it or face the burning furnace. Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refuse and are cast into the fire, yet emerge unharmed. Nebuchadnezzar witnesses their deliverance and acknowledges the power of their God, then promotes the 3 men.

day-0412.key_verse_text: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
day-0412.summary: The psalmist calls on the Lord, the Shepherd of Israel, to turn and shine his face upon the people, who suffer tears and mockery from enemies. The Lord had planted Israel like a vine from Egypt, but it now lies ravaged and burned. The psalmist pleads for the Lord to restore and revive the people.

day-0978.key_verse_text: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
day-0978.summary: A sealed book rests in the hand of the one on the throne, and no creature proves worthy to open it until a Lamb standing amid the throne and elders takes the book. The four living creatures and 24 elders, along with countless angels and all creation, sing praises to the Lamb for its worthiness and redemptive work.

day-0875.key_verse_text: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
day-0875.summary: Paul addresses questions about marriage and singleness, stating that while remaining unmarried is good, marriage is permissible to avoid sexual immorality. Married partners owe each other affection and should not deprive one another. Paul advises each person to remain in their current condition, whether married or single, circumcised or uncircumcised, slave or free, as the Lord has called them.

day-0112.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.
day-0112.summary: The Lord assigns Aaron and the Levites specific duties in the sanctuary, grants Aaron and his sons portions of offerings and firstfruits as their inheritance, and prohibits them from owning land. The Lord then establishes the statute for a red heifer whose ashes purify those who touch the dead, with detailed procedures for cleansing uncleanness lasting seven days.

day-0771.key_verse_text: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
day-0771.summary: Jesus grants the 12 power over demons and disease, sending them to preach God's Kingdom with minimal provisions. They heal throughout villages while Herod questions Jesus's identity. Jesus feeds 5,000 with 5 loaves and 2 fish, then tells disciples the Son of Man must suffer, be rejected, and rise on the third day.

day-0413.key_verse_text: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
day-0413.summary: The Lord recalls delivering Israel from Egypt and commands the people to worship only him, promising to provide abundantly. However, the people refuse to listen and pursue their own desires, so the Lord allows them to follow their stubborn hearts instead of receiving his protection and provision.

day-0333.key_verse_text: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
day-0333.summary: Job expresses his desire to present his case before God, whom he cannot locate despite searching in all directions. Though God remains hidden, Job acknowledges that God knows his path and will refine him like gold. Job then describes the injustices perpetrated by the wicked against the poor and vulnerable, questioning why God does not judge such wickedness.

day-0192.key_verse_text: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God. Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”
day-0192.summary: During a famine, Elimelech takes his wife Naomi and 2 sons to Moab. After Elimelech and both sons die, Naomi decides to return to Bethlehem. Though Orpah departs, Ruth commits to staying with Naomi, pledging to adopt her people and God. The 2 women arrive in Bethlehem at barley harvest, with Naomi expressing bitterness over her losses.

day-0633.key_verse_text: All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and no one can stop his hand, or ask him, “What are you doing?”
day-0633.summary: King Nebuchadnezzar recounts a troubling dream of a great tree cut down, which Daniel interprets as the king's coming humiliation. The prophecy fulfills when Nebuchadnezzar is driven from his palace, lives like an animal for 7 times, then recovers his sanity and kingdom, acknowledging the Most High's eternal dominion.

day-0008.key_verse_text: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.
day-0008.summary: God remembers Noah and the animals, stopping the flood waters. After months of waiting and sending out birds to test the land, Noah exits the ship with all creatures. Noah builds an altar, and the Lord establishes an everlasting covenant never to flood the earth again, setting the rainbow as its sign.

day-0889.key_verse_text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
day-0889.summary: Those in Christ become new creations with old things passing away. God reconciled the world through Jesus Christ, not counting trespasses against people. Believers serve as ambassadors of reconciliation, and Christ became sin so that people might become God's righteousness.

day-0009.key_verse_text: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
day-0009.summary: Noah plants a vineyard and becomes drunk; Ham sees his nakedness and tells his brothers, while Shem and Japheth cover their father respectfully. Noah curses Canaan and blesses Shem and Japheth. The earth's nations descend from Noah's sons. Humanity, speaking one language, builds a city and tower in Shinar until the Lord confuses their speech and scatters them.

day-0193.key_verse_text: May Yahweh repay your work, and a full reward be given to you from Yahweh, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take refuge.”
day-0193.summary: Ruth gleans in Boaz's field and finds favor with him. Boaz praises her loyalty to Naomi and provides her protection and food. Later, Naomi instructs Ruth to approach Boaz at the threshing floor. Boaz acknowledges Ruth's worthiness and promises to resolve her situation, giving her barley before she returns to Naomi.

day-0553.key_verse_text: “A Redeemer will come to Zion, and to those who turn from disobedience in Jacob,” says Yahweh.
day-0553.summary: The Lord's hand remains able to save, but human iniquities separate people from God. Widespread wickedness, violence, and falsehood pervade the land, leaving justice distant and righteousness absent. The Lord observes this corruption, puts on righteousness as armor, and promises a Redeemer will come to Zion and those who turn from disobedience.

day-0113.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
day-0113.summary: The Israelites arrive at Kadesh where Miriam dies. Lacking water, they quarrel with Moses and Aaron, who seek the Lord's guidance. Moses strikes a rock twice and water flows abundantly. The Lord declares Moses and Aaron will not enter the promised land because they failed to believe. Later, Aaron dies on Mount Hor, and the congregation mourns him.

day-0334.key_verse_text: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”
day-0334.summary: Bildad declares that God possesses dominion and fear, with armies beyond counting, while man cannot be just before him. Job responds by describing God's vast power: stretching the north over empty space, hanging the earth on nothing, binding waters in clouds, and stirring the sea. Job concludes that these reveal only the outskirts of God's ways.

day-0992.key_verse_text: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”
day-0992.summary: A great multitude in heaven praises God for his righteous judgments and the destruction of the prostitute. The 24 elders and 4 living creatures worship as a voice calls all servants to give praise. A rider on a white horse, called Faithful and True with the name King of Kings, judges in righteousness while heavenly armies follow him.

day-0772.key_verse_text: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
day-0772.summary: Jesus takes 3 disciples up a mountain where his appearance transforms, Moses and Elijah appear, and a voice declares him the beloved Son. After descending, he heals a demon-possessed boy, teaches about his coming delivery, and instructs his followers about greatness, acceptance, and the cost of discipleship.

day-0554.key_verse_text: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.
day-0554.summary: The Lord's glory rises upon a city, drawing nations and kings to its light. Foreigners bring wealth and rebuild walls while former oppressors bow down. The Lord becomes the city's everlasting light, replacing sun and moon, and establishes peace and righteousness within its borders.

day-0773.key_verse_text: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
day-0773.summary: The Lord appoints 70 others and sends them out to proclaim God's Kingdom, heal the sick, and offer peace to receptive households. The 70 return joyfully reporting that demons obey them, but the Lord redirects their rejoicing toward their names being written in heaven rather than their power over spirits.

day-0890.key_verse_text: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
day-0890.summary: Paul urges the Corinthians not to receive God's grace in vain, describing his apostolic service through afflictions and virtues. He calls them to separation from unbelievers and cleansing themselves. God comforts Paul through Titus, who reports the Corinthians' godly sorrow and repentance, bringing Paul joy and confidence in them.

day-0114.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.” Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.
day-0114.summary: Israel defeats the Canaanite king of Arad after vowing to destroy his cities. During the journey, the people complain and the Lord sends venomous snakes; Moses makes a bronze serpent on a pole so the bitten may live by looking at it. Israel then defeats Sihon and Og, possessing their lands.

day-0414.key_verse_text: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed. Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
day-0414.summary: God presides in the great assembly and judges among the gods, questioning their unjust judgments and partiality toward the wicked. God commands them to defend the weak, poor, and fatherless, and to rescue the needy from the wicked. They walk in darkness, shaking the earth's foundations. God declares they are gods yet shall die like mortals and fall like rulers.

day-0335.key_verse_text: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
day-0335.summary: Job maintains his integrity and declares he will not abandon righteousness. He describes the fate of the wicked, whose wealth and houses prove temporary before destruction overtakes them. Wisdom, though humans search for precious metals and gems, cannot be purchased or found in the earth; God alone understands its place, and fearing the Lord constitutes true wisdom.

day-0634.key_verse_text: TEKEL: you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.
day-0634.summary: King Belshazzar hosts a feast where he and his lords drink from sacred vessels taken from Jerusalem's temple and praise false gods. A mysterious hand writes on the palace wall, terrifying the king. His wise men cannot interpret the writing, so Daniel is summoned and reveals that the Lord has judged Belshazzar's kingdom and found it wanting.

day-0993.key_verse_text: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
day-0993.summary: An angel binds Satan for a thousand years, during which martyrs reign with Christ. After Satan's release and subsequent defeat, the dead stand before a great white throne where they are judged according to their works and the book of life, with the unwritten cast into the lake of fire.

day-0194.key_verse_text: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.
day-0194.summary: Boaz arranges a legal transaction at the city gate with 10 elders as witnesses, acquiring Naomi's land and Ruth as his wife to preserve the family name. Ruth conceives and bears a son, whom the women name Obed. The genealogy traces Obed's line through Jesse to David.

day-0415.key_verse_text: that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
day-0415.summary: The psalmist calls on God to break silence as enemies conspire to destroy Israel. Multiple nations form an alliance against God's people, plotting their annihilation. The psalmist requests God to defeat these adversaries so all may recognize the Lord as the Most High over all the earth.

day-0786.key_verse_text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
day-0786.summary: Jesus passes through Jericho and calls Zacchaeus, a wealthy tax collector, down from a sycamore tree. Zacchaeus receives him joyfully and pledges to give half his goods to the poor and restore fourfold what he wrongfully took. Jesus declares salvation has come to his house.

day-0555.key_verse_text: The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to bind up the broken hearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and release to those who are bound, to proclaim the year of Yahweh’s favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,
day-0555.summary: The Lord's Spirit anoints a messenger to proclaim good news to the humble, bind up the brokenhearted, and release captives. The Lord promises restoration, joy, and righteousness to Zion, transforming shame into honor and establishing an everlasting covenant. Jerusalem receives a new name and becomes a crown of beauty, with the Lord rejoicing over the redeemed people.

day-0903.key_verse_text: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly, which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
day-0903.summary: The writer gives thanks for the faith and love present among the recipients and prays that God grants them wisdom and revelation to know Christ more fully, understanding the hope of his calling, the riches of his inheritance, and the greatness of his power demonstrated in raising Christ and exalting him above all authority.

day-0336.key_verse_text: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!
day-0336.summary: Job recounts his former prosperity and honor, when the Lord favored him and people revered his counsel. He contrasts this with his present suffering and degradation, describing physical torment and social contempt. He then catalogs his righteous conduct regarding lust, servants, the poor, wealth, and honesty, challenging anyone to prove him guilty of wrongdoing.

day-0256.key_verse_text: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight.
day-0256.summary: Ahab desires Naboth's vineyard but is refused. Jezebel orchestrates false charges against Naboth, resulting in his execution by stoning. Ahab takes possession of the vineyard. Elijah confronts Ahab with the Lord's judgment, pronouncing destruction on his house. Ahab repents in sackcloth, and the Lord delays the calamity until his son's generation.

day-0036.key_verse_text: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;
day-0036.summary: The famine forces Jacob's sons to return to Egypt for grain, but the Egyptian official requires Benjamin's presence. Judah pledges himself as collateral and persuades his father to send the boy. The brothers arrive with gifts and double payment, and Joseph welcomes them to his house, where he is moved upon seeing Benjamin.

day-0416.key_verse_text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
day-0416.summary: The psalmist expresses longing for the Lord's dwelling place, describing how blessed are those who dwell in God's house and those whose strength rests in the Lord. A day in God's courts surpasses a thousand elsewhere, and the Lord provides grace and glory to those who walk blamelessly.

day-0035.key_verse_text: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”
day-0035.summary: Jacob sends 10 sons to Egypt for grain during famine. Joseph, now governor, recognizes his brothers but conceals his identity, accusing them of being spies. He detains them 3 days, then releases 9 with grain while holding Simeon hostage, demanding they return with Benjamin. The brothers discover their money restored in their sacks, troubling Jacob greatly.

day-0635.key_verse_text: “I make a decree that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. “For he is the living God, and steadfast forever. His kingdom is that which will not be destroyed. His dominion will be even to the end.
day-0635.summary: Darius establishes Daniel as a high official, but jealous rivals trick the king into signing a decree forbidding petitions to anyone but himself for 30 days. Daniel continues praying to God openly, gets arrested and thrown into a lion's den, yet emerges unharmed. The king then decrees that all people fear the God of Daniel, who delivers and performs wonders.

day-0636.key_verse_text: “I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him. Dominion was given him, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion, which will not pass away, and his kingdom one that will not be destroyed.
day-0636.summary: Daniel receives a vision of 4 great animals rising from the sea, followed by the Ancient of Days seated in judgment. A figure like a son of man approaches and receives everlasting dominion over all peoples. An interpreter explains that 4 kings will arise, but the saints of the Most High will ultimately possess the kingdom forever.

day-0556.key_verse_text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.
day-0556.summary: A figure emerges from Edom with blood-stained garments, having trodden the wine press alone in anger and wrath. The Lord then recounts his mercies toward Israel, how he was afflicted with them and carried them, yet they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. The people lament their desolation and plead for the Lord's return.

day-0787.key_verse_text: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
day-0787.summary: Jesus teaches in the temple as religious leaders question his authority. He responds with a parable about a vineyard owner whose servants and son are rejected by farmers. Later, spies attempt to trap him with questions about taxes and resurrection, but Jesus answers with wisdom that silences them. He then questions their understanding of the Messiah.

day-0905.key_verse_text: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
day-0905.summary: Gentiles once separated from Christ and Israel's covenants are now brought near through Christ's blood. He abolishes the hostility between Gentiles and Jews, creating one new people and reconciling both to God through the cross. Together they form God's holy temple, built on the apostles and prophets with Christ as the chief cornerstone.

day-0115.key_verse_text: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.
day-0115.summary: The children of Israel camp in Moab, causing King Balak to fear their numbers. Balak sends messengers to summon Balaam to curse Israel, offering great rewards.
