Though Balaam initially refuses, God permits him to go. The Lord's angel blocks his path three times until the donkey speaks, revealing the angel to Balaam. Balaam proceeds to meet Balak at Kiriath Huzoth.

day-0116.key_verse_text: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?
day-0116.summary: Balaam constructs altars and receives messages from God declaring blessings over Israel instead of curses. God speaks through Balaam, affirming that the divine word cannot be reversed and that Israel stands protected under the Lord's favor. Balak grows frustrated as Balaam refuses to curse the people.

day-0257.key_verse_text: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
day-0257.summary: The king of Israel and Jehoshaphat plan to attack Ramoth Gilead. Four hundred prophets predict success, but Micaiah reveals a vision of the Lord's throne and describes a lying spirit sent to deceive the king's prophets. The king imprisons Micaiah and goes to battle, where he dies from a random arrow strike, fulfilling Micaiah's prophecy.

day-0337.key_verse_text: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
day-0337.summary: Elihu becomes angry that Job justifies himself rather than God and that the three friends have not answered Job. Though younger, Elihu speaks, claiming the Spirit gives understanding regardless of age. He tells Job that God speaks through dreams and affliction to turn people from pride and preserve their souls from destruction.

day-0478.key_verse_text: Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh, but those who do the truth are his delight.
day-0478.summary: The righteous obtain favor from the Lord through wisdom, truthfulness, and diligent work, while the wicked face condemnation through deceit, laziness, and evil schemes. Truthful speech heals and endures, whereas lying lips displease the Lord. The righteous stand firm and find life, but the wicked are overthrown.

day-0557.key_verse_text: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things will not be remembered, nor come into mind.
day-0557.summary: The Lord makes himself available to those who do not seek him while a rebellious people provoke him through idolatry and disobedience. He promises judgment on the unfaithful but preserves a remnant of servants who will inherit new heavens and a new earth, where former troubles are forgotten and creation itself is restored to peace.

day-0037.key_verse_text: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
day-0037.summary: Joseph plants his silver cup in Benjamin's sack, then has his steward accuse the brothers of theft. Judah pleads for Benjamin's release, recounting their father's grief. Joseph reveals himself, weeps, and tells his brothers God sent him to Egypt to preserve life during the famine. Pharaoh invites the family to Egypt, and Jacob learns his son lives.

day-0637.key_verse_text: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand, son of man, for the vision belongs to the time of the end.”
day-0637.summary: Daniel sees a vision of a ram with 2 horns defeated by a male goat with a notable horn. The goat's horn breaks and 4 horns arise; from one emerges a small horn growing exceedingly great. Gabriel explains the vision concerns the end times, identifying the ram as Media-Persia and the goat as Greece.

day-0800.key_verse_text: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
day-0800.summary: Jesus travels through Samaria and encounters a woman at Jacob's well. He offers her living water that brings eternal life, then reveals knowledge of her 5 former husbands. Identifying himself as the Messiah, Jesus teaches that true worship happens in spirit and truth. The woman leaves to tell her city about him.

day-0038.key_verse_text: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
day-0038.summary: Jacob travels to Egypt with his entire household after God assures him in a vision that the Lord will make his descendants a great nation there. Joseph reunites with his father, then presents his family to Pharaoh, who grants them permission to settle in Goshen and places them under Joseph's care.

day-0338.key_verse_text: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.
day-0338.summary: Elihu addresses the wise, asserting that God cannot act wickedly or pervert justice. God sees all human ways and destroys the wicked while hearing the cries of the poor. Elihu contends that Job speaks without knowledge, claiming righteousness exceeds God's and questioning whether obedience benefits the Almighty.

day-0117.key_verse_text: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
day-0117.summary: Balaam, moved by the Spirit of God, blesses Israel 3 times despite Balak's anger and demands for curses. Balaam declares Israel's strength and future dominion, prophesying a star and scepter arising from Jacob to conquer surrounding nations. Balak dismisses Balaam, who returns home.

day-0479.key_verse_text: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
day-0479.summary: The passage contrasts wise and foolish behavior across numerous domains: speech, work, wealth, relationships, and discipline. Wise sons heed instruction, the diligent prosper, the righteous shine with integrity, and those who accept correction gain honor. Fools despise guidance, scoffers reject rebuke, the lazy remain unsatisfied, and the wicked face ruin and hunger.

day-0558.key_verse_text: For my hand has made all these things, and so all these things came to be,” says Yahweh: “but I will look to this man, even to he who is poor and of a contrite spirit, and who trembles at my word.
day-0558.summary: The Lord declares that heaven is his throne and earth his footstool, seeking those who are poor and contrite in spirit and tremble at his word. Those who perform empty rituals while rejecting his voice will face judgment, while the Lord will comfort Zion and gather all nations to witness his glory and worship before him.

day-0638.key_verse_text: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”
day-0638.summary: Daniel understands from the books that Jerusalem's desolations will last 70 years and seeks the Lord through prayer, fasting, and confession of Israel's sins. Gabriel appears and reveals that 70 weeks are decreed for the people and holy city to finish transgression and bring everlasting righteousness.

day-0118.key_verse_text: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”
day-0118.summary: The Israelites engage in idolatry and sexual immorality with Moabite women, provoking the Lord's anger. Phinehas executes an Israelite man and a Midianite woman, stopping a plague that kills 24,000. The Lord grants Phinehas and his descendants an everlasting priesthood as reward for his zealous action.

day-0918.key_verse_text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
day-0918.summary: Those raised with Christ seek heavenly things where Christ sits at God's right hand, their lives hidden in God. They put to death earthly desires and vices, put on the new self renewed in the Creator's image, and walk in compassion, kindness, humility, forgiveness, and love, doing all in Christ's name with thanksgiving.

day-0039.key_verse_text: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,
day-0039.summary: The severe famine forces Egyptians to trade livestock, then land and themselves to Joseph for grain. Joseph consolidates all Egyptian land for Pharaoh except priestly holdings, establishes a taxation system, and relocates the population. Israel dwells in Goshen, prospers greatly, and Jacob, nearing death, makes Joseph swear to bury him outside Egypt.

day-0259.key_verse_text: This is an easy thing in Yahweh’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
day-0259.summary: Jehoram of Israel recruits Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom to fight Moab's rebellion, but the allied army runs out of water. Elisha prophesies that the Lord will provide water and deliver Moab into their hands. Water arrives overnight, the Moabites mistake it for blood and flee, and Israel defeats them.

day-0339.key_verse_text: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
day-0339.summary: Elihu continues speaking, declaring God's might and justice toward the righteous and wicked. He describes God's power over natural phenomena—snow, rain, lightning, and storms—which demonstrate divine majesty beyond human comprehension. Elihu urges Job to consider God's wondrous works and acknowledge the Lord's exalted power and righteousness.

day-0258.key_verse_text: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
day-0258.summary: King Ahaziah of Israel falls ill and sends messengers to consult Baal Zebub; Elijah intercepts them with a message of death. When the king sends soldiers to capture Elijah, fire consumes 2 companies before a third captain's humility spares his life. Elijah then ascends to heaven in a chariot of fire while Elisha watches, inheriting his mantle and performing miracles.

day-0801.key_verse_text: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
day-0801.summary: Jesus tells the disciples that doing the will of the one who sent him is his sustenance. Many Samaritans believe through a woman's testimony, and Jesus stays 2 days. Later, a nobleman begs Jesus to heal his dying son in Capernaum. Jesus declares the son lives, and the man believes, as does his household.

day-0802.key_verse_text: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”
day-0802.summary: Jesus heals a man sick for 38 years at the pool of Bethesda, commanding him to rise and walk on the Sabbath. The Jewish leaders object to the man carrying his mat, then seek to kill Jesus for healing on the Sabbath and claiming God as his Father.

day-0919.key_verse_text: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
day-0919.summary: Masters are instructed to treat servants justly, knowing the Lord oversees all. The recipients are urged to pray steadily with thanksgiving and speak gracefully to outsiders. Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to report on circumstances, and several companions send greetings, including Epaphras who prays for spiritual maturity among the churches.

day-0480.key_verse_text: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
day-0480.summary: The passage contrasts wise and foolish behavior across personal, relational, and national dimensions. Wisdom builds households and brings understanding, while folly tears down and leads to destruction. Righteousness exalts nations; sin disgraces them. Fear of the Lord provides security and refuge, while various forms of foolishness, deceit, and anger produce ruin.

day-0119.key_verse_text: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai. For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
day-0119.summary: After a plague, the Lord commands Moses and Eleazar to conduct a census of all Israelites aged 20 and older by tribal families. The census counts 601,730 people across the 12 tribes, with the Lord instructing that land inheritance be distributed by lot according to population size. The Levites are counted separately at 23,000 males.

day-0260.key_verse_text: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to Yahweh.
day-0260.summary: A widow's oil multiplies to pay her debt. A prominent woman builds Elisha a room; he promises her a son. The child dies, and Elisha travels to revive him through prayer and physical contact. Later, Elisha purifies poisoned stew and multiplies bread to feed the prophets.

day-0040.key_verse_text: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
day-0040.summary: Jacob, growing weak with age, receives Joseph and his 2 sons, Manasseh and Ephraim. Jacob adopts them as his own and blesses them, deliberately placing his right hand on the younger Ephraim's head despite Joseph's objection. Jacob declares that Ephraim will become greater than his older brother Manasseh.

day-0920.key_verse_text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
day-0920.summary: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write to the Thessalonian assembly, giving thanks for their faith, love, and hope in Jesus Christ. The gospel came to them in power and the Holy Spirit, and they became imitators of the apostles and the Lord. Their faith spreads throughout the region, and they turned from idols to serve the living God and await Jesus.

day-0340.key_verse_text: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
day-0340.summary: The Lord speaks to Job from a whirlwind, questioning his understanding of creation's foundations, the sea's boundaries, weather patterns, celestial bodies, and the behavior of wild animals including lions, ravens, mountain goats, wild donkeys, oxen, ostriches, horses, hawks, and eagles.

day-0481.key_verse_text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
day-0481.summary: The passage describes contrasts between wise and foolish speech, righteous and wicked behavior. Gentle answers turn away anger while harsh words provoke it. The Lord observes all people, delights in the prayers of the upright, and detests wickedness. Wisdom involves accepting correction, seeking counsel, and fearing the Lord, while folly brings trouble and destruction.

day-0559.key_verse_text: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”
day-0559.summary: Jeremiah, a priest from Anathoth, receives the Lord's call during the reigns of Josiah through Zedekiah. The Lord declares Jeremiah appointed as a prophet to the nations, places words in his mouth, and commissions him to uproot and build. Visions of an almond branch and boiling cauldron signal coming judgment from the north, with the Lord promising protection despite opposition.

day-0815.key_verse_text: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
day-0815.summary: Martha summons Mary to Jesus, who weeps at the tomb. Jesus commands Lazarus to come out, and the dead man emerges alive. Many Jews believe, but others report to the Pharisees, who plot Jesus's death. Jesus withdraws to Ephraim while authorities search for him before Passover.

day-0560.key_verse_text: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut out cisterns for themselves: broken cisterns that can’t hold water.
day-0560.summary: The Lord commands Jeremiah to proclaim that Israel has forsaken the Lord, the source of living water, and pursued worthless idols instead. The Lord recalls Israel's early devotion but condemns the people's unfaithfulness, their leaders' corruption, and their reliance on foreign nations. Judgment comes because the people have turned from the Lord and will not escape their shame.

day-0701.key_verse_text: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”
day-0701.summary: Jesus travels to teach after instructing his disciples. John the Baptist, imprisoned, questions whether Jesus is the expected one. Jesus describes his works of healing and proclaims John's greatness, then denounces cities that rejected him despite witnessing miracles. He concludes by offering rest to those who are burdened and take his yoke.

day-0700.key_verse_text: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
day-0700.summary: Jesus instructs his followers not to fear those who kill the body, assuring them that the Lord knows all things and values them more than sparrows. Those who confess Jesus before others will be confessed before the Father, while those who deny him will be denied. Receiving Jesus's followers brings reward.

day-0341.key_verse_text: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?
day-0341.summary: The Lord questions Job from the whirlwind, challenging him to match divine power and judgment. The Lord then describes behemoth and leviathan, two mighty creatures that demonstrate the Lord's supreme creative power and the futility of human resistance against such strength and majesty.

day-0933.key_verse_text: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
day-0933.summary: Paul writes to Timothy expressing thankfulness for his sincere faith, which traces through his mother Eunice and grandmother Lois. Paul urges Timothy to stir up the gift of God within him, noting that God grants power, love, and self-control rather than fear. Paul recounts his own suffering and commitment to the Gospel, and commends Onesiphorus for his faithful service.

day-0041.key_verse_text: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.
day-0041.summary: Jacob gathers his 12 sons and pronounces blessings and curses upon each tribe according to their character and future. Judah receives preeminence with perpetual rulership, while others receive varied fortunes. Jacob then instructs his sons regarding his burial and dies.

day-0482.key_verse_text: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
day-0482.summary: The Lord directs human steps and weighs motives, though people plan their own courses. Righteousness, humility, and truthful speech bring blessing, while pride and perversity lead to destruction. The Lord establishes justice and controls all outcomes, even casting lots.

day-0561.key_verse_text: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.
day-0561.summary: The Lord compares Israel's unfaithfulness to a wife's adultery, describing widespread idolatry on high places. Though Israel has been divorced for her treachery, Judah follows the same path. The Lord calls backsliding children to return, promising to heal them and give shepherds of knowledge, with Jerusalem becoming the Lord's throne where all nations gather.

day-0120.key_verse_text: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
day-0120.summary: The daughters of Zelophehad petition Moses for an inheritance since their father left no sons. The Lord approves their request and establishes a law of succession. The Lord then tells Moses to view the promised land before his death and instructs him to commission Joshua as the people's leader. Moses obeys, laying hands on Joshua before the priest and congregation.

day-0182.key_verse_text: Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;
day-0182.summary: Abimelech kills his 70 brothers to become king of Shechem with the city's support. Jotham, the sole survivor, pronounces a curse from Mount Gerizim. After 3 years, God sends discord between Abimelech and Shechem, leading to conflict, the city's destruction, and Abimelech's death by a woman's hand at Thebez.

day-0042.key_verse_text: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.
day-0042.summary: Joseph mourns his father's death and secures Pharaoh's permission to bury him in Canaan. After the burial, Joseph's brothers fear retribution, but Joseph assures them that God transformed their evil intentions into good for saving many lives. Joseph lives to see his descendants and dies at 110 years old.

day-0261.key_verse_text: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”
day-0261.summary: Naaman, a Syrian military commander with leprosy, travels to Israel on his king's orders seeking healing. The prophet Elisha instructs him to wash in the Jordan 7 times. After initial resistance, Naaman obeys and is healed. He returns to acknowledge the Lord's power and offers gifts, which Elisha refuses.

day-0702.key_verse_text: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.
day-0702.summary: Jesus and his disciples pluck grain on the Sabbath, prompting Pharisees to object. Jesus defends the action through examples and declares himself Lord of the Sabbath. He then heals a man's withered hand in a synagogue, causing the Pharisees to plot against him. Jesus withdraws and heals multitudes while remaining hidden, fulfilling Isaiah's prophecy about God's chosen servant.

day-0934.key_verse_text: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.
day-0934.summary: Paul instructs his child to be strengthened in Christ's grace and to pass on faithful teachings to others. Believers must endure hardship like soldiers and handle God's word properly. Those who deny Christ face denial from him, though God remains faithful. Servants of the Lord pursue righteousness and gentleness while avoiding foolish arguments and youthful lusts.

day-0483.key_verse_text: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
day-0483.summary: The passage presents observations about wisdom and folly across relationships, speech, and character. Peace with simplicity surpasses luxury with conflict. The Lord tests hearts as fire tests metals. Fools lack understanding despite resources, while the wise recognize that friends show loyalty and restraint in speech demonstrates knowledge.

day-0342.key_verse_text: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
day-0342.summary: Job acknowledges the Lord's power and confesses speaking without understanding. The Lord rebukes Job's 3 friends for misrepresenting him, commanding them to offer sacrifices while Job prays for them. The Lord restores Job's wealth and family, granting him twice his former possessions and a long life.

day-0816.key_verse_text: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
day-0816.summary: Jesus arrives in Bethany 6 days before Passover, where Mary anoints his feet with expensive ointment. Judas objects, but Jesus defends her action. A large crowd gathers to see Jesus and Lazarus, whom he raised from the dead. As Jesus enters Jerusalem on a donkey, crowds wave palm branches and cry "Hosanna," while Pharisees observe his growing influence.

day-0562.key_verse_text: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
day-0562.summary: The Lord calls Israel to return and put away abominations, warning that an invader from the north brings destruction. Jerusalem's wickedness has brought calamity upon the land, laying waste cities and fields. The Lord declares the devastation will be complete though not total, and the people flee in terror before the advancing enemy.

day-0703.key_verse_text: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.
day-0703.summary: Jesus heals a demon-possessed blind and mute man, prompting crowds to question if he is the son of David. The Pharisees claim he casts out demons by Beelzebul's power, but Jesus refutes this logic and declares that speaking against the Holy Spirit cannot be forgiven. He later identifies his true family as those who do the will of his Father.

day-0817.key_verse_text: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
day-0817.summary: Greeks seeking Jesus approach Philip, who brings their request to Jesus. Jesus speaks of his coming glorification, comparing himself to a grain of wheat that must die to bear much fruit. He teaches about self-sacrifice, warns of approaching judgment, and declares himself the light of the world sent to save rather than condemn.

day-0947.key_verse_text: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
day-0947.summary: A high priest sits at the throne of majesty in the heavens, serving the true tabernacle. The Lord establishes a new covenant superior to the first, writing laws on hearts and minds, making all people know the Lord directly, and remembering their sins no more.

day-0183.key_verse_text: Jephthah vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver the children of Ammon into my hand,
day-0183.summary: After 2 judges rule Israel, the people serve foreign gods and the Lord delivers them to Ammonite oppression for 18 years. Israel repents, and the Lord's anger softens. Jephthah, a rejected outcast, becomes leader and defeats Ammon after vowing to sacrifice whatever first meets him. His only daughter emerges to greet him, and he fulfills his vow.

day-0484.key_verse_text: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
day-0484.summary: The chapter describes the consequences of isolation, foolishness, and careless speech, while highlighting the power of words and wisdom. The Lord's name provides safety for the righteous, and a person's words ultimately determine satisfaction or ruin. Humility precedes honor, and genuine friendship proves more valuable than many shallow relationships.

day-0404.key_verse_text: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
day-0404.summary: A speaker calls urgently for the Lord's deliverance from enemies and expresses confidence in divine protection. The speaker declares lifelong hope and praise, recounting the Lord's faithfulness from youth through old age and committing to proclaim the Lord's righteousness and mighty acts to future generations.

day-0704.key_verse_text: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”
day-0704.summary: Jesus sits by the sea and speaks parables to a large crowd. He describes a farmer sowing seeds that fall on different types of ground: some are devoured by birds, some wither on rocky soil, some are choked by thorns, and some produce abundant fruit on good soil.

day-0829.key_verse_text: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
day-0829.summary: After breakfast, Jesus questions Simon Peter 3 times about his affection, each time instructing him to feed or tend the flock. Jesus then describes Peter's future suffering and tells him to follow. Peter asks about another disciple, and Jesus redirects him to his own path.

day-0262.key_verse_text: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
day-0262.summary: Elisha performs miracles for the sons of the prophets and Israel's king, revealing Syrian military plans and striking enemies with blindness. During a famine, 4 leprous men discover the Syrian camp abandoned after the Lord makes them hear phantom armies. Food prices plummet as prophesied, and a skeptical captain dies trampled at the gate.

day-0184.key_verse_text: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth ”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.
day-0184.summary: The men of Ephraim confront Jephthah for fighting Ammon without them, but Jephthah explains they refused his call. Gilead defeats Ephraim at the Jordan fords, using a shibboleth test to identify and kill 42,000 Ephraimites. Jephthah judges Israel 6 years, then Ibzan, Elon, and Abdon serve as judges successively.

day-0563.key_verse_text: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh; ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? Though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail. Though they roar, they still can’t pass over it.’
day-0563.summary: The Lord searches Jerusalem for one person who acts justly and seeks truth but finds none. The people swear falsely, refuse correction, and break the Lord's covenant. Both poor and great have rebelled. The Lord declares judgment through invading forces and famine, yet promises not to completely destroy. False prophets and corrupt leaders deceive the people, who love their deception.

day-0043.key_verse_text: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
day-0043.summary: The sons of Israel multiply greatly in Egypt. A new king enslaves them with harsh labor. Hebrew midwives refuse to kill newborn boys. Moses is born, hidden, and rescued by Pharaoh's daughter. After killing an Egyptian, Moses flees to Midian. God hears the Israelites' cries and remembers the covenant.

day-0263.key_verse_text: However, Yahweh would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.
day-0263.summary: A woman whose son Elisha restored to life returns from exile and receives her property restored by the king. Elisha travels to Damascus where he prophesies that Benhadad will die, and Hazael subsequently becomes king of Syria. Jehoram reigns over Judah wickedly, yet the Lord preserves Judah for David's sake. Edom revolts, and later Ahaziah becomes king.

day-0948.key_verse_text: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
day-0948.summary: The first covenant establishes a tabernacle with sacred furnishings and prescribed rituals. The high priest enters the inner sanctuary once yearly with blood for atonement. Christ, as the ultimate high priest, enters heaven itself through his own blood, obtaining eternal redemption and mediating a new covenant superior to the old.

day-0264.key_verse_text: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of Yahweh, even over Israel.
day-0264.summary: Elisha sends a young prophet to anoint Jehu as king over Israel and declare that Ahab's house will be destroyed for shedding the blood of the Lord's servants. Jehu's officers proclaim him king, and he rides to Jezreel where he kills Joram and Ahaziah. Jezebel is thrown from a window and trampled, her body consumed by dogs.

day-0405.key_verse_text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
day-0405.summary: A petition requests that God grant the king justice and righteousness to judge the people fairly, protect the poor, and break oppressors. The king's dominion extends from sea to sea, and all nations serve him. He delivers the needy and redeems them from oppression, his name enduring forever while all nations call him blessed.

day-0485.key_verse_text: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
day-0485.summary: Proverbs 19 contrasts the righteous poor with the foolish wealthy, emphasizing integrity over riches and wisdom over haste. The passage warns against false testimony, laziness, and hot temper while praising discretion, kindness, and obedience to the Lord's commandments. Though many plans exist in human hearts, the Lord's counsel ultimately prevails.

day-0564.key_verse_text: Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’
day-0564.summary: The Lord declares judgment against Jerusalem for its wickedness and rejection of the good way. A northern enemy approaches with military force. The people refuse to listen to warnings or return to righteous paths. Their covetousness, false dealings, and superficial peace claims bring destruction. The Lord rejects their offerings and will scatter them like refined metal discarding impurities.

day-0044.key_verse_text: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
day-0044.summary: Moses encounters the Lord at a burning bush on Mount Horeb and receives a commission to lead the Israelites out of Egypt. The Lord reveals his name and promises to be with Moses, providing 3 signs to authenticate his mission. Moses objects to his inadequacy, and the Lord appoints Aaron as his spokesman.

day-0949.key_verse_text: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful. Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works, not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
day-0949.summary: The law's sacrifices cannot perfect worshipers because animal blood cannot remove sins. Jesus offers his body as a single, eternal sacrifice, perfecting those being sanctified and establishing a new covenant where the Lord writes laws on hearts and remembers sins no more.

day-0406.key_verse_text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
day-0406.summary: A speaker struggles with envy upon witnessing the wicked prosper without suffering, while the righteous face constant affliction. Upon entering God's sanctuary and recognizing the wicked's ultimate destruction, the speaker finds resolution, affirming that God alone provides strength and remains the speaker's eternal portion.

day-0185.key_verse_text: for, behold, you shall conceive and give birth to a son. No razor shall come on his head, for the child shall be a Nazirite to God from the womb. He shall begin to save Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.”
day-0185.summary: The Lord's angel appears to a barren woman from Zorah and announces she will bear a son who becomes a Nazirite and saves Israel from the Philistines. The angel repeats dietary restrictions to her husband Manoah. After offering a burnt sacrifice, the angel ascends in the altar's flame. The woman gives birth to Samson, whom the Lord blesses.

day-0831.key_verse_text: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.
day-0831.summary: On Pentecost, believers gathered together experience a rushing wind and tongues of fire. The Holy Spirit fills them, enabling speech in languages they had not learned. Devout Jews from many nations hear the disciples speaking God's mighty works in their own languages. Peter addresses the crowd and quotes the prophet Joel regarding the outpouring of God's Spirit.

day-0705.key_verse_text: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.
day-0705.summary: Jesus teaches multiple parables about the Kingdom of Heaven: a man sows good seed but an enemy adds weeds; a mustard seed grows into a tree; yeast leavens meal. He explains the weeds parable to his disciples, then offers parables of hidden treasure, a pearl, and a dragnet. Later, in his hometown synagogue, people question his wisdom and reject him.

day-0626.key_verse_text: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, “This is the table that is before Yahweh.”
day-0626.summary: A guide measures the temple's inner sanctuary, side rooms in 3 stories, and decorated walls featuring cherubim and palm trees. The wooden altar stands before the Lord. Priests' rooms flank the holy place where they eat sacred offerings after changing garments. The outer wall measures 500 cubits on each side, separating holy from common space.

day-0830.key_verse_text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”
day-0830.summary: Jesus appears to the apostles over 40 days, teaching about God's Kingdom, then instructs them to wait in Jerusalem for the Holy Spirit's power before witnessing everywhere. He ascends into heaven. The apostles return to Jerusalem and gather in prayer. Peter addresses the group about replacing Judas, and they cast lots, selecting Matthias as the 12th apostle.
